data.name: Query_AvgGrossSalePriceFiveYears
data.value: SELECT DT.ItemCategoryID,DT.CategoryName, cast(2000 + cast(left(cast(DT.PeriodSetName as varchar),2) as int) as varchar)+'-'+ right(cast(DT.PeriodSetName as varchar),2) FiscalYear, --DT.PeriodSetName FiscalYear, sum(Abs(DT.BaseQuantity)) AS BaseQuantity, sum(isnull(DT.QuantityInvoiced,0)) QuantityInvoiced, sum(isnull(DT.BaseAmount,0)) BaseAmount, cast(round(sum(isnull(DT.BaseAmount,0))/sum(isnull(DT.QuantityInvoiced,0)),2) as decimal(18,4)) UnitPrice FROM ( SELECT SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemCategoryID,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName, (Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) AS BaseQuantity, (isnull(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced,0)) QuantityInvoiced, (SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice) UnitPrice, (isnull(SAL_InvoiceDetail.BaseAmount,0)) BaseAmount FROM SAL_InvoiceDetail LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceHeader ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID= INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status=1 LEFT JOIN SAL_DispatchHeader ON SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[FiscalID] AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1 Left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 Left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID Left JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemCategoryID AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_SET_Category.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID AND SET_UnitofMeasure.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID --Inner join SET_Period on SET_Period.PeriodID = Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodID WHERE SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID= @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.[Status] = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.[Status] = 1 AND (@DocumentTypeID is null OR SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID) AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between DATEADD(YYYY,-5, @AsOnDate) and @AsOnDate ) DT GROUP BY DT.ItemCategoryID,DT.CategoryName, DT.PeriodSetName Order by FiscalYear desc
data.comment: SELECT DT.ItemCategoryID,DT.CategoryName, Cast(2000+DT.YY-1 as varchar) +'-'+ cast(DT.YY as varchar) FiscalYear,-- DT.MMM, sum(Abs(DT.BaseQuantity)) AS BaseQuantity, sum(isnull(DT.QuantityInvoiced,0)) QuantityInvoiced, sum(isnull(DT.BaseAmount,0)) BaseAmount, cast(round(sum(isnull(DT.BaseAmount,0))/sum(isnull(DT.QuantityInvoiced,0)),2) as decimal(18,4)) UnitPrice FROM ( SELECT SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemCategoryID,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, FORMAT(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate,'MM') MM, FORMAT (SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate,'yy') YY, (Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) AS BaseQuantity, (isnull(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced,0)) QuantityInvoiced, (SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice) UnitPrice, (isnull(SAL_InvoiceDetail.BaseAmount,0)) BaseAmount FROM SAL_InvoiceDetail LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceHeader ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID= INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status=1 LEFT JOIN SAL_DispatchHeader ON SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[FiscalID] AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1 Left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 Left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID Left JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemCategoryID AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_SET_Category.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID AND SET_UnitofMeasure.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID WHERE SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID= @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.[Status] = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.[Status] = 1 AND (@DocumentTypeID is null OR SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID) AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between DATEADD(YYYY,-5, @AsOnDate) and @AsOnDate ) DT GROUP BY DT.ItemCategoryID,DT.CategoryName, DT.YY Order by FiscalYear desc

data.name: Query_DISaleInvoice
data.value: SELECT Row_Number() OVER ( PARTITION BY tab.InvoiceID ORDER BY tab.InvoiceID ASC ) AS RowNo , TAB.CompanyID , TAB.InvoiceTypeNumber, TAB.InvoiceType , TAB.InvoiceID , TAB.InvoiceDate , TAB.DESCRIPTION , TAB.InvoiceNumber , TAB.SupplierName , TAB.SupplierAddress , TAB.SupplierNTN , TAB.SupplierSTRN , TAB.SupplierPhoneNumber , TAB.billedtoid , TAB.BIllTo , TAB.CustomerName , TAB.CustomerAddress , TAB.CustomerNTN , TAB.CustomerPhoneNumber , TAB.CustomeSTRN , TAB.ItemDescription , TAB.Narration , TAB.TaxAmount , TAB.Amount , TAB.TaxPayable , TAB.TotalAmount , TAB.LogoImage , TAB.Shipto , TAB.Tax , TAB.GrandTotal , TAB.SINumber FROM ( SELECT Row_Number() OVER ( PARTITION BY SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID ORDER BY SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID ASC ) AS RowNo , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID , Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID as InvoiceTypeNumber, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType AS InvoiceType , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceDate , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].Description , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceNumber , SET_Business.BusinessName + ' ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS SupplierName , DocumentTypesGroup.Comments AS SupplierAddress , SET_OperatingUnit.NTNNumber AS SupplierNTN , SET_OperatingUnit.SalesTaxNumber AS SupplierSTRN , SET_Business.PhoneNumber AS SupplierPhoneNumber , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid , BILLTo.CustomerName AS BIllTo , AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName , AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 AS CustomerAddress , AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber AS CustomerNTN , AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber AS CustomerPhoneNumber , AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber AS CustomeSTRN , Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.DocumentReference AS ItemDescription , [Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].Narration --,Abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity]) AS [BaseQuantity] --,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice , ( CASE WHEN [Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].DocumentReference LIKE '%[%]%' THEN REPLACE([Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].DocumentReference, '%', '') ELSE '' END ) AS [TaxAmount] , ( CASE WHEN [Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].Narration LIKE '%discount%' THEN [Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].Amount * -1 ELSE [Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].Amount END ) Amount , ( ISNULL([Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].Amount, 0) * ( CASE WHEN [Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].DocumentReference LIKE '%[%]%' THEN CAST(REPLACE([Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].DocumentReference, '%', '') AS FLOAT) ELSE '' END ) / 100 ) AS TaxPayable , [Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].Amount + ( ISNULL([Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].[Amount], 0) * ISNULL(( CASE WHEN [Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].DocumentReference LIKE '%[%]%' THEN CAST(REPLACE([Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].DocumentReference, '%', '') AS FLOAT) ELSE '' END ), 0) ) / 100 AS TotalAmount , SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage AS LogoImage , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerAddress AS Shipto , [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount AS Tax , ( SELECT --Sum(Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Amount) SUM(( CASE WHEN [Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN [Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].Amount * -1 ELSE [Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].Amount END )) Amount FROM [SAL_InvoiceHeader] Sal_total INNER JOIN Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail ON Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = Sal_total.InvoiceID AND Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = Sal_total.CompanyID AND Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = Sal_total.PeriodID INNER JOIN Set_PeriodCustom ON Sal_total.InvoiceDate BETWEEN Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate AND Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate AND Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 AND Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID WHERE Sal_total.InvoiceID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID AND Sal_total.[Status] = 1 AND ( Sal_total.[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID IS NULL ) AND ( Sal_total.[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID IS NULL ) AND ( [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerID = @CustomerID OR @CustomerID IS NULL ) {0} ) AS GrandTotal , ( CASE WHEN Set_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%CSP%' THEN SUBSTRING(GroupName, 1, 1) + 'SB' + '-' + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), YEAR(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)), 3, 2) + '000' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(24), SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) WHEN DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName = 'Head Office-KHI' THEN 'K' + 'SI' + '-' + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), YEAR(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)), 3, 2) + '000' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(24), SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) WHEN DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName = NULL THEN ' ' + 'SI' + '-' + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), YEAR(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)), 3, 2) + '000' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(24), SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) ELSE SUBSTRING(GroupName, 1, 1) + 'SI' + '-' + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), YEAR(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)), 3, 2) + '000' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(24), SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) END ) AS SINumber FROM [SAL_InvoiceHeader] INNER JOIN Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail ON Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID AND Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID INNER JOIN Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail ON Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID AND Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer BILLTo ON BILLTo.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid AND BILLTo.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND BILLTo.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId AND SET_Business.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN Set_DocumentType ON Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN DocumentTypesGroup ON DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID --AND -- Tax Amount LEFT JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] ON [SAL_InvoiceDetail].InvoiceHeaderID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].Status=1 INNER JOIN Set_PeriodCustom ON [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceDate BETWEEN Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate AND Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate AND Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 AND Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID WHERE [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[Status] = 1 AND ( [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID IS NULL ) AND ( [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID IS NULL ) AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber BETWEEN @InvoiceFrom AND @InvoiceTo AND [Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].Narration NOT LIKE '%[%]%' AND ( Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID = @CustomerID OR @CustomerID IS NULL ) {0} ) TAB GROUP BY TAB.CompanyID , TAB.InvoiceTypeNumber, TAB.InvoiceType , TAB.InvoiceID , TAB.InvoiceDate , TAB.DESCRIPTION , TAB.InvoiceNumber , TAB.SupplierName , TAB.SupplierAddress , TAB.SupplierNTN , TAB.SupplierSTRN , TAB.SupplierPhoneNumber, TAB.billedtoid , TAB.BIllTo , TAB.CustomerName , TAB.CustomerAddress , TAB.CustomerNTN , TAB.CustomerPhoneNumber , TAB.CustomeSTRN , TAB.ItemDescription , TAB.Narration , TAB.TaxAmount , TAB.Amount , TAB.TaxPayable , TAB.TotalAmount , TAB.LogoImage , TAB.Shipto , TAB.Tax , TAB.GrandTotal , TAB.SINumber SELECT Row_Number() OVER ( PARTITION BY tab.InvoiceID ORDER BY tab.InvoiceID ASC ) AS RowNo , * FROM ( -- amount Query SELECT [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceType , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID , 'Total' AS AmountType , SUM(( CASE WHEN [Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN [Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].Amount * -1 ELSE [Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].Amount END )) AS Amount , '' AS Narration FROM [SAL_InvoiceHeader] INNER JOIN Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail ON Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID AND Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID AND Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Status=1 INNER JOIN Set_PeriodCustom ON [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceDate BETWEEN Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate AND Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate AND Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 AND Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID WHERE [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[Status] = 1 AND ( [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID IS NULL ) AND ( [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID IS NULL ) AND [Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].Narration NOT LIKE '%[%]%' AND ( [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerID IS NULL) {0} GROUP BY [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceType , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID , Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Narration UNION ALL SELECT [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceType , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID , ' ' AS AmountType , SUM(( CASE WHEN [Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN [Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].Amount * -1 ELSE [Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].Amount END )) AS Amount , Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Narration FROM [SAL_InvoiceHeader] INNER JOIN Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail ON Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID AND Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID AND Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Status=1 INNER JOIN Set_PeriodCustom ON [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceDate BETWEEN Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate AND Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate AND Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 AND Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID WHERE [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[Status] = 1 AND ( [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID IS NULL ) AND ( [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID IS NULL ) AND ( [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerID IS NOT NULL) {0} GROUP BY [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceType , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID , Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Narration ) AS TAb

SET_Company.CompanyId = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId AND SET_Business.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN Set_DocumentType ON Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN DocumentTypesGroup ON DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID AND -- Tax Amount LEFT JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] ON [SAL_InvoiceDetail].InvoiceHeaderID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].Status=1 INNER JOIN Set_PeriodCustom ON [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceDate BETWEEN Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate AND Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate AND Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 AND Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID WHERE [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[Status] = 1 AND ( [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID IS NULL ) AND ( [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID IS NULL ) AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber BETWEEN @InvoiceFrom AND @InvoiceTo and ([Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].Narration NOT LIKE '%[%]%' or [Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].Narration LIKE '%Sindh%') AND ( Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID = @CustomerID OR @CustomerID IS NULL ) {0} ) TAB GROUP BY TAB.CompanyID , TAB.InvoiceTypeNumber, TAB.InvoiceType , TAB.InvoiceID , TAB.InvoiceDate , TAB.DESCRIPTION , TAB.InvoiceNumber , TAB.SupplierName , TAB.SupplierAddress , TAB.SupplierNTN , TAB.SupplierSTRN , TAB.SupplierPhoneNumber, TAB.billedtoid , TAB.BIllTo , TAB.CustomerName , TAB.CustomerAddress , TAB.CustomerNTN , TAB.CustomerPhoneNumber , TAB.CustomeSTRN , TAB.ItemDescription , TAB.Narration , TAB.TaxAmount , TAB.Amount , TAB.TaxPayable , TAB.TotalAmount , TAB.LogoImage , TAB.Shipto , TAB.Tax , TAB.GrandTotal , TAB.SINumber SELECT Row_Number() OVER ( PARTITION BY tab.InvoiceID ORDER BY tab.InvoiceID ASC ) AS RowNo , * FROM ( -- amount Query SELECT [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceType , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID , 'Total' AS AmountType , SUM(( CASE WHEN [Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN [Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].Amount * -1 ELSE [Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].Amount END )) AS Amount , '' AS Narration FROM [SAL_InvoiceHeader] INNER JOIN Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail ON Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID AND Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID AND Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Status=1 INNER JOIN Set_PeriodCustom ON [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceDate BETWEEN Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate AND Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate AND Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 AND Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID WHERE [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[Status] = 1 AND ( [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID IS NULL ) AND ( [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID IS NULL ) and ([Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].Narration NOT LIKE '%[%]%' or [Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].Narration LIKE '%Sindh%') AND ( [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerID IS NULL) {0} GROUP BY [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceType , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID , Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Narration UNION ALL SELECT [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceType , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID , ' ' AS AmountType , SUM(( CASE WHEN [Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN [Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].Amount * -1 ELSE [Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail].Amount END )) AS Amount , Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Narration FROM [SAL_InvoiceHeader] INNER JOIN Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail ON Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID AND Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID AND Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Status=1 INNER JOIN Set_PeriodCustom ON [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceDate BETWEEN Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate AND Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate AND Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 AND Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID WHERE [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[Status] = 1 AND ( [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID IS NULL ) AND ( [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID IS NULL ) AND ( [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerID IS NOT NULL) {0} GROUP BY [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceType , [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID , Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Narration ) AS TAb

data.name: Query_getCalculatedAmount
data.value:
Select --SUM(SaleTaxAmount)SaleTaxAmount,
case when isnull((select top 1 isnull(WithFED,0) from AP_AdvanceSugarPayment where status = 1 and DocumentNo = tab.AdvTaxInvoiceNo and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.BrokerID = tab.BrokerID order by RecievingDate desc),0) = 1 then (SUM(GrossAmount) - SUM(SaleTaxAmount) ) * isnull((select top 1 isnull(SaleTaxPercent,0) from AP_AdvanceSugarPayment where status = 1 and DocumentNo = tab.AdvTaxInvoiceNo and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.BrokerID = tab.BrokerID order by RecievingDate desc),18) / 100 else (SUM(GrossAmount) - SUM(SaleTaxAmount) - SUM(FixFedAmont)) * isnull((select top 1 isnull(SaleTaxPercent,0) from AP_AdvanceSugarPayment where status = 1 and DocumentNo = tab.AdvTaxInvoiceNo and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.BrokerID = tab.BrokerID order by RecievingDate desc),18) / 100 end as SaleTaxAmount,
SUM(WithHoldingAmount)WithHoldingAmount,InvoiceID,(QuantityInvoiced)QuantityInvoiced,CustomerID,SUM(ExciseDutyActualAmount)ExciseDutyActualAmount ,InvoiceDetailID from ( SELECT Distinct SAL_ContractHeader.AdvTaxInvoiceNo, [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType as InvoiceType ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].InvoiceDetailID , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as ExciseDutyActualAmount ,CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate > '2019-07-01' AND SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG > 70.2 AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' ) THEN ( ( ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * ( SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + ( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) THEN 3.60 ELSE 0 END ) ) )) ) - ( ( ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * ( SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + ( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) THEN 3.60 ELSE 0 END ) ) ) ) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) / ( 100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / ( 100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount ) ELSE ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / 100 ) END as SaleTaxAmount ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].FEDFixRate,0) as FixFedAmont ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced as GrossAmount , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced , SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SalesTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding as WithHoldingTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as ExciseDutyAmountTaxPer ,((isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount,0)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0)) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100 as TaxPayable ,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount + ((isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount,0)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0)) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0) as TotalAmount ,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount, [SAL_InvoiceDetail].InvoiceHeaderID,StockHeaderID,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerID ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].BrokerID FROM [SAL_InvoiceHeader] INNER JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] On [SAL_InvoiceDetail].InvoiceHeaderID =[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].CompanyID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].PeriodID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].ItemID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID Left JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID left join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1 left join [SAL_OrderDetail] on [SAL_OrderDetail].OrderID =SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 And SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID left JOIN INV_SET_Category On INV_SET_Category.CategoryID =INV_Item.ItemTypeID --AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID =INV_Item.CompanyID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer BC ON BC.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer Brokername ON Brokername.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And left JOin SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.uomId=[SAL_InvoiceDetail].ItemUnitID And SET_UnitofMeasure.status=1
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
WHERE [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[Status] = 1 AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID is null) and [SAL_InvoiceDetail].InvoiceHeaderID = @InvoiceHeaderID
) as tab
group by InvoiceID,CustomerID,QuantityInvoiced,InvoiceDetailID,CustomerID,BrokerID,AdvTaxInvoiceNo

data.name: Query_GetCustomerSaleLedger
data.value: Select * from ( Select TAB.CustomerID , TAB.Name as CustomerName , '' as InvoiceDate , 0 as InvoiceNumber , '' as LotNo , '' as ColorName ,'' as FabricName , 0 as FabricWeight , 0 as Rate , '' as ChequeNo , 0 as SaleAmount , 0 as Receive ,sum(TAB.Amount) as Opening from ( select * from ( select 'Opening' AS DocumentType, @FromDate AS CreateDate, TABopening.CustomerID, TABopening.Name, -1 AS SourceID, SUM(TABopening.Amount) as Amount, '' AS InstrumentNo, '' Comments, '' AS InvoiceNumbers, '' AS InvoiceDocumentNo, '' AS DocumentNo, @FromDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 AS ForAlhajAmount , TABopening.StatusCode from ( SELECT FINTAB.DocumentType, Fintab.CreateDate, FINTAB.CustomerID, FINTAB.Name, FinTab.SourceID, SUM(FINTAB.Amount) as Amount, FINTAB.InstrumentNo, FINTAB.Comments, FINTAB.InvoiceNumbers, FINTAB.InvoiceDocumentNo, FINTAB.DocumentNo, FINTAB.DocumentDate, FINTAB.FreightAmount, FINTAB.ForAlhajAmount , FINTAB.StatusCode FROM ( Select 'Opening' as DocumentType, @FromDate AS CreateDate, openingTAB.CustomerID, openingTAB.Name, -1 AS SourceID, sum(openingTAB.Amount) as Amount, '' as InstrumentNo, '' as Comments, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, '' as DocumentNo, @FromDate as DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount , openingTAB.StatusCode From ( ---------- OPENING BALANCE VENDOR INVOICE ---------- SELECT 0 as Amount, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS Name, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptCustomerID as SourceID ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 --AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail on AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Status = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode LEFT Join AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail on AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.Status = 1 INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate And SET_DocumentType.status = 1 GROUP BY AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptCustomerID,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode ) OpeningTAB GROUP BY OpeningTAB.CustomerID ,OpeningTAB.Name,OpeningTAB.StatusCode UNION ALL select distinct TABInvoice.DocumentType, TABInvoice.CreateDate, TABInvoice.CustomerID, TABInvoice.BusinessPartnerName, TABInvoice.SourceID, TABInvoice.Amount, TABInvoice.InstrumentNo, TABInvoice.Comments, TABInvoice.InvoiceNumbers, TABInvoice.InvoiceDocumentNo, TABInvoice.DocumentNo, TABInvoice.DocumentDate, TABInvoice.FreightAmount, TABInvoice.ForAlhajAmount ,TABInvoice.StatusCode from ( SELECT distinct AR_InvoiceHeader.companyID, Set_DocumentType.TransactionType, case when AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode is null then ( select top 1 CUS.TypeCode from AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.BusinessPartnerID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID = CUS.TypeCode And AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 ) else AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode end as TypeCode, case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then ( select CUS.CustomerID from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 And CUS.Status= 1 ) else ( select CUS.CustomerID from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceHeader.Status= 1 And CUS.Status= 1 ) end as CustomerID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then ( select CUS.CustomerName from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status= 1 And CUS.Status= 1 ) else ( select CUS.CustomerName from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceHeader.Status= 1 And CUS.Status= 1 ) end as BusinessPartnerName, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceSupplierID as SourceID, case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then (Case when AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount else AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount * -1 end) else ( Case when AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Debit Note' then AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid else (AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid+AR_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount - isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.OtherAmount,0)) * -1 end ) end as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.Description AS Comments, AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, 0) AS DocumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount ,AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ASCUS ON AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = ASCUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = ASCUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = ASCUS.PeriodID AND ASCUS.Status = 1 left JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.vENDORid AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @companyId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate < @FromDate And SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 --and SET_DocumentType.documenttype not like '%Opening%' ) TABInvoice where TABInvoice.companyID = @companyId UNION ALL ---------- Payment ---------- SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID as SourceID, (Case AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount else AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount * -1 end) as Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo AS InstrumentNo, IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, '') + (Case When AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments IS NULL Then '' Else ' ' + AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments End) AS Comments, case when AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID is null then (ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FROM AP_PaymentHeader childPayment LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = childPayment.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = childPayment.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = childPayment.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 where childPayment.PaymentID = payment.PaymentID and childPayment.CompanyID = payment.CompanyID and childPayment.PeriodID = payment.PeriodID And childPayment.Status = 1 ORDER BY AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceNumbers FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment where payment.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, SAL_DiscountTransactionHeader.DiscountTransactionHeaderID as SourceID, (SAL_DiscountTransactionHeader.CalculatedAmount * -1) as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, '' AS Comments, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(SAL_DiscountTransactionHeader.DiscountTransactionHeaderID, 0) AS DocumentNo, SAL_DiscountTransactionHeader.RunDateTime AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount , 1 as StatusCode FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN SAL_DiscountTransactionHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_DiscountTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_DiscountTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DiscountTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And SAL_DiscountTransactionHeader.Status= 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON SAL_DiscountTransactionHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND SAL_DiscountTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND SAL_DiscountTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_DiscountTransactionHeader.RunDateTime < @FromDate And SET_DocumentType.status= 1 ) AS FINTAB GROUP BY DocumentType, CreateDate, CustomerID, NAME, SourceID, InstrumentNo, Comments, InvoiceNumbers, InvoiceDocumentNo, DocumentNo, DocumentDate, FreightAmount, ForAlhajAmount , StatusCode ) as TABopening -- For Transation type Filter GROUP BY TABopening.CustomerID, TABopening.Name,TABopening.StatusCode ) as FinalTAB where FinalTAB.Amount <> 0 --Order By DocumentDate ) as Tab {2} group by TAB.CustomerID , TAB.Name Union all Select distinct SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber ,Fabrics_SAL_InvoiceDetail.LotNo ,Set_Color.ColorName, SET_Fabric.FabricName ,Fabrics_CustomerChallanInfo.TotalWeight as FabricWeight ,isnull(Sum (Fabrics_SAL_InvoiceProcessRates.Rate),0) as Rate ,'' as ChequeNo ,round((SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid + (SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid * Fabrics_SAL_InvoiceDetail.FurtherTax / 100)),2) as SaleAmount ,0 as Receive , 0 as Opening from SAL_InvoiceHeader Inner Join Fabrics_SAL_InvoiceDetail on Fabrics_SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID Inner Join Fabrics_CustomerChallanInfo on Fabrics_CustomerChallanInfo.Lotno = Fabrics_SAL_InvoiceDetail.LotNo Left Join Set_Color on Set_Color.ColorID = Fabrics_CustomerChallanInfo.ColorID Left Join SET_Fabric on SET_Fabric.FabricID = Fabrics_CustomerChallanInfo.FabricTypeID left Join Fabrics_SAL_InvoiceProcessRates on Fabrics_SAL_InvoiceProcessRates.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID Left Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID Where SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status=1 {0} {1} Group By AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate,Fabrics_SAL_InvoiceDetail.LotNo ,Set_Color.ColorName, SET_Fabric.FabricName ,Fabrics_CustomerChallanInfo.TotalWeight ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid ,Fabrics_SAL_InvoiceDetail.FurtherTax union all select ar_receipttransactionHEader.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, DocumentDate as InvoiceDate,ar_receipttransactionHEader.documentNO as InvoiceNumber ,'' as Lotno ,'' as ColorName, '' as FabricName ,0 as FabricWeight ,0 as Rate ,DocumentReference as ChequeNo ,0 as SaleAmount ,AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.Amount as Receive , 0 as Opening from ar_receipttransactionHEader inner join AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail on AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = ar_receipttransactionHEader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' and AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID = '03-02-06-02-004'-- 02-02-04-01-002 Left Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = ar_receipttransactionHEader.CustomerID where invoiceFor = 'SRO' AND ar_receipttransactionHEader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND ar_receipttransactionHEader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND convert(date,ar_receipttransactionHEader.DocumentDate) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate and ar_receipttransactionHEader.Status = 1 {1} union all select ar_receipttransactionHEader.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, DocumentDate as InvoiceDate,ar_receipttransactionHEader.documentNO as InvoiceNumber ,'' as Lotno ,'' as ColorName, '' as FabricName ,0 as FabricWeight ,0 as Rate ,DocumentReference as ChequeNo ,0 as SaleAmount ,AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.Amount as Receive , 0 as Opening from ar_receipttransactionHEader inner join AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail on AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = ar_receipttransactionHEader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' and AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID = '03-02-04-05-005' Left Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = ar_receipttransactionHEader.CustomerID where invoiceFor = 'InComeTAX' AND ar_receipttransactionHEader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND ar_receipttransactionHEader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and ar_receipttransactionHEader.Status = 1 AND convert(date,ar_receipttransactionHEader.DocumentDate) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate {1} union all select ar_receipttransactionHEader.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, DocumentDate as InvoiceDate,ar_receipttransactionHEader.documentNO as InvoiceNumber ,'' as Lotno ,'' as ColorName, '' as FabricName ,0 as FabricWeight ,0 as Rate ,InstrumentNo as ChequeNo ,0 as SaleAmount ,AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Amount as Receive , 0 as Opening from ar_receipttransactionHEader inner join AR_ReceiptBanksDetail on AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = ar_receipttransactionHEader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Status = 1 Left Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = ar_receipttransactionHEader.CustomerID where invoiceFor = 'Customer' AND ar_receipttransactionHEader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND ar_receipttransactionHEader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and ar_receipttransactionHEader.Status = 1 AND convert(date,ar_receipttransactionHEader.DocumentDate) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate {1} union all select ar_receipttransactionHEader.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, DocumentDate as InvoiceDate,ar_receipttransactionHEader.documentNO as InvoiceNumber ,'' as Lotno ,'' as ColorName, '' as FabricName ,0 as FabricWeight ,0 as Rate ,'' as ChequeNo ,0 as SaleAmount ,AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.Amount as Receive , 0 as Opening from ar_receipttransactionHEader inner join AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail on AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = ar_receipttransactionHEader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.Status = 1 Left Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = ar_receipttransactionHEader.CustomerID where invoiceFor = 'Customer' AND ar_receipttransactionHEader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND ar_receipttransactionHEader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and ar_receipttransactionHEader.Status = 1 AND convert(date,ar_receipttransactionHEader.DocumentDate) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate {1} union all select AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, DocumentDate as InvoiceDate,ar_receipttransactionHEader.documentNO as InvoiceNumber ,'' as Lotno ,'' as ColorName, '' as FabricName ,0 as FabricWeight ,0 as Rate ,'' as ChequeNo ,0 as SaleAmount ,AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail .Amount as Receive , 0 as Opening from ar_receipttransactionHEader inner join AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail on AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = ar_receipttransactionHEader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Status = 1 Left Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID where ar_receipttransactionHEader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND ar_receipttransactionHEader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND convert(date,ar_receipttransactionHEader.DocumentDate) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate and ar_receipttransactionHEader.Documenttypeid<>21 and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' and ar_receipttransactionHEader.Status = 1 {1} union all select AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, DocumentDate as InvoiceDate,ar_receipttransactionHEader.documentNO as InvoiceNumber ,'' as Lotno ,'' as ColorName, '' as FabricName ,0 as FabricWeight ,0 as Rate ,'' as ChequeNo ,AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount as SaleAmount ,0 as Receive , 0 as Opening from ar_receipttransactionHEader inner join AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail on AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = ar_receipttransactionHEader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Status = 1 Left Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID where ar_receipttransactionHEader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND ar_receipttransactionHEader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND convert(date,ar_receipttransactionHEader.DocumentDate) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate and ar_receipttransactionHEader.Documenttypeid<>21 and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' and ar_receipttransactionHEader.Status = 1 {1} union all select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, DocumentDate as InvoiceDate,Ap_PaymentHeader.DocumentNO as InvoiceNumber ,'' as Lotno ,'' as ColorName, '' as FabricName ,0 as FabricWeight ,0 as Rate ,'' as ChequeNo ,AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount as SaleAmount ,0 as Receive , 0 as Opening from Ap_PaymentHeader inner join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = Ap_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status = 1 inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID where Ap_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND Ap_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND convert(date,Ap_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' and Ap_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 {1} union all select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, DocumentDate as InvoiceDate,Ap_PaymentHeader.DocumentNO as InvoiceNumber ,'' as Lotno ,'' as ColorName, '' as FabricName ,0 as FabricWeight ,0 as Rate ,'' as ChequeNo ,0 as SaleAmount ,AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount as Receive , 0 as Opening from Ap_PaymentHeader inner join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = Ap_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status = 1 inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID where Ap_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND Ap_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND convert(date,Ap_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' and Ap_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 {1} ) as Tab1 Order By Tab1.CustomerID, Tab1.CustomerName ,Tab1.InvoiceNumber asc

data.value: SELECT SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo, [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[InvoiceDetailID], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID], Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end as [UnitQuantity], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[InvoiceHeaderID], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[AccountingDate], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[ActualPostedFlag], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[Amount], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[AmountIncludesTaxFlag], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[AssetsTrackingFlag], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[AWHTaxFlag], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[AWHTaxGrossAmount], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[AWHTaxGroupID], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[AWHTaxInvoiceID], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[AWHTaxInvoicePaymentID], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[AWHTaxRateID], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[BaseAmount], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[BaseInvoicePriceVariance], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[BaseQuantityVariance], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[BatchID], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CashPostedFlag], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CountryOfSupply], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CreditCardTransactionID], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[DiscountAmountTaken], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[DistributionCodeCombinationID], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[DistributionLineNumber], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[DistributionMatchType], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[EncumberedFlag], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[ExchangeDate], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[ExchangeRate], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[ExchangeRateType], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[ExchangeRateVariance], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[FinalMatchFlag], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[GrossAmount], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[InvoicePriceVariance], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[MatchStatusFlag], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[MatchedUOMType], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PurchaseOrderDistributionID], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PostedFlag], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PrepayAmountRemaining], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PriceVarianceCodeCombinationID], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[QuantityInvoiced], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[QuantityVariance], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[RateVarianceCodeCombinationID], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[ReceiptTransactionID], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[ReceiptMissingFlag], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[ReceiptRequiredFlag], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[ReceiptVerifiedFlag], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[ReversalFlag], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[SerialNumber], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[IsExciseDutyExempted], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[ExciseDutyAmount], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[IsFEDExempted], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[FEDAmount], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAutoCalculatedFlag], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[UnitPrice], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[Status], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CreatedBy], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CreateDate], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CreatedByValue], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[UpdatedBy], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[UpdateDate], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[UpdatedByValue], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[ItemCategoryID], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[ItemID], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[Inclusive], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[ItemUnitID] AS [ItemUnitOfMeasureID], [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo], [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryName], [INV_Item].[Description] AS [ItemDescription], [INV_Item].[ListPricePerUnit], [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMName], Abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity]) AS [BaseQuantity], [SAL_InvoiceDetail].VehicleID AS DOVehicleInformationID, [SAL_DOVehicleInformation].[Chassis], '' [Action], INV_StockTransactionDetail.SerialNo ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].[Description],Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName ,ISNULL([SAL_InvoiceDetail].FEDFixRate,0) as FEDFixRate FROM [SAL_InvoiceDetail] INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID Left JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID Left JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[ItemCategoryID] --AND [INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[ItemID] --AND [INV_Item].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[ItemUnitID] AND [SET_UnitofMeasure].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN [SAL_DOVehicleInformation] ON [SAL_DOVehicleInformation].[DOVehicleInformationID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[VehicleID] AND [SAL_DOVehicleInformation].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DOVehicleInformation].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] WHERE [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[InvoiceHeaderID] = @InvoiceHeaderID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[Status] = 1 ORDER BY [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[SerialNumber]

SELECT SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo, SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID, SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID, SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID, SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID, Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end as UnitQuantity, SAL_InvoiceDetail.AccountingDate, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ActualPostedFlag, SAL_InvoiceDetail.Amount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.AmountIncludesTaxFlag, SAL_InvoiceDetail.AssetsTrackingFlag, SAL_InvoiceDetail.AWHTaxFlag, SAL_InvoiceDetail.AWHTaxGrossAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.AWHTaxGroupID, SAL_InvoiceDetail.AWHTaxInvoiceID, SAL_InvoiceDetail.AWHTaxInvoicePaymentID, SAL_InvoiceDetail.AWHTaxRateID, SAL_InvoiceDetail.BaseAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.CreditCardTransactionID, SAL_InvoiceDetail.DiscountAmountTaken, SAL_InvoiceDetail.DistributionCodeCombinationID, SAL_InvoiceDetail.DistributionLineNumber, SAL_InvoiceDetail.DistributionMatchType, SAL_InvoiceDetail.EncumberedFlag, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExchangeDate, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExchangeRate, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExchangeRateType, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExchangeRateVariance, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FinalMatchFlag, SAL_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoicePriceVariance, SAL_InvoiceDetail.MatchStatusFlag, SAL_InvoiceDetail.MatchedUOMType, SAL_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderDistributionID, SAL_InvoiceDetail.PostedFlag, SAL_InvoiceDetail.PrepayAmountRemaining, SAL_InvoiceDetail.PriceVarianceCodeCombinationID, SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced, SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityVariance, SAL_InvoiceDetail.RateVarianceCodeCombinationID, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ReceiptTransactionID, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ReceiptMissingFlag, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ReceiptRequiredFlag, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ReceiptVerifiedFlag, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ReversalFlag, SAL_InvoiceDetail.IsFEDExempted, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAutoCalculatedFlag, SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice, SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status, SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID, SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID, SAL_InvoiceDetail.CreatedBy, SAL_InvoiceDetail.CreateDate, SAL_InvoiceDetail.CreatedByValue, SAL_InvoiceDetail.UpdatedBy, SAL_InvoiceDetail.UpdateDate, SAL_InvoiceDetail.UpdatedByValue, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemCategoryID, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID, (select Case when SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive is NULL then 0 else SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive end) as Inclusive, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID AS ItemUnitOfMeasureID, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_Item.Description AS ItemDescription, INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName,
-- Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)
Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID )
AS BaseQuantity, SAL_InvoiceDetail.VehicleID AS DOVehicleInformationID, '' As Chassis, '' [Action], SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as RetailPrice, SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID, SAL_InvoiceDetail.withholding, SAL_InvoiceDetail.VehicleID, '' as VehicleName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID ,ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) as T_Rate ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.GovtLevisAmount,SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxonGovtLevis, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FurtherTaxonGovtLevis,SAL_InvoiceDetail.FCRate,SAL_InvoiceDetail.FCAmount, SAL_ContractHeader.ConversionRate as SOConversionRate,[SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate as SaleOrderDate ,SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate as SaleContractDate ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate ,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG,ISNULL(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive,0)FreightDetail ,SAL_ContractHeader.DTRENo,isnull(SAL_InvoiceDetail.LossInTransitQty,0) as LossInTransitQty ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.FCRate,SAL_InvoiceDetail.FCAmount ,SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate as ContractDate FROM SAL_InvoiceDetail LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_DispatchHeader ON SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[FiscalID] AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1 Left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 Left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID --Left JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID -- AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID -- AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.[Status] = 1
LEft JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND [SAL_OrderDetail].OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND [SAL_OrderDetail].CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND [SAL_OrderDetail].PeriodID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND [SAL_OrderDetail].Status = 1
LEft JOIN [SAL_ContractDetail] ON [SAL_ContractDetail].ContractDetailID = [SAL_OrderDetail].ContractDetailID AND [SAL_ContractDetail].ContractID = [SAL_OrderDetail].ContractHeaderID AND [SAL_ContractDetail].CompanyID = [SAL_OrderDetail].CompanyID AND [SAL_ContractDetail].PeriodID= [SAL_OrderDetail].PeriodID AND [SAL_ContractDetail].Status = 1
inner Join [SAL_OrderHeader] on [SAL_OrderHeader].OrderID= SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID AND [SAL_OrderHeader].CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND [SAL_OrderHeader].PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID --AND [SAL_OrderHeader].FiscalID = SAL_OrderDetail.FiscalID AND [SAL_OrderHeader].Status=1 Left Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = [SAL_ContractDetail].ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = [SAL_ContractDetail].CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.FiscalID = [SAL_ContractDetail].FiscalID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = [SAL_ContractDetail].PeriodID and SAL_ContractHeader.Status =1 and SAL_ContractHeader.StatusCode = 1
--inner join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID --and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID --and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID --and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID --and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID --and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
--inner join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID --and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID --and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID --and SAL_ContractHeader.Status = 1 --and SAL_ContractHeader.StatusCode = 1
LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemCategoryID AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_SET_Category.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID AND SET_UnitofMeasure.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID WHERE SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = @InvoiceHeaderID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID= @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.[Status] = 1 ORDER BY SAL_InvoiceDetail.SerialNumber

--INV_StockTransactionDetail.SerialNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status, --INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreatedBy, SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then [SAL_ContractDetail].ItemID else StockItem.ItemID ENd as ItemID, --Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then INV_Item.Description else StockItem.Description ENd as [Description], INV_StockTransactionDetail.SerialNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreatedBy, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreatedByValue, INV_StockTransactionDetail.UpdatedBy, INV_StockTransactionDetail.UpdateDate,
