SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID else StockItem.ItemID ENd as ItemID, Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then INV_Item.Description else StockItem.Description ENd as Description, --ISNULL([SAL_ContractDetail].[Rate],0) as Rate, Case when (SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 and SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate is null) then ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate],SAL_OrderDetail.[T_Rate]) / (1 + (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount, 0) + ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount, 0) + ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, 0)) / 100) else --INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost SAL_OrderDetail.Rate ENd * (Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID =ISNULL(INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode,StockItem.VolumeUOMCode) then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = ISNULL(INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,StockItem.WeightUOMCode) then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end) as Rate,
--ISNULL([SAL_ContractDetail].[Rate],0) as RetailPrice, -- Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 and SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate is null then --ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate],SAL_OrderDetail.[T_Rate]) else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost ENd -- * (Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 -- when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = ISNULL(INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode,StockItem.VolumeUOMCode) then ISNULL(StockItem.UnitVolume, 1) -- when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = ISNULL(INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,StockItem.WeightUOMCode) then ISNULL(StockItem.UnitWeight, 1) end) Case when (SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 and SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate is null) then ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate],SAL_OrderDetail.[T_Rate]) / (1 + (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount, 0) + ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount, 0) + ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, 0)) / 100) else --INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost SAL_OrderDetail.Rate ENd * (Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID =ISNULL(INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode,StockItem.VolumeUOMCode) then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = ISNULL(INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,StockItem.WeightUOMCode) then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end) as RetailPrice,
-- Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 --then (Case when [SAL_ContractDetail].ItemUnitID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) -- then (ISNULL([SAL_ContractDetail].[Rate],[SAL_ContractDetail].[T_Rate]) * Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) -- when [SAL_ContractDetail].ItemUnitID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then (ISNULL([SAL_ContractDetail].[Rate],[SAL_ContractDetail].[T_Rate]) * ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) -- * Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) -- when [SAL_ContractDetail].ItemUnitID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then (ISNULL([SAL_ContractDetail].[Rate],[SAL_ContractDetail].[T_Rate]) * ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) -- * Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) end) -- else ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity*INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost ) End as BaseAmount, Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then (Case when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.[Rate],[SAL_OrderDetail].[T_Rate]) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end) * Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.[Rate],[SAL_OrderDetail].[T_Rate]) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end) * ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) * Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.[Rate],[SAL_OrderDetail].[T_Rate]) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end) * ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) * Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) end) else ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * (INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) ) End as BaseAmount,
--[SAL_ContractDetail].[GrossAmount] as GrossAmount, Case when ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive, 0) = 1 then ( Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then ( ( (ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate],SAL_OrderDetail.[T_Rate]) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) * ( Case when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1)) when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1)) end ) * ( Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ) - ( (ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate],SAL_OrderDetail.[T_Rate]) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) * ( Case when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1)) when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1)) end ) * ( Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0)) )*(isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount,0))/(100+isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount,0))
- ( (ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate],SAL_OrderDetail.[T_Rate]) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) * ( Case when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1)) when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1)) end ) * ( Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0)) )*(isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount,0))/(100+isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount,0))
- ( (ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate],SAL_OrderDetail.[T_Rate]) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) * ( Case when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1)) when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1)) end ) * ( Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0)) )*(isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.WithHolding,0))/(100+isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.WithHolding,0))
) else ( ( Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0) ) * (INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) ) End ) else ( case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 1 then ( ( Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0) ) * (INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) ) else ABS (( (case when [SAL_OrderDetail].[T_Rate] is null then ((ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[T_Rate],SAL_OrderDetail.[Rate]) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) / (1 + (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount, 0) + ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount, 0) + ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, 0)) / 100) else (ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[T_Rate],SAL_OrderDetail.[Rate]) + ((Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) end) * ( Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then as InvoiceAmount, AmountPaid - --Customer Advance isnull((select isnull(sum(Gl_transactionDetail.Amount),0) from Sal_invoiceHeader Sal inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = Sal.CustomerID inner join Gl_transactionHeader on Gl_transactionHeader.DocumentNo = Sal.invoicenumber and Gl_transactionHeader.CompanyID = Sal.CompanyID and Gl_transactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = Sal.invoiceType and Gl_transactionHeader.FiscalID = Sal.FiscalID and Gl_transactionHeader.CompanyID = Sal.CompanyID inner join Gl_transactionDetail on Gl_transactionDetail.TransactionID = Gl_transactionHeader.TransactionID and Gl_transactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID where AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = 16 and Sal.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID ),0) as ActualAmount, convert(decimal(18,9), AmountPaid ) -
(select cast(isnull(sum(isnull(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.amount,0)),0) as decimal) from SAL_InvoiceDetail SAL_InvoiceDetailinner inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail INV_StockTransactionDetailinner on INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetailinner.StockHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetailinner.StockDetailID and INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetailinner.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetailinner.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.Status = 1
inner join SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail SAL_DeliveryOrderDetailinner on SAL_DeliveryOrderDetailinner.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.SourceHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetailinner.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.SourceLineID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetailinner.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetailinner.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.PeriodID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetailinner.Status = 1
inner join SAL_OrderDetail SAL_OrderDetailinner on SAL_OrderDetailinner.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetailinner.SalesOrderHeaderID and SAL_OrderDetailinner.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetailinner.SalesOrderDetailID and SAL_OrderDetailinner.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetailinner.CompanyID and SAL_OrderDetailinner.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetailinner.PeriodID and SAL_OrderDetailinner.Status = 1
inner join SAL_ContractDetail SAL_ContractDetailinner on SAL_ContractDetailinner.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetailinner.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetailinner.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetailinner.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetailinner.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetailinner.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetailinner.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetailinner.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetailinner.Status = 1
inner join SAL_OrderHeader SAL_OrderHeaderinner on SAL_OrderHeaderinner.OrderID = SAL_OrderDetailinner.OrderID and SAL_OrderHeaderinner.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetailinner.CompanyID and SAL_OrderHeaderinner.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetailinner.PeriodID and SAL_OrderHeaderinner.Status = 1
inner join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner on AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.SourceHeaderID = SAL_ContractDetailinner.ContractID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.CompanyID = SAL_OrderHeaderinner.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeaderinner.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.Status = 1
inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.PeriodID
where SAL_InvoiceDetailinner.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceDetailinner.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%advance%'
) - ROUND(isnull(( select sum(AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.Amount) from AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail left join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader on AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID = AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.ReceiptHeaderID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.PeriodID where AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.Status = 1 --new and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalDate is null and ReversalComments is null ),0 ),0) as BalanceAmount, ROUND(
AmountPaid -
(select cast(isnull(sum(isnull(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.amount,0)),0) as decimal) from SAL_InvoiceDetail SAL_InvoiceDetailinner inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail INV_StockTransactionDetailinner on INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetailinner.StockHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetailinner.StockDetailID and INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetailinner.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetailinner.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.Status = 1
inner join SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail SAL_DeliveryOrderDetailinner on SAL_DeliveryOrderDetailinner.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.SourceHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetailinner.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.SourceLineID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetailinner.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetailinner.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.PeriodID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetailinner.Status = 1
inner join SAL_OrderDetail SAL_OrderDetailinner on SAL_OrderDetailinner.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetailinner.SalesOrderHeaderID and SAL_OrderDetailinner.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetailinner.SalesOrderDetailID and SAL_OrderDetailinner.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetailinner.CompanyID and SAL_OrderDetailinner.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetailinner.PeriodID and SAL_OrderDetailinner.Status = 1
inner join SAL_ContractDetail SAL_ContractDetailinner on SAL_ContractDetailinner.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetailinner.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetailinner.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetailinner.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetailinner.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetailinner.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetailinner.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetailinner.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetailinner.Status = 1
inner join SAL_OrderHeader SAL_OrderHeaderinner on SAL_OrderHeaderinner.OrderID = SAL_OrderDetailinner.OrderID and SAL_OrderHeaderinner.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetailinner.CompanyID and SAL_OrderHeaderinner.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetailinner.PeriodID and SAL_OrderHeaderinner.Status = 1
inner join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner on AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.SourceHeaderID = SAL_ContractDetailinner.ContractID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.CompanyID = SAL_OrderHeaderinner.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeaderinner.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.Status = 1
inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.PeriodID
where SAL_InvoiceDetailinner.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceDetailinner.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%advance%' ) - isnull(( select sum(AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.Amount) from AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail left join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader on AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID = AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.ReceiptHeaderID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.PeriodID where AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.Status = 1 --new and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalDate is null and ReversalComments is null),0 ),0) as Amount,'' as Action ,0 as ActualBalance
from SAL_InvoiceHeader left join SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].ItemID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1
Left JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID left join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1 left join [SAL_OrderDetail] on [SAL_OrderDetail].OrderID =SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 And SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
left JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerID
INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
where SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = @InvoiceID )as tab group by ReceiptInvoicesID,ReceiptHeaderID,InvoiceHeaderID,InvoiceNo,InvoiceDate,Action,ActualBalance
data.comment:
WITH cteAmount (InvoiceAmount) AS (
select
case SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive when 1 then --most probably sugar xase (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * case when COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) > 0 then COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) else ( (case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG else SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG end ) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)) end )))
else
(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * case when COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) > 0 then COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) else ( (case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG else SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG end ) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)) end ))) + (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * case when COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) > 0 then COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) else ( (case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG else SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG end ) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)) end ))) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / 100
end
as InvoiceAmount from SAL_InvoiceHeader left join SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].ItemID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = 19
Left JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID left join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1 left join [SAL_OrderDetail] on [SAL_OrderDetail].OrderID =SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 And SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
left JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerID
INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
where SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = @InvoiceID )
select ReceiptInvoicesID,ReceiptHeaderID,InvoiceHeaderID,InvoiceNo,InvoiceDate,sum(InvoiceAmount) as InvoiceAmount,sum(ActualAmount) as ActualAmount,sum(BalanceAmount) as BalanceAmount,sum(Amount) as Amount,Action ,ActualBalance from ( select distinct -1 as ReceiptInvoicesID, -1 as ReceiptHeaderID, InvoiceID as InvoiceHeaderID, InvoiceNumber as InvoiceNo,InvoiceDate, (select sum(InvoiceAmount) from cteAmount) - --Customer Advance isnull((select isnull(sum(Gl_transactionDetail.Amount),0) from Sal_invoiceHeader Sal inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = Sal.CustomerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = Sal.CompanyID inner join Gl_transactionHeader on Gl_transactionHeader.DocumentNo = Sal.invoicenumber and Gl_transactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = Sal.invoiceType and Gl_transactionHeader.FiscalID = Sal.FiscalID and Gl_transactionHeader.CompanyID = Sal.CompanyID inner join Gl_transactionDetail on Gl_transactionDetail.TransactionID = Gl_transactionHeader.TransactionID and Gl_transactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID and Gl_transactionDetail.CompanyID = Gl_transactionHeader.CompanyID where AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = 16 and Sal.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID ),0)
as InvoiceAmount, (select sum(InvoiceAmount) from cteAmount) - --Customer Advance isnull((select isnull(sum(Gl_transactionDetail.Amount),0) from Sal_invoiceHeader Sal inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = Sal.CustomerID inner join Gl_transactionHeader on Gl_transactionHeader.DocumentNo = Sal.invoicenumber and Gl_transactionHeader.CompanyID = Sal.CompanyID and Gl_transactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = Sal.invoiceType and Gl_transactionHeader.FiscalID = Sal.FiscalID and Gl_transactionHeader.CompanyID = Sal.CompanyID inner join Gl_transactionDetail on Gl_transactionDetail.TransactionID = Gl_transactionHeader.TransactionID and Gl_transactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID where AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = 16 and Sal.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID ),0) as ActualAmount, convert(decimal(18,9), (select sum(InvoiceAmount) from cteAmount) ) -
(select cast(isnull(sum(isnull(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeaderinner.amount,0)),0) as decimal) from SAL_InvoiceDetail SAL_InvoiceDetailinner inner join INV_StockTransactionDetail INV_StockTransactionDetailinner on INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetailinner.StockHeaderID and INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetailinner.StockDetailID and INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetailinner.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetailinner.PeriodID and INV_StockTransactionDetailinner.Status = 1

) - ROUND(isnull(( select sum(AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.Amount) from AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail left join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader on AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID = AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.ReceiptHeaderID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.PeriodID where AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.Status = 1 --new and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalDate is null and ReversalComments is null ),0 ),0) as BalanceAmount, ROUND(

from SAL_InvoiceHeader left join SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].ItemID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = 19
Left JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID left join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1 left join [SAL_OrderDetail] on [SAL_OrderDetail].OrderID =SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 And SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
left JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerID
INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
where SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = @InvoiceID )as tab group by ReceiptInvoicesID,ReceiptHeaderID,InvoiceHeaderID,InvoiceNo,InvoiceDate,Action,ActualBalance

data.value:
SELECT Distinct [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType as InvoiceType ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceDate,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].Description ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceNumber, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo as DeliveryOrderNo --,Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced as Quantity
, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced *
(select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc)
/ 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as ExciseDutyActualAmount
--, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SaleTaxAmount ,(case when ( SAL_OrderDetail.Rate <=
--(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' (case when
--SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' (select top 1 isnull(Inclusive,0) as Inclusive from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) = 1
then (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) else ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) - ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 36 No (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced--SAL_OrderDetail.Quantity else
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced--SAL_OrderDetail.Quantity else (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount) end)
end) else --((([SAL_OrderDetail].[NetAmount]-[SAL_OrderDetail].WithHoldingAmount) * [SAL_OrderDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_OrderDetail].[SalesTaxAmount])) ((( ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice ) - --WithHolding ((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice)* ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / 100 )
) * [SAL_OrderDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_OrderDetail].[SalesTaxAmount])) end )as SaleTaxAmount , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount --, (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG) * --( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice ) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced ,INV_Item.UnitWeight ,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG , SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SalesTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding as WithHoldingTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as ExciseDutyAmountTaxPer ,[SAL_OrderHeader].DTRENo , [SAL_OrderHeader].DTREDate --,(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight) * [SAL_OrderDetail].PriceperKG) As AmountReceivable ,(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice )) As AmountReceivable ,SET_Business.BusinessName as SupplierName ,SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName as SupplierNameComplete ,SET_Business.AddressLine1 as SupplierAddress ,SET_Business.NTNNumber as SupplierNTN, SET_Business.PhoneNumber as SupplierPhoneNumber , SET_Business.SalesTaxNumber as SupplierSTRN, [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid, BC.CustomerName as BIllTo, --AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerNameII as CustomerName ,AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 as CustomerAddress, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as CustomerNTN, AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber as CustomerPhoneNumber ,AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber as CustomeSTRN --,AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerCNICII as CNICNumber, [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo as DispatchNo, INV_Item.Description as ItemDescription ,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemStatusCode, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, Abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity]) AS [BaseQuantity] ,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].Transactioncost as UnitPrice, [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],[SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount, [SAL_OrderDetail].[T_GrossAmount], ((isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount,0)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0)) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100 as TaxPayable ,--[SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount + (isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[GrossAmount],0) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100 as TotalAmount ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount + ((isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount,0)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0)) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0) as TotalAmount ,SET_OperatingUnit.LogoImage as LogoImage ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerAddress as Shipto,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].Description as DescriptionTagNo, SAL_InvoiceDetail.DiscountAmountTaken
,(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+'SI' +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+'SI' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+'SI'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as SINumber
,SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno as CustomerRefNo ,SET_Business.AddressLine1 ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding AS WithHolding ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount AS NetAmount --,SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo AS ContractNo ,case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo end as ContractNo --,SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate AS ContractDate, ,case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate end as ContractDate, --([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount,

) as ActualInvoiceAmount,

, (select distinct stuff(( select distinct ',' + COnvert(varchar(10),u.AdvancePaymentID) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment u where u.AdvancePaymentID = AdvancePaymentID and u.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID
for xml path('') ),1,1,'') as userlist from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID group by AdvancePaymentID) as PaymentReference
,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID),0)WHAdvance

,case when [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerPRovinceID = 1 then 'Balochistan' when CustomerProvinceID = 2 then 'KPK' when CustomerProvinceID = 3 then 'Punjab' when CustomerProvinceID = 4 then 'Sindh' end as ProvinceName ,case when isnull([INV_Item].PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,0) <> 0 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [INV_Item].UnitWeight) / isnull([INV_Item].PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,1)) else 0 end as QtyinPackets ,isnull(SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDFixRate,0) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced AS FixFEDAmount
FROM [SAL_InvoiceHeader] INNER JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] On [SAL_InvoiceDetail].InvoiceHeaderID =[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].CompanyID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].PeriodID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].ItemID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID -- inner join Set_PeriodCustom spc_dispatch on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between spc_dispatch.StartDate and spc_dispatch.EndDate --and spc_dispatch.Status = 1 and spc_dispatch.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID Left JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID left join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1 left join [SAL_OrderDetail] on [SAL_OrderDetail].OrderID =SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 And SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
left JOIN INV_SET_Category On INV_SET_Category.CategoryID =INV_Item.ItemTypeID --AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID =INV_Item.CompanyID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer BC ON BC.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer Brokername ON Brokername.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And left JOin SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.uomId=[SAL_InvoiceDetail].ItemUnitID And SET_UnitofMeasure.status=1 WHERE [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[Status] = 1 AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID is null)

SELECT Distinct [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType as InvoiceType ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceDate,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].Description ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceNumber, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo as DeliveryOrderNo --,Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced as Quantity
, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced *
(select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc)
/ 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as ExciseDutyActualAmount
--, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SaleTaxAmount , CASE WHEN ISNULL(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) = 0 THEN (
case when (SAL_OrderDetail.Rate - isnull((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG ))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) ,0) ) <= (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as Inclusive from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 AND SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID AND SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID AND SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate between FromDate and ToDate AND ISNULL(SET_SalesTaxParameters.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.SalesTaxParameterID desc) then
(case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 36 No (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount/ 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0)= isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) end)
end) ELSE
(case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 36 No (SAL_OrderDetail.Rate - isnull((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG ))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) ,0) ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then ( SAL_OrderDetail.Rate * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount/ 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else SAL_OrderDetail.Rate * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) end)
end)
END
) ELSE (
SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount *
(case when ( SAL_OrderDetail.Rate <=
--(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' (case when (select top 1 isnull(Inclusive,0) as Inclusive from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate between FromDate and ToDate AND ISNULL(SET_SalesTaxParameters.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.SalesTaxParameterID desc) = 1 then (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) else ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) ORDER by CreateDate desc ) - ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount ))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 36 No (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount/ 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0)= isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) end)
end) else --(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_OrderDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_OrderDetail].[SalesTaxAmount] + isnull([SAL_OrderDetail].[ExciseDutyAmount],0) ) ) -- (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) / (100+ [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount + isnull([SAL_OrderDetail].[ExciseDutyAmount],0) ) )
( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] - (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) )
-- / (100+ [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount + isnull([SAL_OrderDetail].[ExciseDutyAmount],0) )
end )
/ (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + isnull(Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.FurtherTax,0)) ) end
as SaleTaxAmount , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount --, (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG) * --( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice ) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced ,INV_Item.UnitWeight ,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG , SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SalesTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding as WithHoldingTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as ExciseDutyAmountTaxPer ,[SAL_OrderHeader].DTRENo , [SAL_OrderHeader].DTREDate --,(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight) * [SAL_OrderDetail].PriceperKG) As AmountReceivable ,(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice )) As AmountReceivable ,SET_Business.BusinessName as SupplierName ,SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - for xml path('') ),1,1,'') as userlist from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID group by AdvancePaymentID) as PaymentReference
,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID),0)WHAdvance
,ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID),0)FurtherTaxAdvance
,case when [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerPRovinceID = 1 then 'Balochistan' when CustomerProvinceID = 2 then 'KPK' when CustomerProvinceID = 3 then 'Punjab' when CustomerProvinceID = 4 then 'Sindh' end as ProvinceName ,case when isnull([INV_Item].PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,0) <> 0 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [INV_Item].UnitWeight) / isnull([INV_Item].PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,1)) else 0 end as QtyinPackets ,isnull(SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDFixRate,0) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced AS FixFEDAmount
FROM [SAL_InvoiceHeader] INNER JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] On [SAL_InvoiceDetail].InvoiceHeaderID =[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].CompanyID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].ItemID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID -- inner join Set_PeriodCustom spc_dispatch on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between spc_dispatch.StartDate and spc_dispatch.EndDate --and spc_dispatch.Status = 1 and spc_dispatch.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID Left JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID left join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 And SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID

left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
left JOIN INV_SET_Category On INV_SET_Category.CategoryID =INV_Item.ItemTypeID --AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID =INV_Item.CompanyID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer BC ON BC.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer Brokername ON Brokername.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And left JOin SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.uomId=[SAL_InvoiceDetail].ItemUnitID And SET_UnitofMeasure.status=1 WHERE [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[Status] = 1 AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID is null)
