Select TAB.InvoiceID, TAB.BuyerNTN, TAB.BuyerCNICNo,TAB.BuyerName, TAB.CustomerCategoryID, TAB.CustomerCategory, TAB.Provinceid, TAB.ProvinceName, TAB.InvoiceType,TAB.DocumentType, TAB.InvoiceNumber , TAB.DocumentDate, TAB.SaleType, --SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as Rate, TAB.Rate, TAB.ItemID, --Inv_Item.Description as ItemName, TAB.ItemName, Sum(Quantity) as Quantity, TAB.UOMName, TAB.WithHolding, TAB.TaxAmount, TAB.ExciseDutyAmount, TAB.FEDAmount, SUM(FixedSalesTaxAmount) as FixedSalesTaxAmount, Round(SUM( SaleTaxAmount),0) as SaleTaxAmount, Round(Sum(TAB.ValueTaxAmountReturn) - SUM( SaleTaxAmount) - SUM(FurtherTaxAmount),0) as ValueSaleReturn, Round(SUM(FurtherTaxAmount),0) as FurtherTaxAmount, SUM(FEDTaxAmount) as FEDTaxAmount, SUM(WithHoldingAmount) as WithHoldingAmount, SUM(AmountReceivable) as AmountReceivable , SUM(ActualInvoiceAmount) as ActualInvoiceAmount, TAB.BuyerSTRNNumber, TAB.CompanyName, TAB.CompanyAddressLine1, TAB.CompanyAddressLine2, TAB.CompanyAddressLine3, TAB.CompanyZipCode, TAB.CompanyCity, TAB.CompanyPhone, TAB.Logoimage, TAB.CompanyFax from ( Select SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as BuyerNTN,
Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 then '' Else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII end as BuyerCNICNo, Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName Else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerNameII end as BuyerName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID, --Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory, case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'EXPORTER' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'REGISTERED' else 'UNREGISTERED' end) end as CustomerCategory, AR_SET_Customer.Provinceid, case When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 1 then 'Balochistan' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 2 then 'KPK' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 3 then 'Punjab' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 4 then 'Sindh' else 'Other' end As ProvinceName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType, --Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, 'SI' as DocumentType,
(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber , SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate, 'Goods at standard rate (default)' as SaleType, --SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as Rate, Convert(varchar(20), convert(int, Round(SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,2))) +' %' as Rate, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID, --Inv_Item.Description as ItemName, Case When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Molasses%' then '1703 - Molasses resulting from the extraction or refining of sugar' --When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Bagasse%' then '2303 - Residues of starch manufacture, similar residues beet-pulp, bagasse and other waste of sugar manufacture, brewing or distilling dregs and waste, whether or not in the form of pellets' end as ItemName, When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Bagasse%' then '1701 -e- Others' end as ItemName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.Quantityinvoiced as Quantity, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount, Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) ),2) as FixedSalesTaxAmount , --(Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then -- (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) ) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) -- else --(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) -- end) as SaleTaxAmount case when isnull(SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo,'') = '' then ( Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].Rate / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) ) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) else Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0) end ) else 0 end AS SaleTaxAmount
,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].Rate) as ValueTaxAmountReturn,
-- (Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then -- (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount )) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) -- else -- (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) --end)
case when isnull(SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo,'') = '' then ( (Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.Rate / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount )) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) else Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount,0) end) ) else 0 end as FurtherTaxAmount
, Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount,2) as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount, Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))),2) As AmountReceivable, Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) ),0) as ActualInvoiceAmount, AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber as BuyerSTRNNumber, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax from SAL_InvoiceHeader Inner Join SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status=1 Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1 inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 inner Join SAL_DispatchHeader on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status=1
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID --And AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Left Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.Status = 1 inner Join Set_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID inner Join Inv_Item on Inv_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID --AND Inv_Item.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND Inv_Item.Status = 1 inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID where SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 And (SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null) And (SAL_ContractHeader.BrokerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null) AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between @FromDate and @ToDate {0} )TAB
Group BY TAB.InvoiceID, TAB.BuyerNTN, TAB.BuyerCNICNo,TAB.BuyerName, TAB.CustomerCategoryID, TAB.CustomerCategory, TAB.Provinceid, TAB.ProvinceName, TAB.InvoiceType,TAB.DocumentType, TAB.InvoiceNumber , TAB.DocumentDate, TAB.SaleType, TAB.Rate, TAB.ItemID, TAB.ItemName, TAB.UOMName, TAB.WithHolding, TAB.TaxAmount, TAB.ExciseDutyAmount, TAb.FEDAmount, TAB.BuyerSTRNNumber, TAB.CompanyName, TAB.CompanyAddressLine1, TAB.CompanyAddressLine2, TAB.CompanyAddressLine3, TAB.CompanyZipCode, TAB.CompanyCity, TAB.CompanyPhone, TAB.Logoimage, TAB.CompanyFax
Order By TAB.CustomerCategory, TAB.InvoiceNumber

(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1) +'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+ substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber , SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate, 'Goods at standard rate (default)' as SaleType, --SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as Rate, Convert(varchar(20), convert(int, Round(SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0))) +' %' as Rate, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID, --Inv_Item.Description as ItemName, '1701B - Cane Sugar' as ItemName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.Quantityinvoiced as Quantity, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) ) as FixedSalesTaxAmount --, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SaleTaxAmount
-- ,CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate > '2019-07-01' and [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2021-11-01' -- AND SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG > 70.3404 -- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' -- ) -- THEN -- ( ( ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced -- * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight -- * ( SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG -- + ( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' -- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' -- AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 -- ) THEN 3.60 -- ELSE 0 -- END ) ) )) ) -- - ( ( ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced -- * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight -- * ( SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG -- + ( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' -- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' -- AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 -- ) THEN 3.60 -- ELSE 0 -- END ) ) ) ) -- * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) -- / ( 100 -- + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) ) -- * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / ( 100 -- + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount ) -- ELSE -- case when SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG < 84.4974 -- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' then
--( ( ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced -- * ( (84.4974 * 50) )) ) -- /*- ( ( ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced -- * ( (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG * 50) ) ) -- * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) -- / ( 100 -- + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) */) -- * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / ( 100 -- + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount )
-- else
-- ( ( ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced -- * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight -- * ( SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG -- + ( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' -- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' -- AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 -- ) THEN 3.60 -- ELSE 0 -- END ) ) )) ) -- - ( ( ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced -- * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight -- * ( SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG -- + ( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' -- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' -- AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 -- ) THEN 3.60 -- ELSE 0 -- END ) ) ) ) -- * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) -- / ( 100 -- + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) ) -- * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / ( 100 -- + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount )
-- end -- END -- as SaleTaxAmount
,(case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate else (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate - (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 36 No SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) * SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity else
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity else SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) end)
end) else (([SAL_ContractDetail].[GrossAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100)) end ) as SaleTaxAmount ,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc)) as ValueSaleReturn , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as FurtherTaxAmount , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount,
-- (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + --(Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then 3.60 -- else -- 0 end))))) As AmountReceivable
-- case when isnull(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive,0) > 0 -- then SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive -- else -- --[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.Rate -- (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + --(Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then 3.60 -- else -- 0 end))))) -- end as AmountReceivable
(case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate else (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate - (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 34 No (SAL_ContractDetail.quantity * SAL_ContractDetail.rate) + (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) * SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity)
else (SAL_ContractDetail.quantity * SAL_ContractDetail.rate) + (case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity else SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) end)
end) else
case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then (SAL_ContractDetail.quantity * SAL_ContractDetail.rate) else (SAL_ContractDetail.quantity * SAL_ContractDetail.rate) + (([SAL_ContractDetail].[GrossAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100)) end end ) as AmountReceivable
,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount, AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber as BuyerSTRNNumber, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, null as Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax
,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)AdvanceAmount ,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)WHAdvance
,ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)FurtherTaxAdvance from SAL_InvoiceHeader Inner Join SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status=1 Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1 inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 inner Join SAL_DispatchHeader on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status=1 Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID --And AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Left Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID -- AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.Status = 1 inner Join Set_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID inner Join Inv_Item on Inv_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID --AND Inv_Item.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND Inv_Item.Status = 1 inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
where SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 And (SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null) {0} )tab
group by (tab.InvoiceID),(tab.BuyerNTN),(tab.BuyerCNICNo),(tab.BuyerName),(CustomerCategoryID) ,(tab.CustomerCategory),(tab.Provinceid),(tab.ProvinceName),(tab.InvoiceType), (tab.DocumentType),(tab.InvoiceNumber),tab.DocumentDate,tab.SaleType,tab.Rate,tab.ItemID,tab.ItemName, tab.UOMName,tab.WithHolding,tab.TaxAmount,tab.ExciseDutyAmount,tab.FEDAmount, BuyerSTRNNumber,CompanyName ,CompanyAddressLine1,CompanyAddressLine2,CompanyAddressLine3,CompanyZipCode,CompanyCity,CompanyPhone, CompanyFax,LogoImage
union all
select
PaymentID as InvoiceID, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as BuyerNTN, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as BuyerCNICNo,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as BuyerName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID, case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'EXPORTER' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'REGISTERED' else 'UNREGISTERED' end) end as CustomerCategory , AR_SET_Customer.Provinceid, case When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 1 then 'Balochistan' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 2 then 'KPK' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 3 then 'Punjab' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 4 then 'Sindh' else 'Other' end As ProvinceName , '' as InvoiceType, 'APR' as DocumentType, convert(varchar,AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.DocumentNo) as InvoiceNumber,AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.RecievingDate as DocumentDate,'' as SaleType, '' as Rate, 0 as ItemID ,'' as ItemName , AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.Quantity,'' as UOMName, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.WithHoldingTax as WithHolding, 0 as TaxAmount, 0 as ExciseDutyAmount,0 as FEDAmount,0 as FixedSalesTaxAmount, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.FEDAmount as SaleTaxAmount, 0 as ValueSaleReturn, 0 as FurtherTaxAmount, 0 as FEDTaxAmount, 0 as WithHoldingAmount, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.AdvanceAmount as AmountReceivable, 0 as ActualInvoiceAmount, '' as BuyerSTRNNumber, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode ,CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone,null as Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax ,0 as AdvanceAmount, 0 as FurtherTaxAdvance ,2 as Adjusted from AP_AdvanceSugarPayment Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CustomerID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID where AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.Status = 1 and RecievingDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID And (AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CustomerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null)
-- Order By CustomerCategory,InvoiceNumber

data.name: Query_OutStandingInstallment
data.value: Select CustomerName, CustomerAccountCCID As AccountCode, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description As AccountName, @DateFrom As Date, '' As RefNumber, '( Opening ) -- Balance As On' As Description, '' As Description1, '' As Description2, '' As Debit, '' As Credit, IsNull(Sum(Sal_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid) - Sum(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount), 0) As Balance, 1 As Type From AR_Set_Customer Inner JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerAccountCCID --AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID = AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join Sal_InvoiceHeader ON Sal_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --AND Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID AND Sal_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate < @DateFrom Inner Join Sal_InvoiceDetail On Sal_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND Sal_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND Sal_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 Left Join AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail ON AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @DateFrom Where AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = @CustomerID Group By CustomerName, CustomerAccountCCID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description Union All Select Distinct CustomerName, CustomerAccountCCID As AccountCode, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description As AccountName, Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate As Date, Sal_OrderHeader.referenceno As RefNumber, INV_Item.Description, ( Case When INV_Set_Category.CategoryName = 'CRD' Then 'Al-Haj-FAW' Else Case When INV_Set_Category.CategoryName = 'CBU' Then 'Faw China' Else '' END END ) As Description1, ( Case When SAL_DOVehicleInformation.Chassis is not null then SAL_DOVehicleInformation.Chassis Else '' End ) As Description2, Sal_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid As Debit, '' As Credit, '' As Balance, 2 As Type From AR_Set_Customer Inner JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerAccountCCID --AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID = AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join Sal_InvoiceHeader ON Sal_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --AND Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID AND Sal_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 Inner Join Sal_InvoiceDetail On Sal_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND Sal_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND Sal_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = Sal_InvoiceDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 Inner Join Inv_Set_Category On Inv_Set_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND Inv_Set_Category.Status = 1 Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = Sal_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 Left Join Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader ON Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.Status = 1 Left Join Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail ON Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 Left Join SAL_DOVehicleInformation ON SAL_DOVehicleInformation.DOVehicleInformationID = Sal_InvoiceDetail.VehicleID AND SAL_DOVehicleInformation.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DOVehicleInformation.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DOVehicleInformation.Status = 1 Left Join Sal_OrderHeader ON Sal_OrderHeader.OrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND Sal_OrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND Sal_OrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND Sal_OrderHeader.Status = 1 Where AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = @CustomerID AND Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate Between @DateFrom AND @DateTo Union All Select Distinct CustomerName, CustomerAccountCCID As AccountCode, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description As AccountName, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate As Date, Sal_OrderHeader.referenceno As RefNumber, IsNull(AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountName,'') As Description, IsNull(AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber,'') As Description1, IsNull(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Comments,'') As Description2, '' As Debit, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount As Credit, '' As Balance, 3 As Type From AR_Set_Customer Inner JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerAccountCCID --AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID = AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader On AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_SET_BankAccount ON AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID AND AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID --AND AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BankAccount.Status = 1 Left Join AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail on AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.Status = 1 Left Join Sal_InvoiceHeader ON AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.Status = 1 Left Join Sal_InvoiceDetail On Sal_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND Sal_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND Sal_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 Left Join INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = Sal_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 Left Join Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader ON Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.Status = 1 Left Join Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail ON Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 Left Join Sal_OrderHeader ON Sal_OrderHeader.OrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND Sal_OrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND Sal_OrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND Sal_OrderHeader.Status = 1 Where AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = @CustomerID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate Between @DateFrom AND @DateTo

data.name: Query_SaleCommissionReport
data.value: Select InvoiceID,InvoiceNumber,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,SalesPerson.CustomerName as SalePerson,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate,[INV_SET_Category].CategoryName, [INV_Item].Description as Item,isnull(SAL_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount,0) - Isnull(SAL_InvoiceDetail.DiscountAmountTaken,0) as invoiceValues,SAL_DiscountFrequencyHeader.HeaderName, Convert(varchar(10),Convert(int,SAL_DiscountFrequencyHeader.DiscountPercentage)) + '%' as Commission ,(isnull(SAL_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount,0) - Isnull(SAL_InvoiceDetail.DiscountAmountTaken,0))* (isnull(SAL_DiscountFrequencyHeader.DiscountPercentage,0)*1/100) as Amount from SAL_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail ON SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID =SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID =SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status=1 INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[ItemCategoryID] --AND [INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[ItemID] --AND [INV_Item].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID= SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND SET_DocumentType.[CompanyID] = SAL_InvoiceHeader.[CompanyID] AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1 left JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer SalesPerson ON SalesPerson.CustomerID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.billedtoid AND SalesPerson.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID INNER JOIn SAL_DiscountFrequencyHeader ON SAL_DiscountFrequencyHeader.SalesPersonID = SalesPerson.CustomerID AND SAL_DiscountFrequencyHeader.CompanyID = SalesPerson.CompanyID AND SAL_DiscountFrequencyHeader.Status=1 AND ( SAL_DiscountFrequencyHeader.DiscountOnItemCategory=1 AND SAL_DiscountFrequencyHeader.ItemcategoryID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemCategoryID or SAL_DiscountFrequencyHeader.DiscountOnItemCategory=0 ) AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between SAL_DiscountFrequencyHeader.CommissionForDate and SAL_DiscountFrequencyHeader.CommissionToDate Where SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID

data.name: Query_SaleReportUnderSalesTaxAct1990
data.value:
--Declare @CurrentFiscalID int = 2 --Declare @PeriodID int = 1 --Declare @FromDate datetime = '2019-10-01 00:00:00:000' --Declare @ToDate datetime = '2021-03-15 00:00:00:000'
select Row_Number() over (order by FinalT.InvoiceNumber asc) as RowNumber, FinalT.BuyerNTN, FinalT.BuyerCNIC,FinalT.BuyerName,FinalT.BuyerAddress,FinalT.BuyerType,FinalT.InvoiceNumber ,FinalT.InvoiceDate,FinalT.SaleType,FinalT.Rate,FinalT.Description,SUM(FinalT.ExciseDutyActualAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount ,SUM(FinalT.SaleTaxAmount) as SaleTaxAmount ,SUM(FinalT.WithHoldingAmount) as WithHoldingAmount ,SUM(FinalT.AmountReceivable) as AmountReceivable ,FinalT.Inclusive,FinalT.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemCode,Sum(FinalT.ReceiptAmount) as AmountReceived,FinalT.ReceiptDate as ReceiptDate ,FinalT.ChequeNo as ChequeNo
from (
SELECT Distinct AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.Amount as ReceiptAmount , AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate as ReceiptDate , AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.InstrumentNo as ChequeNo, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, SET_Business.NTNNumber as BuyerNTN, AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber as BuyerCNIC, Brokername.CustomerName as BuyerName, Brokername.AddressLine1 as BuyerAddress, case when Brokername.Isregistered = 1 then 'Registered' else 'Unregistered' end as BuyerType, [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceNumber, [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceDate,null as SaleType, 0 as Rate, null as Description, SUM( case when isnull(SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo,'') = '' then ( (Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.Rate / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount )) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) else Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount,0) end) ) else 0 end ) as ExciseDutyActualAmount
,SUM(case when isnull(SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo,'') = '' then ( Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].Rate / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) ) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) else Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0) end ) else 0 end ) as SaleTaxAmount
,SUM( Round((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding),0) )as WithHoldingAmount
,SUM(Round((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced ) * ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.Rate,SAL_OrderDetail.Rate) ),0)) As AmountReceivable
,ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive,SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive)Inclusive
FROM [SAL_InvoiceHeader] INNER JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] On [SAL_InvoiceDetail].InvoiceHeaderID =[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].CompanyID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].PeriodID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].ItemID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
Left JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID left join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1 left join [SAL_OrderDetail] on [SAL_OrderDetail].OrderID =SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 And SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
left JOIN INV_SET_Category On INV_SET_Category.CategoryID =INV_Item.ItemTypeID
left JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerID
AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer BC ON BC.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid
AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer Brokername ON Brokername.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID
AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID left JOin SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.uomId=[SAL_InvoiceDetail].ItemUnitID And SET_UnitofMeasure.status=1
left join AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail on AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.status = 1
left join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader on AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID = AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.ReceiptHeaderID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerID = Brokername.CustomerID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.FiscalID = AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.FiscalID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.status = 1
left join AR_ReceiptBanksDetail on AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.FiscalID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.FiscalID and AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.status = 1
WHERE [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] in @CompanyID AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID is null) and Cast(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as Date) between @FromDate and @ToDate --and Brokername.CustomerName like '%gul paper%'
group by SET_Business.NTNNumber, AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,Brokername.CustomerName,Brokername.AddressLine1,InvoiceNumber ,InventoryItemStatusCode,ReceiptDate,InstrumentNo,SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive,SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,Brokername.Isregistered,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate ,AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.Amount )FinalT
group by FinalT.BuyerNTN, FinalT.BuyerCNIC,FinalT.BuyerName,FinalT.BuyerAddress,FinalT.BuyerType,FinalT.InvoiceNumber ,FinalT.InvoiceDate,FinalT.SaleType,FinalT.Rate,FinalT.Description,FinalT.Inclusive ,FinalT.InventoryItemStatusCode ,FinalT.ReceiptDate ,FinalT.ChequeNo

data.name: Query_SaleReturnReportUnderSalesTaxAct1990
data.value: Select SAL_ReverseHeader.ReverseHeaderID,SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentNo as CrNoteNumber, SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate as ReverseDate,InvoiceDate,InvoiceNumber,AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber ,AddressLine1 as CustomerAddress,DocumentType as InvoiceType,CustomerName ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID,INV_Item.Description as ItemDescription,SUM(SAL_ReverseDetail.ReversedAmount) as GrossAmount ,INV_Item.Description as ItemDescription,SUM(SAL_ReverseDetail.ReversedAmount) as ExclusiveSalesTaxAmount ,SUM((SAL_ReverseDetail.ReversedAmount*ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0))/100) as SaleTaxAmount ,SUM((SAL_ReverseDetail.ReversedAmount*ISNULL(FEDAmount,0))/100) as FEDTaxAmount ,SUM((SAL_ReverseDetail.ReversedAmount*ISNULL(WithHolding,0))/100) as WithHoldingAmount ,SUM((SAL_ReverseDetail.ReversedAmount*ISNULL(ExciseDutyAmount,0))/100) as ExtraTaxes ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice from SAL_ReverseHeader INNER JOIN SAL_ReverseDetail ON SAL_ReverseDetail.ReverseHeaderID =SAL_ReverseHeader.ReverseHeaderID AND SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID =SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID =SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail ON SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID=SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDetailID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID=SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status=1 INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceHeader ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID=SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType= SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status=1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode=1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber= SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID =SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID =SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status=1 where SAL_ReverseHeader.Status=1 AND SAL_ReverseHeader.StatusCode=1 AND SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID =@CompanyID AND SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID =@PeriodID --AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID =@CurrentFiscalID AND SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate between @FromDate and @ToDate group by SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentNo, SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate,SAL_ReverseHeader.ReverseHeaderID,DocumentType,InvoiceDate,SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice,INV_Item.Description,InvoiceNumber,SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID,CustomerName, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,AddressLine1

data.name: Query_SalesComparison
data.value: SELECT distinct SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemCategoryID,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID AS ItemUnitOfMeasureID,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName+ CHAR(13)+CHAR(10) + 'Rs.' + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'Rs./'+SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName UOMName, Count(*) Rowcounts,'Current' as Section,@AsOnDate as CurrentFiscal, SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, sum(Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) AS BaseQuantity, sum(isnull(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced,0)) QuantityInvoiced, avg(SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice) UnitPrice, sum(isnull(SAL_InvoiceDetail.BaseAmount,0)) BaseAmount, 'Rs.' UOMAmount, 'Rs./'+ SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName UOMPerUnit FROM SAL_InvoiceDetail LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID= INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status=1 LEFT JOIN SAL_DispatchHeader ON SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1 Left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 Left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID Left JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemCategoryID AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_SET_Category.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID AND SET_UnitofMeasure.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID WHERE SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID= @PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.[Status] = 1 AND (@DocumentTypeID is null OR SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID) AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate < @AsOnDate --and SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemCategoryID = 70927 group by distinct SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemCategoryID,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID AS ItemUnitOfMeasureID,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName+ CHAR(13)+CHAR(10) + 'Rs.' + CHAR(13)+CHAR(10) + 'Rs./'+SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName UOMName, Count(*) Rowcounts,'Previous' as Section,DATEADD(YYYY,-1,@AsOnDate) as PreviousFiscal, SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, sum(Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) AS BaseQuantity, sum(isnull(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced,0)) QuantityInvoiced, avg(SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice) UnitPrice, sum(isnull(SAL_InvoiceDetail.BaseAmount,0)) BaseAmount, 'Rs.' UOMAmount, 'Rs./'+ SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName UOMPerUnit FROM SAL_InvoiceDetail LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID= INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status=1 LEFT JOIN SAL_DispatchHeader ON SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[FiscalID] AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1 Left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 Left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID Left JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemCategoryID AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_SET_Category.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID AND SET_UnitofMeasure.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID - 1 WHERE SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID= @PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.[Status] = 1 AND (@DocumentTypeID is null OR SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID) AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate < DATEADD(YYYY,-1,@AsOnDate) --AND INV_StockTransactionHeader <= DATEADD(YYYY,-1,@AsOnDate) --and ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType union all ---Variance select --fintab.* --distinct fintab.ItemCategoryID,fintab.CategoryName, fintab.ItemUnitOfMeasureID AS ItemUnitOfMeasureID,fintab.UOMName, 0 Rowcounts,'Variance' as Section,'2000-01-01' as CurrentFiscal, fintab.DocumentTypeID,fintab.DocumentType, (fintab.CurrentQuantity - SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, FORMAT(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate,'MM') MM, FORMAT (SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate,'yy') YY, FORMAT(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate,'MMM') MMM, CONVERT(varchar,FORMAT(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate,'yy')) +''+ CONVERT(varchar,FORMAT (SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate,'MM')) YYMM, SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate,6),4,7) [MonthName], (Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) AS BaseQuantity, (isnull(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced,0)) QuantityInvoiced, (SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice) UnitPrice, (isnull(SAL_InvoiceDetail.BaseAmount,0)) BaseAmount FROM SAL_InvoiceDetail LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceHeader ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID= INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status=1 LEFT JOIN SAL_DispatchHeader ON SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[FiscalID] AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1 Left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 Left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID Left JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemCategoryID AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_SET_Category.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID AND SET_UnitofMeasure.[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID WHERE SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID= @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.[Status] = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.[Status] = 1 AND (@DocumentTypeID is null OR SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID) AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between DATEADD(YYYY,-1, @AsOnDate) and @AsOnDate --and SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemCategoryID = 70927 ) DT GROUP BY DT.ItemCategoryID,DT.CategoryName, DT.YYMM, DT.MMM
