data.value: SELECT [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType as InvoiceType ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceDate,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].Description ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceNumber ,SET_Business.BusinessName +' '+ SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName as SupplierName, DocumentTypesGroup.Comments as SupplierAddress ,SET_OperatingUnit.NTNNumber as SupplierNTN,DocumentTypesGroup.BranchPh as SupplierPhoneNumber , SET_OperatingUnit.SalesTaxNumber as SupplierSTRN,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid, BC.CustomerName as BIllTo,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName ,AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 as CustomerAddress,AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as CustomerNTN,AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber as CustomerPhoneNumber ,AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber as CustomeSTRN,[SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo as DispatchNo,INV_Item.Description as ItemDescription ,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemStatusCode,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,Abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity]) AS [BaseQuantity] ,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].Transactioncost as UnitPrice,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],[SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount, --(isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[GrossAmount],0) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100 as TaxPayable ((isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount,0)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0)) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100 as TaxPayable ,--[SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount + (isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[GrossAmount],0) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100 as TotalAmount ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount + ((isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount,0)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0)) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0) as TotalAmount ,SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage as LogoImage ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerAddress as Shipto,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].Description as DescriptionTagNo, SAL_InvoiceDetail.DiscountAmountTaken ,(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+'SI' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+'SI' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+'SI' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as SINumber ,SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno as CustomerRefNo ,SET_Business.AddressLine1 FROM [SAL_InvoiceHeader] INNER JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] On [SAL_InvoiceDetail].InvoiceHeaderID =[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].CompanyID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].PeriodID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].ItemID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID -- inner join Set_PeriodCustom spc_dispatch on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between spc_dispatch.StartDate and spc_dispatch.EndDate --and spc_dispatch.Status = 1 and spc_dispatch.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID Left JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1 left JOIN INV_SET_Category On INV_SET_Category.CategoryID =INV_Item.ItemTypeID --AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID =INV_Item.CompanyID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer BC ON BC.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And WHERE [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[Status] = 1 AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID is null)

data.name: Query_SalesRegisterReport
data.value: select SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName as CompanyName, Set_Location.LocationName, SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo, INV_Item.Description, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced, SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice, SAL_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount as SalesAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount as InclusiveAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive ,SAL_OrderDetail.Rate as RetailPrice ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName From SAL_InvoiceDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SAL_DispatchHeader ON SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1 Left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 inner join SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitID = SET_Company.OperatingUnitID and SET_OperatingUnit.Status = 1 inner join SET_Business on SET_Business.BusinessID = SET_Company.BusinessID and SET_Business.Status = 1 and SET_Company.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID left JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status = 1 left join SAL_OrderHeader on SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID and SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemCategoryID --AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_SET_Category.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[ItemUnitID] AND [SET_UnitofMeasure].[Status] = 1 inner join SAL_InvoiceHeader on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.[PeriodID] = SAL_InvoiceDetail.[PeriodID] and SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 left join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status =1 inner join Set_Location on Set_Location.LocationID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.LocationID and Set_Location.Status =1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].DocumentTypeID Inner Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And where SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID {0}

data.value: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID ORDER BY [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID) Rows, [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType as InvoiceType ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceDate,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].Description ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceNumber ,SET_Business.BusinessName +' '+ SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName as SupplierName, DocumentTypesGroup.Comments as SupplierAddress ,SET_OperatingUnit.NTNNumber as SupplierNTN, '' as SupplierPhoneNumber ,INV_Item.Description as ItemDesciption , SET_OperatingUnit.SalesTaxNumber as SupplierSTRN,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid, BC.CustomerName as BIllTo,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName ,AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 as CustomerAddress,AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as CustomerNTN,AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber as CustomerPhoneNumber ,AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber as CustomeSTRN,[SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo as DispatchNo,INV_Item.Description as ItemDescription ,ROUND((CASE WHEN ISNull(INV_ItemDetails.PiecesinCarton,0) >0 then Abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity])/ISNull(INV_ItemDetails.PiecesinCarton,0) else 0 END ),1) Cartons ,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemStatusCode,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,Abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity]) AS [BaseQuantity] ,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].Transactioncost as UnitPrice,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],[SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount, --(isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[GrossAmount],0) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100 as TaxPayable ((isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount,0)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0)) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100 as TaxPayable ,--[SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount + (isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[GrossAmount],0) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100 as TotalAmount ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount + ((isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount,0)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0)) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0) as TotalAmount ,SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage as LogoImage ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerAddress as Shipto,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].Description as DescriptionTagNo, SAL_InvoiceDetail.DiscountAmountTaken ,(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+'SI' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+'SI' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+'SI' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as SINumber ,SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno as CustomerRefNo ,fintab2.GD ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo FROM [SAL_InvoiceHeader] INNER JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] On [SAL_InvoiceDetail].InvoiceHeaderID =[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].CompanyID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].PeriodID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].ItemID LEFT JOIN INV_ItemDetails ON INV_ItemDetails.ItemID=INV_Item.ItemID --AND INV_ItemDetails.CompanyID =INV_Item.CompanyID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID -- inner join Set_PeriodCustom spc_dispatch on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between spc_dispatch.StartDate and spc_dispatch.EndDate --and spc_dispatch.Status = 1 and spc_dispatch.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID Left JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1 left JOIN INV_SET_Category On INV_SET_Category.CategoryID =INV_Item.ItemTypeID --AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID =INV_Item.CompanyID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer BC ON BC.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And LEFT JOIN (Select SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.GD,TransactionQuantity,INV_Item.ItemTypeID as CategoryID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, ISNULL(FINTAB.issuance,0) as issuance from SET_WeightAssessmentHeader INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo=SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.DocumentNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID=SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID=SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=SET_WeightAssessmentHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1 INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID LEFT JOIN (Select abs(sum(isnull(IssuanceDetail.transactionquantity,0))) issuance ,INV_Item.ItemTypeID From INV_StockTransactionDetail IssuanceDetail Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader IssuanceHeader ON IssuanceHeader.StockTransactionId = IssuanceDetail.StockTransactionID AND IssuanceHeader.CompanyID = IssuanceDetail.CompanyID AND IssuanceHeader.PeriodID = IssuanceDetail.PeriodID AND IssuanceHeader.Status = 1 and IssuanceDetail.status = 1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = IssuanceHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = IssuanceDetail.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = IssuanceDetail.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = (CASE when SET_DocumentType.Documenttype LIKE '%stock%return%' THEN ISNULL(IssuanceHeader.ToLocationID,IssuanceHeader.locationid) ELSE IssuanceHeader.locationid end) LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = (CASE when SET_DocumentType.Documenttype LIKE '%stock%return%' THEN ISNULL(IssuanceHeader.ToLocationID,IssuanceHeader.locationid) ELSE IssuanceHeader.locationid end) INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=IssuanceDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status=1 Where IssuanceDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND IssuanceDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID --AND (isnull(SL.LocationID,SET_Location.LocationID) = @LocationID OR @LocationID is null) AND Set_DocumentType.TransactionImpact in('Negative') And IssuanceDetail.Status = 1 And IssuanceHeader.Status = 1 AND IssuanceHeader.IsActive = 1 And IssuanceHeader.StatusCode = 1 --AND IssuanceHeader.DocumentDate < INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate group by INV_Item.ItemTypeID) as FINTAB ON FINTAB.ItemTypeID=INV_Item.ItemTypeID Where (TransactionQuantity) - ISNULL(FINTAB.issuance,0) >0) as fintab2 ON fintab2.CategoryID=INV_Item.ItemTypeID WHERE [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[Status] = 1 AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID is null)

'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AS DispatchNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode AS DeliveryOrderNo ,case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo end ContractNo ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, Case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) Then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName Else [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerNameII end as CustomerName,
--Case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) Then AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber Else [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerCNICII end as NTNNumber , Case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) Then --FORMAT( Convert(int , isnull(replace(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,'-','' ),0)), '#######-#') (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName else [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerNameII end) as InvoicedDescription, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 AS CustomerAddress, AR_SET_Customer.ZipCode AS CustomerZipCode, CityCust.CityName AS CustomerCity, AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber AS CustomerPhone, SET_Term.Description AS Terms, INV_Item.Description As ItemDescription, SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced, Sal_InvoiceHeader.Description As InvoiceComments, Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoicedTo, --Case When IsNull(SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive, 0) = 0 Then SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice -- Else SAL_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount / SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced End As UnitPrice, --SAL_OrderDetail.Rate as UnitPrice, SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as UnitPrice, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, SET_Currency.CurrencySign, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount, ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5), '') as DocumentStatus , INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemCode, SAL_InvoiceHeader.Billedtoid AS BilledTo, SAL_InvoiceDetail.DiscountAmountTaken as Discount ,SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno as CustomerRefNo , SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) ) as ExclusiveSalesTaxAmount --, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SaleTaxAmount --,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * -- Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate > '2019-07-01' and SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG > 72.0 and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' ) --then --[SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate] --else [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate END -- / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SaleTaxAmount ,case when SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo is null then CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate > '2019-07-01'
AND SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG > case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) then 70.2 else 70.2 end
AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%'
)
THEN
( ( ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced
* ( INV_Item.UnitWeight
* ( isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG)
--+ ( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01'
-- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%'
-- AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0
-- ) THEN 3.60
-- ELSE 0
-- END ) ) )) )
- ( ( ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced
* ( INV_Item.UnitWeight
* ( isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG)
--+ ( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01'
-- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%'
-- AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0
-- ) THEN 3.60
-- ELSE 0
-- END ) ) ) )
* ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) )
/ ( 100
+ [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) )
* [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / ( 100
+ [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount )
ELSE
(( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced
* SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate
* [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / 100 ))
END else 0 end AS SaleTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount ,SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID, Brokername.CustomerName as DealerName, --[SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate as SaleOrderDate case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate end as SaleOrderDate
,(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * case when ( COnvert(decimal(18,2),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) > 0 and isnull((select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and CurrentFiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID and CompanyID = @CompanyID and PeriodID = @PeriodID and Status = 1),0) > 0 ) then COnvert(decimal(18,2),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) else (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG )end))) As AmountReceivable,
--,Round((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced ) * ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.Rate,SAL_OrderDetail.Rate) ),0) As AmountReceivable,
--,case when isnull(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive,0) > 0 --then SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive --else ((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced ) * ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.Rate,SAL_OrderDetail.Rate) )) -- end as AmountReceivable,
--([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + -- (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then -- Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 -- else -- 0 end)) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate) as ActualInvoiceAmount ,SAL_ContractHeader.DTRENo, SAL_ContractHeader.DTREDate ,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)AdvanceAmount ,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)WHAdvance
,ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)FurtherTaxAdvance ,Convert(int,ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive,0))Inclusive ,Convert(decimal(18,4),SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail) as FreightDetail , isnull((select InvoiceID from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and CurrentFiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID and CompanyID = @CompanyID and PeriodID = @PeriodID and Status = 1 group by InvoiceID having SUM(AdvanceAmount) > 0),0) as AdvanceID From SAL_InvoiceDetail Inner Join SAL_InvoiceHeader ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 Left JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID
LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status=1
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Inner Join SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And INNER Join AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID --AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And -- And AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer Brokername ON Brokername.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID -- AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID Inner Join INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID Inner Join SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceCurrencyID Left Join SET_City AS CityCust ON CityCust.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID Left Join SET_Term ON SET_Term.TermID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.TermsID Left Join SET_UnitOfMeasure ON SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID = SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID Left Join AR_SET_Customer ARS ON ARS.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.billedtoid --And ARS.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And ARS.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
Left Join SET_City AS SC ON SC.CityID = ARS.CityID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID where SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 And (SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = @InvoiceNoFrom or @InvoiceNoFrom is null) And (SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = @InvoiceNoTo or @InvoiceNoTo is null) And (SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null) -- And (SAL_ContractHeader.BrokerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null)
Union All

CompanyFax, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType AS InvoiceType, (Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber, 0 AS DispatchNo, 0 AS DeliveryOrderNo, 0 as ContractNo,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as CustomerName, FORMAT( Convert(int , isnull(replace(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,'-','' ),0)), '#######-#') as NTNNumber, '' as InvoicedDescription, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 AS CustomerAddress, AR_SET_Customer.ZipCode AS CustomerZipCode, CityCust.CityName AS CustomerCity, SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5), '') as DocumentStatus , '0' as ItemCode, SAL_InvoiceHeader.Billedtoid AS BilledTo, 0 as Discount ,'0' as CustomerRefNo , 0 as WithHolding, 0 as ExclusiveSalesTaxAmount , 0 as SaleTaxAmount , 0 as ExciseDutyActualAmount , 0 as FEDTaxAmount , 0 as WithHoldingAmount ,0 as BrokerID, '' as DealerName, '' as SaleOrderDate , Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount as AmountReceivable,
Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount as ActualInvoiceAmount ,'0' as DTRENo, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DTREDate ,0 as AdvanceAmount,0,0 ,Convert(int,0)Inclusive ,0.0 as FreightDetail ,0 as AdvanceID from SAL_InvoiceHeader
--left Join Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID -- And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID -- And SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID And Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Status = 1

data.name: Query_Sales_TaxReport
data.value: Select Cast(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate AS Date) As InvoiceDate, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.Description, isnull(AR_Set_Customer.AddressLine1, '') As AddressLine1, isnull(AR_Set_Customer.NTNNumber, '') As NTNNumber, isnull(AR_Set_Customer.STRNNumber, '') As STRNNumber, [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderNo], QuantityInvoiced As QuantityMTons, UnitPrice As PricePerTon, SAL_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount As ValueExclusiveOfTaxex, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount As SalesTaxFEDRs, isnull(SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount,0) As SED, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount As InclusiveOfTaxex, (SAL_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount) As ValueInclusiveOfTaxes ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,SET_Business.AddressLine1 as CompanyAddress , SET_Business.NTNNumber as CompanyNTN, SET_Business.SalesTaxNumber as CompanySTN ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] as DocumentNo ,( CASE when SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount <>0 then (ISnull(UnitPrice*SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,1)/100)+UnitPrice else UnitPrice end) As PriceInclusiveOfTaxes , ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.[T_Rate],[SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate])*QuantityInvoiced as T_Amount From SAL_InvoiceDetail Inner Join SAL_InvoiceHeader On SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID AND AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[FiscalID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 Left JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1 Left JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[Status] = 1 Left JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderDetail.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.[Status] = 1 inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID inner join SET_Business on SET_Business.BusinessId = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID INNER JOIN Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID where SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber between @invoiceNumberFrom and @InvoiceNumberTO {0}

--declare @COmpanyID int = 1 , @PeriodID int = 1 , @DOcumentTypeID int = 19 , @FiscalID int = 1 , @DateFrom date = '2019-10-01', @DateTo date = '2019-10-31' ---------------- Registered and Exporter------- Select * from ( Select COnvert(Varchar(Max),FinTab.DispatchNo) as DispatchNo, Convert(Varchar(Max),FinTab.DispatchID) as DispatchID, FinTab.DispatchDate, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName , FinTab.IsExporter , FinTab.IsRegistered ,FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.DocumentType, Sum(FinTab.TotalAmount) as TotalAmount ,SUM(ABS(FinTab.Quantity)) as TotalQuantity ,max(FinTab.UOMName) as UOMName ,max(DeliveryOrderNo) as DeliveryOrderNo ,FinTab.Action ,ContractNo,'' as WeightOption From ( Select * from ( Select (SELECT Distinct STUFF ( (SELECT ',' + D1.DispatchNo FROM SAL_DispatchHeader as D1 Where D1.CustomerID=SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID --AND D1.CustomerCNICII = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII --AND D1.[DispatchDate] Between @DateFrom AND @DateTo And D1.DocumentTypeID= @DocumentTypeID And D1.Status=1 AND D1.DispatchDate = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate And D1.DispatchNo in (Select DispatchNo from ( Select Tab.Quantity, Tab.DispatchNo, Tab.DocumentTypeID,Tab.CustomerID,Tab.CompanyID, Tab.PeriodID,Tab.FiscalID, Tab.DispatchDate,Tab.TotalAmount from ( Select Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ) AS Quantity ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo , [SAL_DispatchHeader].DocumentTypeID,[SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerID,[SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID, [SAL_DispatchHeader].PeriodID,[SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID, [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].TotalAmount
from SAL_DispatchHeader Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID=SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo=SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID=SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID=SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1
left join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.Status = 1 left join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID and INV_SET_Category.Status = 1
Where [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] =@PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID]= @CompanyID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[FiscalID]=@FiscalID AND convert(date,[SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchDate]) Between @DateFrom AND @DateTo And SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode=1 And SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID= @DocumentTypeID
and isnull(INV_SET_Category.SeperateInvoices,0) = 0

data.name: Query_SelectAll_ForApproveDetail
data.value: SELECT DISTINCT SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceReceivedDate ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode ,SET_DocumentApprove.ApprovalStatus ,SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalOperator ,SET_ApprovalAuthority.UserID AS UserID ,SET_Authority.AuthorityLevel FROM SAL_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentApprove ON SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.Status =1 AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber INNER JOIN SET_UserApprovalAmount ON SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.Status = 1 AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NULL AND (SELECT ih.AmountPaid FROM SAL_InvoiceHeader ih WHERE ih.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND ih.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND ih.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT ih.AmountPaid FROM SAL_InvoiceHeader ih WHERE ih.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND ih.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND ih.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) INNER JOIN SET_ApprovalAuthority ON SET_ApprovalAuthority.ApprovalAuthorityID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAuthorityID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Authority ON SET_Authority.AuthorityID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.AuthorityID AND SET_Authority.CompanyID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID AND SET_Authority.PeriodID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID AND SET_Authority.Status = 1 WHERE SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = @InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = @DocumentTypeID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = @DocumentNo
