(SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NULL AND (SELECT ih.AmountPaid FROM SAL_InvoiceHeader ih WHERE ih.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND ih.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND ih.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT ih.AmountPaid FROM SAL_InvoiceHeader ih WHERE ih.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND ih.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND ih.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) INNER JOIN SET_ApprovalAuthority ON SET_ApprovalAuthority.ApprovalAuthorityID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAuthorityID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Authority ON SET_Authority.AuthorityID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.AuthorityID AND SET_Authority.CompanyID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID AND SET_Authority.PeriodID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID AND SET_Authority.Status = 1

data.name: Query_SelectAll_Searching_WithPaging_ForApprove
data.value: SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID DESC) AS 'Row' FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceID ,InvHeader_Outer.CompanyID ,InvHeader_Outer.PeriodID ,InvHeader_Outer.Status ,InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceType ,InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceNumber ,InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceDate ,InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceReceivedDate ,InvHeader_Outer.StatusCode ,SET_DocumentApprove.ApprovalStatus ,Set_documentPendingApprove.ApprovalOperator ,Set_documentPendingApprove.ApprovalUserID AS UserID ,InvHeader_Outer.InvoicedTo ,SET_Documenttype.DocumentType ,Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName FROM SAL_InvoiceHeader InvHeader_Outer INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON InvHeader_Outer.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND InvHeader_Outer.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND InvHeader_Outer.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentApprove ON SET_DocumentApprove.CompanyID = InvHeader_Outer.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID = InvHeader_Outer.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentApprove.Status =1 left join Set_PeriodCustom on InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentTypeID = InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceType AND SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentNo = InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceNumber AND SET_DocumentApprove.CreateDate = (SELECT MAX(CreateDate) FROM SET_DocumentApprove WHERE CompanyID = InvHeader_Outer.CompanyID AND PeriodID = InvHeader_Outer.PeriodID AND DocumentTypeID = InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceType AND DocumentNo = InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceNumber) inner join Set_documentPendingApprove on Set_documentPendingApprove.DocumentApproveID = SET_DocumentApprove.DocumentApproveID and Set_documentPendingApprove.companyID = SET_DocumentApprove.companyID and Set_documentPendingApprove.PeriodID = SET_DocumentApprove.PeriodID inner join SET_Documenttype on SET_Documenttype.DocumentTypeID = InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceType and SET_Documenttype.CompanyID = InvHeader_Outer.CompanyID and SET_Documenttype.periodId = InvHeader_Outer.periodId INNER JOIN SET_UserApprovalAmount ON SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID = InvHeader_Outer.CompanyID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID = InvHeader_Outer.PeriodID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.Status = 1 AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID = InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceType OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 110) AS DATETIME) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NULL AND (SELECT ih.AmountPaid FROM SAL_InvoiceHeader ih WHERE ih.CompanyID = InvHeader_Outer.CompanyID AND ih.PeriodID = InvHeader_Outer.PeriodID AND ih.InvoiceID = InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceID) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT ih.AmountPaid FROM SAL_InvoiceHeader ih WHERE ih.CompanyID = InvHeader_Outer.CompanyID AND ih.PeriodID = InvHeader_Outer.PeriodID AND ih.InvoiceID = InvHeader_Outer.InvoiceID) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) LEFT join UsersInRoles on UsersInRoles.RoleId = SET_UserApprovalAmount.RoleId and UsersInRoles.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID ) SAL_InvoiceHeader

data.name: Query_SelectDataFromDetailOnBases
data.value: Select AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID, SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoiceid, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber AS InvoiceNo, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid - case AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.InvoiceFor when 'Customer' then ( --Customer Advance isnull((select isnull(sum(Gl_transactionDetail.Amount),0) from Sal_invoiceHeader Sal inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = Sal.CustomerID inner join Gl_transactionHeader on Gl_transactionHeader.DocumentNo = Sal.invoicenumber and Gl_transactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = Sal.invoiceType and Gl_transactionHeader.FiscalID = Sal.FiscalID inner join Gl_transactionDetail on Gl_transactionDetail.TransactionID = Gl_transactionHeader.TransactionID and Gl_transactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID where AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = 16 and Sal.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID ),0) ) else 0 end AS InvoiceAmount ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid - case AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.InvoiceFor when 'Customer' then ( --Customer Advance isnull((select isnull(sum(Gl_transactionDetail.Amount),0) from Sal_invoiceHeader Sal inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = Sal.CustomerID inner join Gl_transactionHeader on Gl_transactionHeader.DocumentNo = Sal.invoicenumber and Gl_transactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = Sal.invoiceType and Gl_transactionHeader.FiscalID = Sal.FiscalID inner join Gl_transactionDetail on Gl_transactionDetail.TransactionID = Gl_transactionHeader.TransactionID and Gl_transactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID where AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = 16 and Sal.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and Sal.Status = 1 ),0) ) else 0 end as ActualAmount ,(round(SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid,0) - case AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.InvoiceFor when 'Customer' then ( --Customer Advance isnull((select isnull(sum(Gl_transactionDetail.Amount),0) from Sal_invoiceHeader Sal inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = Sal.CustomerID inner join Gl_transactionHeader on Gl_transactionHeader.DocumentNo = Sal.invoicenumber and Gl_transactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = Sal.invoiceType and Gl_transactionHeader.FiscalID = Sal.FiscalID inner join Gl_transactionDetail on Gl_transactionDetail.TransactionID = Gl_transactionHeader.TransactionID and Gl_transactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID where AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = 16 and Sal.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and Sal.Status = 1 ),0) ) else 0 end ) - ( Select Sum(AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.Amount) From AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail Where AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.Status = 1 ) AS BalanceAmount ,AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.Amount, '' AS Action ,(round(SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid,0) - case AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.InvoiceFor when 'Customer' then ( --Customer Advance isnull((select isnull(sum(Gl_transactionDetail.Amount),0) from Sal_invoiceHeader Sal inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = Sal.CustomerID inner join Gl_transactionHeader on Gl_transactionHeader.DocumentNo = Sal.invoicenumber and Gl_transactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = Sal.invoiceType and Gl_transactionHeader.FiscalID = Sal.FiscalID inner join Gl_transactionDetail on Gl_transactionDetail.TransactionID = Gl_transactionHeader.TransactionID and Gl_transactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID where AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = 16 and Sal.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and Sal.Status = 1 ),0) ) else 0 end ) - isnull(( Select Sum(AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.Amount) From AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail Where AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.Status = 1 ), round(SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid,0) )as ActualBalance ,AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID From AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceHeader ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 inner join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader on AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID = AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.ReceiptHeaderID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.PeriodID Where AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = @RHID

data.name: Query_Select_DataByKey_ForApprove
data.value: SELECT DISTINCT SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status ,SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalOperator ,SET_ApprovalAuthority.UserID AS UserID ,SET_Authority.AuthorityLevel , SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAmountID , SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAuthorityID FROM SAL_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SET_UserApprovalAmount ON SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.Status = 1 AND (SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType OR SET_UserApprovalAmount.DocumentTypeID IS NULL) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, 110) AS DATETIME) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, 110) AS DATETIME) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.EffectiveDateTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AND (1 = (CASE WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NULL AND (SELECT ih.AmountPaid FROM SAL_InvoiceHeader ih WHERE ih.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND ih.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND ih.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID) >= SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom THEN 1 WHEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT ih.AmountPaid FROM SAL_InvoiceHeader ih WHERE ih.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND ih.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND ih.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID) BETWEEN SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountFrom AND SET_UserApprovalAmount.AmountTo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) INNER JOIN SET_ApprovalAuthority ON SET_ApprovalAuthority.ApprovalAuthorityID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalAuthorityID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.CompanyID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.PeriodID AND SET_ApprovalAuthority.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Authority ON SET_Authority.AuthorityID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.AuthorityID AND SET_Authority.CompanyID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.CompanyID AND SET_Authority.PeriodID = SET_ApprovalAuthority.PeriodID AND SET_Authority.Status = 1 INNER JOIN aspnet_UsersInRoles On aspnet_UsersInRoles.UserID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CreatedBy And (aspnet_UsersInRoles.RoleID = SET_UserApprovalAmount.RoleID or SET_UserApprovalAmount.RoleID is null) WHERE --SET_UserApprovalAmount.ApprovalOperator = 'AND' AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = @InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = @DocumentTypeID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = @DocumentNo

data.name: Query_TaxInvoiceReport
data.value:
SELECT Distinct [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType as InvoiceType ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceDate,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].Description ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceNumber, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo as DeliveryOrderNo --,Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced as Quantity , case when isnull(SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo,'') = '' then ( (Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.Rate / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount )) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) else Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount,0) end) ) else 0 end as ExciseDutyActualAmount
,case when isnull(SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo,'') = '' then ( Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].Rate / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) ) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) else Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0) end ) else 0 end as SaleTaxAmount , ROund(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount,0) as FEDTaxAmount , Round((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding),0) as WithHoldingAmount ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced ,INV_Item.UnitWeight
, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SalesTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding as WithHoldingTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as ExciseDutyAmountTaxPer ,[SAL_OrderHeader].DTRENo , [SAL_OrderHeader].DTREDate --,Round((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight) * [SAL_OrderDetail].PriceperKG),0) As AmountReceivable ,Round((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced ) * ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.Rate,SAL_OrderDetail.Rate) ),0) As AmountReceivable ,SET_Business.BusinessName as SupplierName ,SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName as SupplierNameComplete ,SET_Business.AddressLine1 as SupplierAddress ,SET_Business.NTNNumber as SupplierNTN, SET_Business.PhoneNumber as SupplierPhoneNumber , SET_Business.SalesTaxNumber as SupplierSTRN, [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid, BC.CustomerName as BIllTo,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName ,AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 as CustomerAddress,AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as CustomerNTN,AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber as CustomerPhoneNumber ,AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber as CustomeSTRN ,AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber,[SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo as DispatchNo,INV_Item.Description as ItemDescription ,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemStatusCode,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,Abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity]) AS [BaseQuantity] ,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].Transactioncost as UnitPrice,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],[SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount, [SAL_OrderDetail].[T_GrossAmount], ((isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount,0)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0)) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100 as TaxPayable ,--[SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount + (isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[GrossAmount],0) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100 as TotalAmount ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount + ((isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount,0)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0)) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0) as TotalAmount ,SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage as LogoImage ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerAddress as Shipto,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].Description as DescriptionTagNo, SAL_InvoiceDetail.DiscountAmountTaken ,(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as SINumber ,SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno as CustomerRefNo ,SET_Business.AddressLine1 ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding AS WithHolding ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount AS NetAmount --,SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo AS ContractNo ,case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo end as ContractNo
--,SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate AS ContractDate, ,case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate end as ContractDate,
--case when SAL_OrderDetail.inclusive= '0' then SAL_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount else --( SAL_OrderDetail.GrossAmount - ((([SAL_OrderDetail].[T_GrossAmount]/100)* [SAL_OrderDetail].[SalesTaxAmount])+ --(SAL_OrderDetail.ExciseDutyActualAmount) + (SAL_OrderDetail.WithHoldingAmount))) end as ActualInvoiceAmount, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount, SAL_OrderDetail.GrossAmount As TAmountReceivable, SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID, Brokername.CustomerName as BrokerName ,SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 as UnitAddress, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber as UnitPhoneNo, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber as UnitFaxNo ,Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory as BrokerCategory ,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive,SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive)Inclusive ,ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.Rate,SAL_OrderDetail.Rate) PricePerKG FROM [SAL_InvoiceHeader] INNER JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] On [SAL_InvoiceDetail].InvoiceHeaderID =[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].CompanyID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].PeriodID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].ItemID
inner join Set_PeriodCustom PeriodCustom on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between PeriodCustom.StartDate and PeriodCustom.EndDate and PeriodCustom.Status = 1
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID -- inner join Set_PeriodCustom spc_dispatch on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between spc_dispatch.StartDate and spc_dispatch.EndDate --and spc_dispatch.Status = 1 and spc_dispatch.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID Left JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID left join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1 left join [SAL_OrderDetail] on [SAL_OrderDetail].OrderID =SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 And SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
left JOIN INV_SET_Category On INV_SET_Category.CategoryID =INV_Item.ItemTypeID --AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID =INV_Item.CompanyID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer BC ON BC.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer Brokername ON Brokername.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And left JOin SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.uomId=[SAL_InvoiceDetail].ItemUnitID And SET_UnitofMeasure.status=1 WHERE [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[Status] = 1 AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID is null)

data.name: Query_GetDispatchDataWithSaleContractDate
data.value:
SELECT distinct * FROM ( SELECT INV_Item.UnitWeight, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID AS StockDetailID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AS StockHeaderID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments, SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID,SAL_OrderDetail.WithHolding, Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end as UnitQuantity, Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ) AS QuantityInvoiced, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SerialNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreatedBy, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreatedByValue, INV_StockTransactionDetail.UpdatedBy, INV_StockTransactionDetail.UpdateDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.UpdatedByValue, Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then SAL_OrderDetail.ItemCategoryID else StockCat.CategoryID ENd as ItemCategoryID, Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID else StockItem.ItemID ENd as ItemID, Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then INV_Item.Description else StockItem.Description ENd as ItemDescription,
Case when (SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 and SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate is null) then ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate],SAL_OrderDetail.[T_Rate]) / (1 + (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount, 0) + ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount, 0) + ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, 0)) / 100) else --INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost SAL_OrderDetail.Rate ENd * (Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID =ISNULL(INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode,StockItem.VolumeUOMCode) then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = ISNULL(INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,StockItem.WeightUOMCode) then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end) as UnitPrice, Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 and SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate is null then ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate],SAL_OrderDetail.[T_Rate]) else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost ENd * (Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = ISNULL(INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode,StockItem.VolumeUOMCode) then ISNULL(StockItem.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = ISNULL(INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,StockItem.WeightUOMCode) then ISNULL(StockItem.UnitWeight, 1) end) as RetailPrice, Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then (Case when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.[Rate],[SAL_OrderDetail].[T_Rate]) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end) * Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.[Rate],[SAL_OrderDetail].[T_Rate]) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end) * ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) * Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.[Rate],[SAL_OrderDetail].[T_Rate]) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end) * ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) * Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) end) else ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * (INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) ) End as BaseAmount, Case when ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive, 0) = 1 then ( Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then ( ( (ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate],SAL_OrderDetail.[T_Rate]) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) * ( Case when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1)) when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1)) end ) * ( Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0)) ) --now calculating taxation - (case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Bagass%' THEN ( (case when SAL_OrderDetail.[T_Rate] is not null then ((( ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.[T_Rate],[SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate]) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) * ( Case when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1)) when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1)) end ) * ( Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0)) -- )*(isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount,0)+isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount,1))/(100+isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount,0))) else )*(isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount,0)+isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount,0))/(100+isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount,0))) else 0 end ) ) ELSE (case when SAL_OrderDetail.[T_Rate] is not null then ((( ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.[T_Rate],[SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate]) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) * ( Case when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1)) when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1)) end ) * ( Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0)) --)*(isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount,0)+isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount,1))/100) else )*(isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount,0)+isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount,0))/100) else 0 end ) END ) ) else ( ( Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0) ) * (INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) ) End ) else ( case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 1 then ( ( Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0) ) * (INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) ) else ABS (( (case when [SAL_OrderDetail].[T_Rate] is null then ((ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[T_Rate],SAL_OrderDetail.[Rate]) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) / (1 + (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount, 0) + ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount, 0) + ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, 0)) / 100) else (ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[T_Rate],SAL_OrderDetail.[Rate]) + ((Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) end) * ( Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end ) ))end)end as GrossAmount, -- then SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID else UOM.UOMID ENd as ItemUnitID, Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then INV_SET_Category.CategoryName else StockCat.CategoryName ENd as CategoryName, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName else UOM.UOMName ENd as UOMName,
Case when ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive, 0) = 1 then (Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 1 then ( ( ( ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.[T_Rate],[SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate]) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) * (Case when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1)) when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1)) end) * ( Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ) - (ISNULL((Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail .InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader .InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail .CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader .CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader .CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader .PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID]),0)))) * ((ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[SalesTaxAmount], 0)) + (ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[ExciseDutyAmount], 0)) + (ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[FEDAmount], 0))) / 100)) else (((Abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity]) - ISNULL([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[DiscountAmount],0) + ( (((Abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity]) - ISNULL((Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail .InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader .InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail .CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader .CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader .CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader .PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID]),0) ) * (ISNULL([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionCost],0) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) -(ISNULL([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[DiscountAmount],0))) * ISNULL([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SalesTax],0) / 100) )) else ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * ( Case when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end ) * (ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[T_Rate],SAL_OrderDetail.[Rate]) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) end )end as NetAmount,
Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then abs(ISNULL(ISNULL(INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) * (INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity), 0)) else INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount end as TotalAmount, convert(bit,ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.IsSalesTaxExempted, 0)) IsSalesTaxExempted, Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount, 0) Else ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.SalesTax, 0) End As TaxAmount, ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionDetail.DiscountAmount, 0) as DiscountAmountTaken, ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.IsExciseDutyExempted, 0) IsExciseDutyExempted, convert(bit, ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive, 0)) Inclusive, SAL_OrderDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, Convert(bit,ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.IsFEDExempted, 0)) IsFEDExempted, SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount , '' [Action], SAL_DispatchHeader.OtherDiscount, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,SAL_DispatchHeader.BilledToID ,ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) as T_Rate, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, -1 as InvoiceHeaderID, -1 as InvoiceDetailID , SAL_DispatchHeader.CostCentreID ,[SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate as SaleOrderDate ,SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate as SaleContractDate ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate ,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG,ISNULL(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive,0)FreightDetail ,SAL_ContractHeader.DTRENo FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN SAL_DispatchHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID Left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 Inner JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status = 1 inner Join [SAL_OrderHeader] on [SAL_OrderHeader].OrderID= SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID AND [SAL_OrderHeader].CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND [SAL_OrderHeader].PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID --AND [SAL_OrderHeader].FiscalID = SAL_OrderDetail.FiscalID AND [SAL_OrderHeader].Status=1 Left Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID LEft JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemCategoryID AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND INV_SET_Category.Status = 1 LEft JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 LEft JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID AND SET_UnitofMeasure.Status = 1 ---------- For Order Number ---------- left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID LEft JOIN INV_Item as StockItem ON StockItem.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND StockItem.Status = 1 LEft JOIN INV_SET_Category as StockCat ON StockCat.CategoryID = StockItem.ItemTypeID AND StockCat.CompanyID = StockItem.CompanyID AND StockCat.Status = 1 LEft JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure as UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID AND UOM.Status = 1
Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId= [SAL_OrderHeader].CompanyID
inner join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
inner join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
{0} ) Tab Where Tab.QuantityInvoiced > 0 ORDER BY Tab.StockDetailID

data.name: Query_SalesInvoiceMolasses
data.value:
Select TAB.InvoiceID, TAB.BuyerNTN, TAB.BuyerCNICNo,TAB.BuyerName, TAB.CustomerCategoryID, TAB.CustomerCategory, TAB.Provinceid, TAB.ProvinceName, TAB.InvoiceType,TAB.DocumentType, TAB.InvoiceNumber , TAB.DocumentDate, case when TAB.DtreNO is not null then 'DTRE Goods' else TAB.SaleType end as SaleType, TAB.SaleType, --SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as Rate, TAB.Rate, TAB.ItemID, --Inv_Item.Description as ItemName, TAB.ItemName, Sum(Quantity) as Quantity, TAB.UOMName, TAB.WithHolding, TAB.TaxAmount, TAB.ExciseDutyAmount, TAB.FEDAmount, SUM(FixedSalesTaxAmount) as FixedSalesTaxAmount, SUM( SaleTaxAmount) as SaleTaxAmount, Sum(TAB.ValueTaxAmountReturn) as ValueSaleReturn, SUM(FurtherTaxAmount) as FurtherTaxAmount, SUM(FEDTaxAmount) as FEDTaxAmount, SUM(WithHoldingAmount) as WithHoldingAmount, SUM(AmountReceivable) as AmountReceivable , SUM(ActualInvoiceAmount) as ActualInvoiceAmount, TAB.BuyerSTRNNumber, TAB.CompanyName, TAB.CompanyAddressLine1, TAB.CompanyAddressLine2, TAB.CompanyAddressLine3, TAB.CompanyZipCode, TAB.CompanyCity, TAB.CompanyPhone, TAB.Logoimage, TAB.CompanyFax,DTRENo,0 as AdvanceAmount from ( Select SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as BuyerNTN,
Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 then AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber Else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII end as BuyerCNICNo, Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName Else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerNameII end as BuyerName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID, --Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory, case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'EXPORTER' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'REGISTERED' else 'UNREGISTERED' end) end as CustomerCategory, AR_SET_Customer.Provinceid, case When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 1 then 'Balochistan' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 2 then 'KPK' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 3 then 'Punjab' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 4 then 'Sindh' else 'Other' end As ProvinceName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType, --Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, 'SI' as DocumentType,
(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'R' else 'U' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'R' else 'U' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber , SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate, 'Goods at standard rate (default)' as SaleType, --SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as Rate, Convert(varchar(20), convert(int, Round(SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0))) +' %' as Rate, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID, --Inv_Item.Description as ItemName, Case When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Molasses%' then '1703 - Molasses resulting from the extraction or refining of sugar' When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Bagasse%' then '2303 - Residues of starch manufacture, similar residues beet-pulp, bagasse and other waste of sugar manufacture, brewing or distilling dregs and waste, whether or not in the form of pellets' end as ItemName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.Quantityinvoiced as Quantity, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount, round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) ),0) as FixedSalesTaxAmount -- , Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then -- (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].Rate / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) ) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) --else -- Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0) --end as SaleTaxAmount
,Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Molasses%' then Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0) else ((( ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG ) - --WithHolding ((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG )* ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / 100 )
) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) / (100+ [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount)) end else Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0) END as SaleTaxAmount
,Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate),0) as ValueTaxAmountReturn, Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount,0) as FurtherTaxAmount , Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount,0) as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount, round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate),0) As AmountReceivable,
Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) ),0) as ActualInvoiceAmount, AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber as BuyerSTRNNumber, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax, ISNULL(SAL_ContractHeader.DTRENo,SAl_ORderHEader.DTRENo)DTRENo from SAL_InvoiceHeader Inner Join SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status=1 Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1 inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 inner Join SAL_DispatchHeader on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status=1 Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID
And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Left Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.Status = 1 inner Join Set_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID inner Join Inv_Item on Inv_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID
AND Inv_Item.Status = 1 inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
where SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 And (SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null) AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between @FromDate and @ToDate {0} )TAB
Group BY TAB.InvoiceID, TAB.BuyerNTN, TAB.BuyerCNICNo,TAB.BuyerName, TAB.CustomerCategoryID, TAB.CustomerCategory, TAB.Provinceid, TAB.ProvinceName, TAB.InvoiceType,TAB.DocumentType, TAB.InvoiceNumber , TAB.DocumentDate, TAB.SaleType, TAB.Rate, TAB.ItemID, TAB.ItemName, TAB.UOMName, TAB.WithHolding, TAB.TaxAmount, TAB.ExciseDutyAmount, TAb.FEDAmount, TAB.BuyerSTRNNumber, TAB.CompanyName, TAB.CompanyAddressLine1, TAB.CompanyAddressLine2, TAB.CompanyAddressLine3, TAB.CompanyZipCode, TAB.CompanyCity, TAB.CompanyPhone, TAB.Logoimage, TAB.CompanyFax ,DTRENo
Order By TAB.CustomerCategory, TAB.InvoiceNumber

data.name: Query_GetAllDispatchForSheikhoo
data.value:
Select * from(
Select convert(Varchar(Max),FinTab.DispatchNo) as DispatchNo, Convert(Varchar(Max),FinTab.DispatchID) as DispatchID, FinTab.DispatchDate, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.IsExporter, FinTab.IsRegistered ,FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.DocumentType, --Sum(FinTab.TotalAmount) as TotalAmount SUM(ABS(FinTab.Quantity) * FinTab.Rate) as TotalAmount ,SUM(ABS(FinTab.Quantity)) as TotalQuantity ,max(FinTab.UOMName) as UOMName ,max(DeliveryOrderNo) as DeliveryOrderNo ,FinTab.Action ,FinTab.CustomerCNICII ,ContractNo ,WeightOption From ( Select * from ( Select (SELECT Distinct STUFF ( (SELECT ',' + D1.DispatchNo FROM SAL_DispatchHeader as D1 Where D1.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID AND D1.CustomerCNICII = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII --AND D1.[DispatchDate] Between @DateFrom AND @DateTo And D1.DocumentTypeID= @DocumentTypeID And D1.Status=1 AND D1.DispatchDate = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate -- AND D1.BiltyNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.BiltyNo AND D1.CustomerNameII = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerNameII And D1.DispatchNo in (Select DispatchNo from ( Select Tab.Quantity, Tab.DispatchNo, Tab.DocumentTypeID,Tab.CustomerID,Tab.CompanyID, Tab.PeriodID,Tab.FiscalID, Tab.DispatchDate --,Tab.TotalAmount ,SUM(ABS(Tab.Quantity) * Tab.Rate) as TotalAmount ,Tab.CustomerCNICII from ( Select Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ) AS Quantity ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo , [SAL_DispatchHeader].DocumentTypeID,[SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerID,[SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID, [SAL_DispatchHeader].PeriodID,[SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID, [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].TotalAmount ,SAL_ContractDetail.Rate ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerCNICII from SAL_DispatchHeader Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID=SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo=SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID=SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID=SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1
Left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1
Inner JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status = 1 inner Join [SAL_OrderHeader] on [SAL_OrderHeader].OrderID= SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID AND [SAL_OrderHeader].CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND [SAL_OrderHeader].PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID --AND [SAL_OrderHeader].FiscalID = SAL_OrderDetail.FiscalID AND [SAL_OrderHeader].Status=1
inner join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
inner join SAL_ContractHeader contHdr on contHdr.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and contHdr.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and contHdr.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
left join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.Status = 1 left join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID and INV_SET_Category.Status = 1

--(SAL_OrderDetail.ExciseDutyActualAmount) + (SAL_OrderDetail.WithHoldingAmount))) end as ActualInvoiceAmount, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) ) as ,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive,SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive)Inclusive ,ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.Rate,SAL_OrderDetail.Rate) PricePerKG ,SAL_ContractHeader.CustomerPoNo , SAL_ContractHeader.CustomerPoDate ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].GatePassNo ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].GatePassNo as DeliveryChallanNo ,SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage as LogoImage, Set_Batch.Description as CropYear SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID),0)AdvanceAmount ,SAL_ContractHeader.AdvTaxInvoiceNo,SAL_ContractHeader.AdvTaxInvoicedate FROM [SAL_InvoiceHeader] INNER JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] On [SAL_InvoiceDetail].InvoiceHeaderID =[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].CompanyID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].PeriodID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].ItemID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID -- inner join Set_PeriodCustom spc_dispatch on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between spc_dispatch.StartDate and spc_dispatch.EndDate --and spc_dispatch.Status = 1 and spc_dispatch.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID Left JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID left join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
left JOIN INV_SET_Category On INV_SET_Category.CategoryID =INV_Item.ItemTypeID --AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID =INV_Item.CompanyID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer BC ON BC.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer Brokername ON Brokername.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And left JOin SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.uomId=[SAL_InvoiceDetail].ItemUnitID And SET_UnitofMeasure.status=1 left join Set_Batch on Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_ContractHeader.Season WHERE [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[Status] = 1 AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID is null)
