LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status=1
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Inner Join SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And INNER Join AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID --AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And -- And AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer Brokername ON Brokername.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID -- AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID Inner Join INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID Inner Join SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceCurrencyID Left Join SET_City AS CityCust ON CityCust.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID Left Join SET_Term ON SET_Term.TermID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.TermsID Left Join SET_UnitOfMeasure ON SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID = SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID Left Join AR_SET_Customer ARS ON ARS.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.billedtoid --And ARS.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And ARS.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
Left Join SET_City AS SC ON SC.CityID = ARS.CityID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 --and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
where SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 {2} --and INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
Union All
Select SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName,SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID,SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID, Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName, '' As BilledtoName, '' AS BilledtoAddress, '' As BilledtoZipCode, '' AS BilledtoPhone, '' As BilledtoCity, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID as InvoiceHeaderID, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType AS InvoiceType, (Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber, 0 AS DispatchNo, 0 AS DeliveryOrderNo, 0 as ContractNo,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as CustomerName, FORMAT( Convert(int , isnull(replace(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,'-','' ),0)), '#######-#') as NTNNumber, '' as InvoicedDescription, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 AS CustomerAddress, AR_SET_Customer.ZipCode AS CustomerZipCode, CityCust.CityName AS CustomerCity, AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber AS CustomerPhone, '' AS Terms, '' As ItemDescription, '' as UOMName, 0 as QuantityInvoiced, Sal_InvoiceHeader.Description As InvoiceComments, Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoicedTo, 0 as UnitPrice, 0 as TaxAmount, SET_Currency.CurrencySign, 0 as ExciseDutyAmount, 0 as FEDAmount, ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5), '') as DocumentStatus , '0' as ItemCode, SAL_InvoiceHeader.Billedtoid AS BilledTo, 0 as Discount ,'0' as CustomerRefNo , 0 as WithHolding, 0 as ExclusiveSalesTaxAmount , 0 as SaleTaxAmount , 0 as ExciseDutyActualAmount , 0 as FEDTaxAmount , 0 as WithHoldingAmount ,0 as BrokerID, '' as DealerName, '' as SaleOrderDate , Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount as AmountReceivable,
Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount as ActualInvoiceAmount ,'0' as DTRENo, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DTREDate ,0 as AdvanceAmount,0,0 ,Convert(int,0)Inclusive from SAL_InvoiceHeader
left Join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Status = 1
inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID
Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId
Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId
Inner Join SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType
Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID Inner Join AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID --AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And
Inner Join SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceCurrencyID
Left Join SET_City AS CityCust ON CityCust.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID Left Join SET_Term ON SET_Term.TermID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.TermsID Left Join AR_SET_Customer ARS ON ARS.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.billedtoid --AND ARS.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And ARS.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
Left Join SET_City AS SC ON SC.CityID = ARS.CityID
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 --and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
where SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 --And SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sales Invoice%Scrap%' {2} --and SAL_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
)FinalTAB Where FinalTAB.InvoiceDate between @FromDate and @ToDate group by FinalTAB.PeriodSetName, FinalTAB.Inclusive,FinalTAB.InvoiceDate ,FinalTAB.OperatingUnitName,FinalTAB.CompanyID,FinalTAB.PeriodID )Tab
)Fintab group by Fintab.mnth,Fintab.Months,Fintab.OperatingUnitName,Fintab.CompanyID,Fintab.PeriodID
)FinalFintab Group By FinalFintab.mnth,FinalFintab.Months, FinalFintab.CompanyID, FinalFintab.PeriodID,FinalFintab.OperatingUnitName Order By FinalFintab.mnth

data.name: Query_Monthly_Summary_Sales__Mud_Report
data.value:
--Declare @CurrentFiscalID int = 5 --Declare @PeriodID int = 1 --Declare @FromDate datetime = '2020-10-01 00:00:00:000' --Declare @ToDate datetime = '2021-03-31 00:00:00:000'
Select FinalFintab.mnth, FinalFintab.Months, FinalFintab.OperatingUnitName, FinalFintab.CompanyID, FinalFintab.PeriodID, Sum(QuantityInvoiced) as QuantityInvoiced, Sum(CalNetAmount) as CalNetAmount, SUM(GrossAmount) as GrossAmount, SUM(NetAmount) as NetAmount, SUM(T_GrossAmount) as T_GrossAmount, SUM(ExciseDutyActualAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount, SUM(SaleTaxAmount) as SaleTaxAmount, SUM(AmountReceivable) as AmountReceivable, Sum(Amount) - SUM(FinalFintab.SecurityDeposit) as ReceiptAmount ,SUM(FinalFintab.QtySold) as QtySold ,SUM(FinalFintab.TotalSaleRs) as TotalSaleRs ,SUM(FinalFintab.SecurityDeposit) as SecurityDeposit from (
Select 0 as mnth, 'Opening Balance' as Months, Fintab.OperatingUnitName, Fintab.CompanyID, Fintab.PeriodID, Sum(QuantityInvoiced) as QuantityInvoiced, Sum(CalNetAmount) as CalNetAmount, SUM(GrossAmount) as GrossAmount, SUM(NetAmount) as NetAmount, SUM(T_GrossAmount) as T_GrossAmount, SUM(ExciseDutyActualAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount, SUM(SaleTaxAmount) as SaleTaxAmount, SUM(AmountReceivable) as AmountReceivable, Sum(Amount) as Amount ,Sum(Fintab.QtySold)as QtySold ,SUM(Fintab.TotalSaleRs) as TotalSaleRs ,SUM(Fintab.SecurityDeposit) as SecurityDeposit
from ( Select Datepart(Month, SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate) as mnth, concat(FORMAT(SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate,'MMM') ,' - ',DATEPART(YEAR, SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate)) as Months, SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID,SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID,
0 as QuantityInvoiced, 0 as TotalSale, 0 as AmountReceived,
0 AS CalNetAmount, 0 as GrossAmount, 0 as NetAmount, 0 as T_GrossAmount, 0 as ExciseDutyActualAmount ,0 as SaleTaxAmount, 0 As AmountReceivable ,0 as Amount , SAL_OrderDetail.Quantity as QtySold ,SAL_OrderDetail.NetAmount as TotalSaleRs ,0 as SecurityDeposit
--, SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG
from SAL_OrderHeader
inner Join SAL_OrderDetail on SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID And SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID And SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID And SAL_OrderDetail.Status=1
left Join SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail on SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status=1
left Join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID And SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.Status=1 and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.StatusCode=1
Inner Join INV_Item On INV_Item.ItemID= SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID= SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status=1 Inner Join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID= SAL_OrderHeader.SaleContractTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID= SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID= SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID And SET_DocumentType.Status=1
Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status=1
Left Join AR_SET_Customer Set_Broker on Set_Broker.CustomerID=SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID --AND Set_Broker.CompanyID = SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID AND Set_Broker.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID And Set_Broker.Status=1
INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1
INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 Where SAL_OrderHeader.Status=1 And SAL_OrderHeader.StatusCode=1 And SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID And SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID= @PeriodID --And SAL_OrderHeader.FiscalID= @CurrentFiscalID and Cast(SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate as Date) < @FromDate --And [SAL_OrderHeader].SaleContractTypeID =158 {1} )Fintab Group By Fintab.mnth,Fintab.Months, Fintab.CompanyID, Fintab.PeriodID,Fintab.OperatingUnitName
Union All
Select 0 as mnth,'Opening Balance' as Months, Fin.OperatingUnitName, Fin.CompanyID, Fin.PeriodID, 0 as QuantityInvoiced, 0 AS CalNetAmount, 0 as GrossAmount, 0 as NetAmount, 0 as T_GrossAmount, 0 as ExciseDutyActualAmount ,0 as SaleTaxAmount, 0 As AmountReceivable, Sum(Fin.Amount) as Amount ,0 as QtySold ,0 as TotalSaleRs ,0 as SecurityDeposit from ( Select Datepart(Month, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) as mnth, concat(FORMAT(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,'MMM') ,' - ',DATEPART(YEAR, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)) as Months, SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID, 0 as QuantityInvoiced, 0 AS CalNetAmount, 0 as GrossAmount, 0 as NetAmount, 0 as T_GrossAmount, 0 as ExciseDutyActualAmount ,0 as SaleTaxAmount, 0 As AmountReceivable ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount as Amount ,0 as QtySold ,0 as TotalSaleRs ,0 as SecurityDeposit From AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1
INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 Where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = (Select top 1 DocumentTypeID from SET_DocumentType Where SET_DocumentType.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND DocumentType like 'Direct%Receipt%Mud%') AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID --AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate )Fin Group By Fin.OperatingUnitName, Fin.CompanyID, Fin.PeriodID
Union All
Select 0 as mnth,'Opening Balance' as Months, Fin.OperatingUnitName, Fin.CompanyID, Fin.PeriodID, 0 as QuantityInvoiced, 0 AS CalNetAmount, 0 as GrossAmount, 0 as NetAmount, 0 as T_GrossAmount, 0 as ExciseDutyActualAmount ,0 as SaleTaxAmount, 0 As AmountReceivable, 0 as Amount ,0 as QtySold ,0 as TotalSaleRs ,Sum(Fin.SecurityDeposit) as SecurityDeposit from ( Select Datepart(Month, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) as mnth, concat(FORMAT(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,'MMM') ,' - ',DATEPART(YEAR, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)) as Months, SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID, 0 as QuantityInvoiced, 0 AS CalNetAmount, 0 as GrossAmount, 0 as NetAmount, 0 as T_GrossAmount, 0 as ExciseDutyActualAmount ,0 as SaleTaxAmount, 0 As AmountReceivable ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount as Amount ,0 as QtySold ,0 as TotalSaleRs ,isnull(AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount,0) as SecurityDeposit From AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1
INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
inner join AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail on AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.FiscalID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.FiscalID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Status = 1
inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description like '%SECURITY DEPOSITS - OTHERS%'
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1
Where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = (Select top 1 DocumentTypeID from SET_DocumentType Where SET_DocumentType.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND DocumentType like 'Direct%Receipt%Mud%') AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID --AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate )Fin Group By Fin.OperatingUnitName, Fin.CompanyID, Fin.PeriodID
Union ALL
Select 0 as mnth, 'Opening Balance' as Months, Fintab.OperatingUnitName, Fintab.CompanyID, Fintab.PeriodID, Sum(Fintab.QuantityInvoiced) as QuantityInvoiced, 0 as CalNetAmount, SUM(Fintab.AmountReceivable) as GrossAmount, SUM(Fintab.TotalAmountReceivable) as NetAmount, 0 as T_GrossAmount, SUM(Fintab.ExciseDutyActualAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount, SUM(Fintab.SaleTaxAmount) as SaleTaxAmount, 0 as AmountReceivable, 0 as Amount ,0as QtySold ,0 as TotalSaleRs ,0 as SecurityDeposit
from (
select Datepart(Month, Tab.InvoiceDate) as mnth, concat(FORMAT(Tab.InvoiceDate,'MMM') ,' - ',DATEPART(YEAR, Tab.InvoiceDate)) as Months, Tab.OperatingUnitName, Tab.CompanyID,Tab.PeriodID, Tab.PeriodSetName, ( case when Tab.f_SaleTaxAmount > 0 or Tab.SaleTaxAmount = 0 then (Tab.f_Value_Inclusive - (Tab.SaleTaxAmount+Tab.ExciseDutyActualAmount) ) else 0 end ) as AmountReceivable , Tab.f_SaleTaxAmount as SaleTaxAmount, Tab.ExciseDutyActualAmount as ExciseDutyActualAmount, Tab.AdvanceAmount as AdvanceAmount , Tab.Inclusive
, Tab.f_Total_Amount_Receivable as TotalAmountReceivable
,Tab.QuantityInvoiced as QuantityInvoiced from (
Select FinalTAB.PeriodSetName ,SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) as SaleTaxAmount , SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) - SUM(FinalTAB.AdvanceAmount) as f_SaleTaxAmount , SUM(FinalTAB.ExciseDutyActualAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount , SUM(FinalTAB.AdvanceAmount) as AdvanceAmount , FinalTAB.Inclusive
,(case when FinalTAB.Inclusive = 0 then
case when ( (SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) - SUM(FinalTAB.AdvanceAmount)) > 0 OR SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) = 0 ) then round(SUM(FinalTAB.AmountReceivable) + SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) + SUM(FinalTAB.ExciseDutyActualAmount),0) else 0 end
when ( (SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) - SUM(FinalTAB.AdvanceAmount)) > 0 OR SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) = 0 ) then round(SUM(FinalTAB.AmountReceivable),0) else 0 end ) as f_Total_Amount_Receivable
, case when ( (SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) - SUM(FinalTAB.AdvanceAmount)) > 0 OR SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) = 0 ) then round((case when FinalTAB.Inclusive = 0 then
case when ( (SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) - SUM(FinalTAB.AdvanceAmount)) > 0 OR SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) = 0 ) then round(SUM(FinalTAB.AmountReceivable) + SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) + SUM(FinalTAB.ExciseDutyActualAmount),0) else 0 end
when ( (SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) - SUM(FinalTAB.AdvanceAmount)) > 0 OR SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) = 0 ) then round(SUM(FinalTAB.AmountReceivable),0) else 0 end ) - SUM(FinalTab.WithHoldingAmount),0)
else 0 end as f_Value_Inclusive
,SUM(isnull(FinalTab.QuantityInvoiced,0)) as QuantityInvoiced ,FinalTab.InvoiceDate ,FinalTab.OperatingUnitName ,FinalTab.CompanyID,FinalTab.PeriodID from ( Select distinct SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName,SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID,SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID,Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName, ARS.CustomerName As BilledtoName, ARS.AddressLine1 AS BilledtoAddress, ARS.ZipCode As BilledtoZipCode, ARS.PhoneNumber AS BilledtoPhone, SC.CityName As BilledtoCity, SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType AS InvoiceType, (Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AS DispatchNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode AS DeliveryOrderNo ,case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo end ContractNo ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, Case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) Then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName Else [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerNameII end as CustomerName,

Where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = (Select top 1 DocumentTypeID from SET_DocumentType Where SET_DocumentType.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND DocumentType like 'Direct%Receipt%Mud%') AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID --AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate AND @ToDate)Fin Group By Fin.mnth,Fin.Months, Fin.OperatingUnitName, Fin.CompanyID, Fin.PeriodID
Union ALL
Select Fintab.mnth, Fintab.Months, Fintab.OperatingUnitName, Fintab.CompanyID, Fintab.PeriodID, Sum(Fintab.QuantityInvoiced) as QuantityInvoiced, 0 as CalNetAmount, SUM(Fintab.AmountReceivable) as GrossAmount, SUM(Fintab.TotalAmountReceivable) as NetAmount, 0 as T_GrossAmount, SUM(Fintab.ExciseDutyActualAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount, SUM(Fintab.SaleTaxAmount) as SaleTaxAmount, 0 as AmountReceivable, 0 as Amount ,0as QtySold ,0 as TotalSaleRs ,0 as SecurityDeposit
from (
select Datepart(Month, Tab.InvoiceDate) as mnth, concat(FORMAT(Tab.InvoiceDate,'MMM') ,' - ',DATEPART(YEAR, Tab.InvoiceDate)) as Months, Tab.OperatingUnitName, Tab.CompanyID,Tab.PeriodID, Tab.PeriodSetName, ( case when Tab.f_SaleTaxAmount > 0 or Tab.SaleTaxAmount = 0 then (Tab.f_Value_Inclusive - (Tab.SaleTaxAmount+Tab.ExciseDutyActualAmount) ) else 0 end ) as AmountReceivable , Tab.f_SaleTaxAmount as SaleTaxAmount, Tab.ExciseDutyActualAmount as ExciseDutyActualAmount, Tab.AdvanceAmount as AdvanceAmount , Tab.Inclusive
, Tab.f_Total_Amount_Receivable as TotalAmountReceivable
,Tab.QuantityInvoiced as QuantityInvoiced from (
Select FinalTAB.PeriodSetName ,SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) as SaleTaxAmount , SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) - SUM(FinalTAB.AdvanceAmount) as f_SaleTaxAmount , SUM(FinalTAB.ExciseDutyActualAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount , SUM(FinalTAB.AdvanceAmount) as AdvanceAmount , FinalTAB.Inclusive
,(case when FinalTAB.Inclusive = 0 then
case when ( (SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) - SUM(FinalTAB.AdvanceAmount)) > 0 OR SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) = 0 ) then round(SUM(FinalTAB.AmountReceivable) + SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) + SUM(FinalTAB.ExciseDutyActualAmount),0) else 0 end
when ( (SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) - SUM(FinalTAB.AdvanceAmount)) > 0 OR SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) = 0 ) then round(SUM(FinalTAB.AmountReceivable),0) else 0 end ) as f_Total_Amount_Receivable
, case when ( (SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) - SUM(FinalTAB.AdvanceAmount)) > 0 OR SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) = 0 ) then round((case when FinalTAB.Inclusive = 0 then
case when ( (SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) - SUM(FinalTAB.AdvanceAmount)) > 0 OR SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) = 0 ) then round(SUM(FinalTAB.AmountReceivable) + SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) + SUM(FinalTAB.ExciseDutyActualAmount),0) else 0 end
when ( (SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) - SUM(FinalTAB.AdvanceAmount)) > 0 OR SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) = 0 ) then round(SUM(FinalTAB.AmountReceivable),0) else 0 end ) - SUM(FinalTab.WithHoldingAmount),0)
else 0 end as f_Value_Inclusive
,SUM(isnull(FinalTab.QuantityInvoiced,0)) as QuantityInvoiced ,FinalTab.InvoiceDate ,FinalTab.OperatingUnitName ,FinalTab.CompanyID,FinalTab.PeriodID from ( Select distinct SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName,SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID,SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID,Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName, ARS.CustomerName As BilledtoName, ARS.AddressLine1 AS BilledtoAddress, ARS.ZipCode As BilledtoZipCode, ARS.PhoneNumber AS BilledtoPhone, SC.CityName As BilledtoCity, SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType AS InvoiceType, (Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AS DispatchNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode AS DeliveryOrderNo ,case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo end ContractNo ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, Case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) Then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName Else [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerNameII end as CustomerName,
--Case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) Then AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber Else [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerCNICII end as NTNNumber , Case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) Then --FORMAT( Convert(int , isnull(replace(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,'-','' ),0)), '#######-#') isnull(replace(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,'-','' ),0) Else format(convert(float(50), isnull(replace([SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerCNICII, '-',''),0)),'#####-#######-#') end as NTNNumber , (case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName else [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerNameII end) as InvoicedDescription, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 AS CustomerAddress, AR_SET_Customer.ZipCode AS CustomerZipCode, CityCust.CityName AS CustomerCity, AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber AS CustomerPhone, SET_Term.Description AS Terms, INV_Item.Description As ItemDescription, SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced, Sal_InvoiceHeader.Description As InvoiceComments, Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoicedTo,
SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as UnitPrice, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, SET_Currency.CurrencySign, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount, ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5), '') as DocumentStatus , INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemCode, SAL_InvoiceHeader.Billedtoid AS BilledTo, SAL_InvoiceDetail.DiscountAmountTaken as Discount ,SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno as CustomerRefNo , SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) ) as ExclusiveSalesTaxAmount
, case when isnull(SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo,'') = '' then ( Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].Rate / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) ) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) else Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0) end ) else 0 end AS SaleTaxAmount
, --(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount case when isnull(SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo,'') = '' then ( (Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.Rate / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount )) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) else Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount,0) end) ) else 0 end as ExciseDutyActualAmount
, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount ,SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID, Brokername.CustomerName as DealerName, --[SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate as SaleOrderDate case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate end as SaleOrderDate
,(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * case when COnvert(decimal(18,2),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) > 0 then COnvert(decimal(18,2),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) else (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end))end))) As AmountReceivable,
([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate) as ActualInvoiceAmount ,SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo, SAL_OrderHeader.DTREDate ,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)AdvanceAmount ,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)WHAdvance
,ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)FurtherTaxAdvance ,Convert(int,ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive,0))Inclusive From SAL_InvoiceDetail Inner Join SAL_InvoiceHeader ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 Left JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID
LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status=1
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Inner Join SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And INNER Join AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID --AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And -- And AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer Brokername ON Brokername.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID -- AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID Inner Join INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID Inner Join SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceCurrencyID Left Join SET_City AS CityCust ON CityCust.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID Left Join SET_Term ON SET_Term.TermID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.TermsID Left Join SET_UnitOfMeasure ON SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID = SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID Left Join AR_SET_Customer ARS ON ARS.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.billedtoid --And ARS.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And ARS.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
Left Join SET_City AS SC ON SC.CityID = ARS.CityID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 --and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
where SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 {2} --and INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
Union All

AS BilledtoPhone, '' As BilledtoCity, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID as InvoiceHeaderID, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +Convert(varchar(5),(case When substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber, 0 AS DispatchNo, 0 AS DeliveryOrderNo, 0 as ContractNo,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as CustomerName, FORMAT( Convert(int , isnull(replace(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,'-','' ),0)), AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber AS CustomerPhone, '' AS Terms, '' As ItemDescription, '' as UOMName, 0 as QuantityInvoiced, Sal_InvoiceHeader.Description As InvoiceComments, Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoicedTo, SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5), '') as DocumentStatus , '0' as ItemCode, SAL_InvoiceHeader.Billedtoid AS BilledTo, 0 as Discount ,'0' as CustomerRefNo , 0 as WithHolding, 0 as ExclusiveSalesTaxAmount , 0 as SaleTaxAmount , 0 as ExciseDutyActualAmount , 0 as FEDTaxAmount , 0 as WithHoldingAmount ,0 as BrokerID, '' as DealerName, '' as SaleOrderDate , Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount as AmountReceivable,

Inner Join SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceCurrencyID

where SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 --And SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sales Invoice%Mud%' {2} --and SAL_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID

data.name: Query_Summary_Mud_Sales_Report
data.value:
Select FinalFintab.OperatingUnitName, FinalFintab.CompanyID, FinalFintab.PeriodID, Sum(QuantityInvoiced) as QuantityInvoiced, Sum(CalNetAmount) as CalNetAmount, SUM(GrossAmount) as GrossAmount, SUM(GrossAmount) - (SUM(SaleTaxAmount) + SUM(ExciseDutyActualAmount)) as NetAmount, SUM(T_GrossAmount) as T_GrossAmount, SUM(ExciseDutyActualAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount, SUM(SaleTaxAmount) as SaleTaxAmount, SUM(AmountReceivable) as AmountReceivable, Sum(ReceiptAmount) as ReceiptAmount, (Select isnull(SUM(isnull(CrushingQuantity,0)),0) as CrushingQuantity from cane_Crushing Where CrushingDate Between @FromDate and @ToDate And CompanyID = @CompanyID AND PeriodID = @PeriodID ) As CrushingQuantity, (select sum(TAB.OpeningBalanceQty) as OpeningBalanceQty FROM (SELECT INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, (case when SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Positive' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) else abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)*-1 end) AS OpeningBalanceQty FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0) LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID in (1) AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 and SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <>'No Impact' AND convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @FromDate AND INV_Item.ItemTypeID = @ItemCategory AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 ) AS TAB group by tab.CategoryName) as OpeningStock, (select sum(TAB.ClosingBalanceQty) as ClosingBalanceQty FROM ( SELECT INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, (case when SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Positive' then abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) else abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)*-1 end) AS ClosingBalanceQty
FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0) LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID in (1) AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 and SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <>'No Impact' AND convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) > @FromDate AND INV_Item.ItemTypeID = @ItemCategory AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 ) AS TAB group by tab.CategoryName) as ClosingStock , (Select ISNULL(Sum(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount),0) as OpeningReceiptAmount From AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1
INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = (Select top 1 DocumentTypeID from SET_DocumentType Where SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND DocumentType like 'Direct%Receipt%Mud%') AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate )as OpeningReceiptAmount, (Select ISNULL(Sum(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount),0) as OpeningReceiptAmount From AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1
INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = (Select top 1 DocumentTypeID from SET_DocumentType Where SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND DocumentType like 'Direct%Receipt%Mud%') AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate and @ToDate) as ReceiptAmountDuringThePeriod from ( Select Fintab.OperatingUnitName, Fintab.CompanyID, Fintab.PeriodID, Sum(QuantityInvoiced) as QuantityInvoiced, Sum(CalNetAmount) as CalNetAmount, SUM(GrossAmount) as GrossAmount, SUM(GrossAmount) - (SUM(SaleTaxAmount) + SUM(ExciseDutyActualAmount)) as NetAmount, SUM(T_GrossAmount) as T_GrossAmount, SUM(ExciseDutyActualAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount, SUM(SaleTaxAmount) as SaleTaxAmount, SUM(AmountReceivable) as AmountReceivable, Sum(Amount) as ReceiptAmount from (SELECT SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID, SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID, SAL_InvoiceDetail .QuantityInvoiced, (SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice) as TotalSale, 0 as AmountReceived,
round(SAL_OrderDetail.Quantity * SAL_OrderDetail.Rate, 0) AS CalNetAmount, Round(SAL_OrderDetail.GrossAmount, 0) as GrossAmount, Round(SAL_OrderDetail.NetAmount, 0) as NetAmount, Round(SAL_OrderDetail.T_GrossAmount, 0) as T_GrossAmount, Round((SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount,0) as ExciseDutyActualAmount, case when isnull(SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo, '') = '' then Round((SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, 0) else 0 end as SaleTaxAmount, Round(((SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) * ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.Rate, SAL_OrderDetail.Rate)), 0) As AmountReceivable, 0 as Amount FROM SAL_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail On SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail . TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail . StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail . StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail . StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail . CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail . CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail . PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail . PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail . Status = 1
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader . StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail . StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader . CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail . CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader . PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail . PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader . Status = 1
INNER JOIN SAL_DispatchHeader ON SAL_DispatchHeader . DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader . DocumentTypeID AND SAL_DispatchHeader . DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader . DocumentNo AND SAL_DispatchHeader . CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader . CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader . PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader . PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader . Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID -- inner join Set_PeriodCustom spc_dispatch on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate between spc_dispatch.StartDate and spc_dispatch.EndDate --and spc_dispatch.Status = 1 and spc_dispatch.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID Left JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail .SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail .CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID left join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader. CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail . CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader. PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail . PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader. Status = 1 left join SAL_OrderDetail on SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID AND SAL_OrderHeader. CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail . CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader. PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail . PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail . Status = 1 And SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_ContractHeader.Status = 1
INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceHeader .CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status = 1
INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive = 1 INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
WHERE SAL_InvoiceHeader.status = 1 And SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between @FromDate AND @ToDate {0}) Fintab Group By Fintab.CompanyID, Fintab.PeriodID, Fintab.OperatingUnitName
Union All
Select Fin.OperatingUnitName, Fin.CompanyID, Fin.PeriodID, 0 as QuantityInvoiced, 0 AS CalNetAmount, 0 as GrossAmount, 0 as NetAmount, 0 as T_GrossAmount, 0 as ExciseDutyActualAmount, 0 as SaleTaxAmount, 0 As AmountReceivable, Sum(Fin.Amount) as ReceiptAmount from (Select SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID, 0 as QuantityInvoiced, 0 AS CalNetAmount, 0 as GrossAmount, 0 as NetAmount, 0 as T_GrossAmount, 0 as ExciseDutyActualAmount, 0 as SaleTaxAmount, 0 As AmountReceivable, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount as Amount From AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status = 1
INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive = 1 INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = (Select top 1 DocumentTypeID from SET_DocumentType Where SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND DocumentType like 'Direct%Receipt%Mud%') AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate AND @ToDate) Fin Group By Fin.OperatingUnitName, Fin.CompanyID, Fin.PeriodID
)FinalFintab Group By FinalFintab.CompanyID, FinalFintab.PeriodID,FinalFintab.OperatingUnitName

data.name: Query_GetDataByKey_ForDOUpdate
data.value:
SELECT distinct * FROM ( SELECT SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo,SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID,SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID as DeliveryOrderIDOld,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID AS StockDetailID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AS StockHeaderID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments, SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID,SAL_OrderDetail.WithHolding, Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end as UnitQuantity, Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = @StockHeaderID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ) AS Quantity, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SerialNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreatedBy, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreatedByValue, INV_StockTransactionDetail.UpdatedBy, INV_StockTransactionDetail.UpdateDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.UpdatedByValue, Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then SAL_OrderDetail.ItemCategoryID else StockCat.CategoryID ENd as ItemCategoryID, Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID else StockItem.ItemID ENd as ItemID, Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then INV_Item.Description else StockItem.Description ENd as [Description], Case when (SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 and SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate is null) then ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate],SAL_OrderDetail.[T_Rate]) / (1 + (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount, 0) + ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount, 0) + ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, 0)) / 100) else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost ENd * (Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID =ISNULL(INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode,StockItem.VolumeUOMCode) then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = ISNULL(INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,StockItem.WeightUOMCode) then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end) as Rate, Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 and SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate is null then ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate],SAL_OrderDetail.[T_Rate]) else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost ENd * (Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = ISNULL(INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode,StockItem.VolumeUOMCode) then ISNULL(StockItem.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = ISNULL(INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,StockItem.WeightUOMCode) then ISNULL(StockItem.UnitWeight, 1) end) as RetailPrice, Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then (Case when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.[Rate],[SAL_OrderDetail].[T_Rate]) * Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.[Rate],[SAL_OrderDetail].[T_Rate]) * ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) * Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.[Rate],[SAL_OrderDetail].[T_Rate]) * ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) * Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) end) else ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity*INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost ) End as BaseAmount, Case when ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive, 0) = 1 then ( Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then ( ( ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate],SAL_OrderDetail.[T_Rate]) * ( Case when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1)) when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1)) end ) * ( Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = @StockHeaderID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0)) ) --now calculating taxation - (case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Bagass%' THEN ( (case when SAL_OrderDetail.[T_Rate] is not null then (( ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.[T_Rate],[SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate]) * ( Case when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1)) when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1)) end ) * ( Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = @StockHeaderID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0)) -- )*(isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount,0)+isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount,1))/(100+isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount,0))) else )*(isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount,0)+isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount,0))/(100+isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount,0))) else 0 end ) ) ELSE (case when SAL_OrderDetail.[T_Rate] is not null then (( ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.[T_Rate],[SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate]) * ( Case when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1)) when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1)) end ) * ( Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = @StockHeaderID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0)) --)*(isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount,0)+isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount,1))/100) else )*(isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount,0)+isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount,0))/100) else 0 end ) END ) ) else ( ( Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = @StockHeaderID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0) ) * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost ) End ) else ( case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 1 then ( ( Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = @StockHeaderID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0) ) * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost ) else ABS (( (case when [SAL_OrderDetail].[T_Rate] is null then (ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[T_Rate],SAL_OrderDetail.[Rate]) * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) / (1 + (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount, 0) + ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount, 0) + ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, 0)) / 100) else (ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[T_Rate],SAL_OrderDetail.[Rate]) * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) end) * ( Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end ) ))end)end as GrossAmount, -- SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity * sal_orderdetail.BaseAmount as GrossAmount, Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) AS BaseQuantity, Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID else UOM.UOMID ENd as ItemUnitID, Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then INV_SET_Category.CategoryName else StockCat.CategoryName ENd as CategoryName, Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit else StockItem.ListPricePerUnit ENd as ListPricePerUnit, Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName else UOM.UOMName ENd as UOMName, Case when ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive, 0) = 1 then (Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 1 then ( ( ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.[T_Rate],[SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate])* (Case when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1)) when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1)) end) * ( Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = @StockHeaderID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0) ) ) + SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end ) * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.[Rate],[SAL_OrderDetail].[T_Rate]) end )end as NetAmount, Case when =SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and INV_LoadingPointDetail.PeriodID =SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID ),0) as RemainingLoadingQty,convert(date,INV_SecondWeight.CreateDate) as GrossWeightDate ,INV_LoadingPointHeader.LoadingPointHeaderID as LoadingPointHeaderID FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 LEft JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status = 1 LEft JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemCategoryID AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND INV_SET_Category.Status = 1 inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 inner join AR_SET_Customer as Transporter on Transporter.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.TransporterID and Transporter.Status = 1 inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = Transporter.CustomerID inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = 'Transporter' LEft JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.CompanyID = ---------- left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID LEft JOIN INV_Item as StockItem ON StockItem.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID AND StockItem.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND StockItem.Status = 1 LEft JOIN INV_SET_Category as StockCat ON StockCat.CategoryID = StockItem.ItemTypeID AND StockCat.CompanyID = StockItem.CompanyID AND StockCat.Status = 1 LEft JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure as UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID AND UOM.Status = 1
left join INV_SecondWeight on INV_SecondWeight.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_SecondWeight.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID --and INV_SecondWeight.SecondWeightID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.GrossWeightID and INV_SecondWeight.Documentno = INV_StockTransactionHeader.GrossWeightID and INV_SecondWeight.CurrentFiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID and INV_SecondWeight.Status = 1 and INV_SecondWeight.StatusCode =1
inner join SET_DocumentType SET_DocumentTypedispacth on SET_DocumentTypedispacth.documenttypeid = INV_StockTransactionHeader.documenttypeid and SET_DocumentTypedispacth.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentTypedispacth.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and SET_DocumentTypedispacth.Status = 1
inner join SET_DocumentType SET_DocumentTypeGrossweight on SET_DocumentTypeGrossweight.documenttypeid = INV_SecondWeight.documenttypeid and SET_DocumentTypeGrossweight.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentTypeGrossweight.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID and SET_DocumentTypeGrossweight.Status = 1
inner join INV_LoadingPointHeader on INV_LoadingPointHeader.DocumentNo = INV_SecondWeight.LoadingPointNo and INV_LoadingPointHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_SecondWeight.LPDocType and INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID = INV_SecondWeight.CompanyID and INV_LoadingPointHeader.PeriodID = INV_SecondWeight.PeriodID and INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID = INV_SecondWeight.CurrentFiscalID and INV_LoadingPointHeader.Status = 1 and INV_LoadingPointHeader.Statuscode = 1
WHERE INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = @StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status= 1 and Upper(SUBSTRING(SET_DocumentTypedispacth.DocumentType,CHARINDEX('-',SET_DocumentTypedispacth.DocumentType)+1,LEN(SET_DocumentTypedispacth.DocumentType))) = Upper(SUBSTRING(SET_DocumentTypeGrossweight.DocumentType,CHARINDEX('-',SET_DocumentTypeGrossweight.DocumentType)+1,LEN(SET_DocumentTypeGrossweight.DocumentType))) ) Tab Where Tab.Quantity > 0 ORDER BY Tab.StockDetailID
