data.value:
Select * from( Select ARS.CustomerName As BilledtoName, ARS.AddressLine1 AS BilledtoAddress, ARS.ZipCode As BilledtoZipCode, ARS.PhoneNumber AS BilledtoPhone, SC.CityName As BilledtoCity, SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType AS InvoiceType, (Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'R' else 'U' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'R' else 'U' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AS DispatchNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode AS DeliveryOrderNo, --SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo, case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo end as ContractNo,
DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, Case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) Then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName Else [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerNameII end as CustomerName,
--Case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) Then AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber Else [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerCNICII end as NTNNumber , Case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) Then FORMAT( Convert(int , isnull(replace(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,'-','' ),0)), '#######-#') Else format(convert(float(50), isnull(replace([SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerCNICII, '-',''),0)),'#####-#######-#') end as NTNNumber , (case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName else [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerNameII end) as InvoicedDescription, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 AS CustomerAddress, AR_SET_Customer.ZipCode AS CustomerZipCode, CityCust.CityName AS CustomerCity, AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber AS CustomerPhone, SET_Term.Description AS Terms, INV_Item.Description As ItemDescription, SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced, Sal_InvoiceHeader.Description As InvoiceComments, Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoicedTo, --Case When IsNull(SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive, 0) = 0 Then SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice -- Else SAL_InvoiceDetail.GrossAmount / SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced End As UnitPrice, --SAL_OrderDetail.Rate as UnitPrice, SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as UnitPrice, SET_Currency.CurrencySign, ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5), '') as DocumentStatus , INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemCode, SAL_InvoiceHeader.Billedtoid AS BilledTo, SAL_InvoiceDetail.DiscountAmountTaken as Discount ,SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno as CustomerRefNo , SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) ) as ExclusiveSalesTaxAmount , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SaleTaxAmount , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as ExciseDutyActualAmount , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 0 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount ,SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID, Brokername.CustomerName as DealerName, [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate as SaleOrderDate ,(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 0 else 0 end))))) As AmountReceivable,
--([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + -- (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then -- Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 -- else -- 0 end)) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate) as ActualInvoiceAmount ,SAL_ContractHeader.DTRENo, SAL_ContractHeader.DTREDate ,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)AdvanceAmount ,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)WHAdvance
,ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)FurtherTaxAdvance ,Convert(int,ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive,0))Inclusive From SAL_InvoiceDetail Inner Join SAL_InvoiceHeader ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 Left JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID
LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status=1
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Inner Join SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And INNER Join AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And And AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer Brokername ON Brokername.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID Inner Join INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID Inner Join SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceCurrencyID Left Join SET_City AS CityCust ON CityCust.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID Left Join SET_Term ON SET_Term.TermID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.TermsID Left Join SET_UnitOfMeasure ON SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID = SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID Left Join AR_SET_Customer ARS ON ARS.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And ARS.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And ARS.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.billedtoid Left Join SET_City AS SC ON SC.CityID = ARS.CityID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID where SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 And (SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = @InvoiceNoFrom or @InvoiceNoFrom is null) And (SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = @InvoiceNoTo or @InvoiceNoTo is null) And (SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null)
Union All

left Join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Status = 1
inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID

-- * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / ( 100

-- ELSE

-- END -- else 0 end -- AS SaleTaxAmount case when isnull(SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo,'') = '' then ( Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].Rate / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) ) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) else Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0) end ) else 0 end AS SaleTaxAmount , --(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount case when isnull(SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo,'') = '' then ( (Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.Rate / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount )) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) else Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount,0) end) ) else 0 end

,(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * case when COnvert(decimal(18,2),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) > 0 then COnvert(decimal(18,2),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) else (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end))end))) As AmountReceivable,
--,Round((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced ) * ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.Rate,SAL_OrderDetail.Rate) ),0) As AmountReceivable,
--,case when isnull(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive,0) > 0 --then SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive --else ((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced ) * ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.Rate,SAL_OrderDetail.Rate) )) -- end as AmountReceivable,
--([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + -- (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then -- Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 -- else -- 0 end)) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate) as ActualInvoiceAmount ,SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo, SAL_OrderHeader.DTREDate ,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)AdvanceAmount ,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)WHAdvance
,ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)FurtherTaxAdvance ,Convert(int,ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive,0))Inclusive From SAL_InvoiceDetail Inner Join SAL_InvoiceHeader ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 Left JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID
LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status=1

Left Join SET_City AS SC ON SC.CityID = ARS.CityID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID where SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 And (SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = @InvoiceNoFrom or @InvoiceNoFrom is null) And (SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = @InvoiceNoTo or @InvoiceNoTo is null) --And (SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null) --And (SAL_ContractHeader.BrokerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null) AND (ISNULL(SAL_ContractHeader.BrokerID,SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID) = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null)

SELECT Distinct [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType as InvoiceType ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceDate,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].Description ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceNumber, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo as DeliveryOrderNo --,Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced as Quantity --, (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount , --case when isnull(SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo,'') = '' --then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) --else 0 end case when isnull(SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo,'') = '' then ( Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) ) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) else Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0) end ) else 0 end as SaleTaxAmount , --(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount) case when isnull(SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo,'') = '' then ( (Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount )) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) else Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount,0) end) ) else 0 end
as FEDTaxAmount , ((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding)) as WithHoldingAmount ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced ,INV_Item.UnitWeight
, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SalesTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding as WithHoldingTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as ExciseDutyAmountTaxPer ,[SAL_ContractHeader].DTRENo , [SAL_ContractHeader].DTREDate --,Round((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight) * [SAL_OrderDetail].PriceperKG),0) As AmountReceivable ,((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced ) * ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.Rate,SAL_OrderDetail.Rate) )) As AmountReceivable ,SET_Business.BusinessName as SupplierName ,SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName as SupplierNameComplete ,SET_Business.AddressLine1 as SupplierAddress ,SET_Business.NTNNumber as SupplierNTN, SET_Business.PhoneNumber as SupplierPhoneNumber , SET_Business.SalesTaxNumber as SupplierSTRN, [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid, BC.CustomerName as BIllTo,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName --,AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 as CustomerAddress, ,(case when isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter,0) =1 or isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) = 1 then AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 else [SAL_DispatchHeader].BiltyAddress end) as CustomerAddress, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as CustomerNTN,AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber as CustomerPhoneNumber ,AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber as CustomeSTRN --,AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber, ,case when isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter,0) =1 or isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) = 1 then AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber else [SAL_DispatchHeader].DriverCNIC end as CNICNumber, [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo as DispatchNo,INV_Item.Description as ItemDescription ,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemStatusCode,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,Abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity]) AS [BaseQuantity] --,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].Transactioncost as UnitPrice ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as UnitPrice ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],[SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount, [SAL_OrderDetail].[T_GrossAmount], --((isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount,0)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0)) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100 as TaxPayable (isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].NetAmount,0) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount]) as TaxPayable
,--[SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount + (isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[GrossAmount],0) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100 as TotalAmount ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount + ((isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount,0)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0)) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0) as TotalAmount ,SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage as LogoImage ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerAddress as Shipto,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].Description as DescriptionTagNo, SAL_InvoiceDetail.DiscountAmountTaken ,(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( --Case When -- DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then -- 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1) +'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then '000' +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) -- else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+ substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' -- else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'R' else 'U' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) -- end ) as SINumber ,SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno as CustomerRefNo ,SET_Business.AddressLine1 ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding AS WithHolding ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount AS NetAmount --,SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo AS ContractNo ,case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo end as ContractNo
--,SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate AS ContractDate, ,case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate end as ContractDate,
--case when SAL_OrderDetail.inclusive= '0' then SAL_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount else --( SAL_OrderDetail.GrossAmount - ((([SAL_OrderDetail].[T_GrossAmount]/100)* [SAL_OrderDetail].[SalesTaxAmount])+ --(SAL_OrderDetail.ExciseDutyActualAmount) + (SAL_OrderDetail.WithHoldingAmount))) end as ActualInvoiceAmount, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount, SAL_OrderDetail.GrossAmount As TAmountReceivable, SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID, --Brokername.CustomerName as BrokerName case when isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter,0) =1 or isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) = 1 then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName else [SAL_DispatchHeader].DriverName end as BrokerName ,SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 as UnitAddress, ,ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive,SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive)Inclusive ,ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.Rate,SAL_OrderDetail.Rate) PricePerKG ,SAL_ContractHeader.CustomerPoNo , SAL_ContractHeader.CustomerPoDate ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].GatePassNo ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].GatePassNo as DeliveryChallanNo ,SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage as LogoImage, Set_Batch.Description as CropYear ,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID),0)AdvanceAmount ,SAL_ContractHeader.AdvTaxInvoiceNo,SAL_ContractHeader.AdvTaxInvoicedate FROM [SAL_InvoiceHeader] INNER JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] On [SAL_InvoiceDetail].InvoiceHeaderID =[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].CompanyID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].PeriodID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].ItemID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID -- inner join Set_PeriodCustom spc_dispatch on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between spc_dispatch.StartDate and spc_dispatch.EndDate --and spc_dispatch.Status = 1 and spc_dispatch.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID Left JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID left join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1 left join [SAL_OrderDetail] on [SAL_OrderDetail].OrderID =SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 And SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
left JOIN INV_SET_Category On INV_SET_Category.CategoryID =INV_Item.ItemTypeID --AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID =INV_Item.CompanyID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer BC ON BC.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer Brokername ON Brokername.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID and Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And left JOin SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.uomId=[SAL_InvoiceDetail].ItemUnitID And SET_UnitofMeasure.status=1 left join Set_Batch on Set_Batch.BatchID = SAL_ContractHeader.Season WHERE [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[Status] = 1 AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID is null)

Select TAB.InvoiceID, TAB.BuyerNTN, TAB.BuyerCNICNo,TAB.BuyerName, TAB.CustomerCategoryID, TAB.CustomerCategory, TAB.Provinceid, TAB.ProvinceName, TAB.InvoiceType,TAB.DocumentType, TAB.InvoiceNumber , TAB.DocumentDate, TAB.SaleType, --SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as Rate, TAB.Rate, TAB.ItemID, --Inv_Item.Description as ItemName, TAB.ItemName, Sum(Quantity) as Quantity, TAB.UOMName, TAB.WithHolding, TAB.TaxAmount, TAB.ExciseDutyAmount, TAB.FEDAmount, SUM(FixedSalesTaxAmount) as FixedSalesTaxAmount, Round(SUM( SaleTaxAmount),0) as SaleTaxAmount, Sum(TAB.ValueTaxAmountReturn) as ValueSaleReturn, Round(SUM(FurtherTaxAmount),0) as FurtherTaxAmount, SUM(FEDTaxAmount) as FEDTaxAmount, SUM(WithHoldingAmount) as WithHoldingAmount, SUM(AmountReceivable) as AmountReceivable , SUM(ActualInvoiceAmount) as ActualInvoiceAmount, TAB.BuyerSTRNNumber, TAB.CompanyName, TAB.CompanyAddressLine1, TAB.CompanyAddressLine2, TAB.CompanyAddressLine3, TAB.CompanyZipCode, TAB.CompanyCity, TAB.CompanyPhone, TAB.Logoimage, TAB.CompanyFax,TAB.NetAmount,Round (TAB.TaxPayable ,0) as TaxPayable ,TAB.ExciseDutyActualAmount from ( Select SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as BuyerNTN,
Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 then AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber Else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII end as BuyerCNICNo, Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName Else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerNameII end as BuyerName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID, --Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory, case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'EXPORTER' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'REGISTERED' else 'UNREGISTERED' end) end as CustomerCategory, AR_SET_Customer.Provinceid, case When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 1 then 'Balochistan' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 2 then 'KPK' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 3 then 'Punjab' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 4 then 'Sindh' else 'Other' end As ProvinceName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType, --Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, 'SI' as DocumentType,
(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber , SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate, 'Goods at standard rate (default)' as SaleType, --SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as Rate, Convert(varchar(20), convert(int, Round(SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,2))) +' %' as Rate, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID, --Inv_Item.Description as ItemName, Case --When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Molasses%' then '1703 - Molasses resulting from the extraction or refining of sugar' When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Billet%' then '7207A - IRON & NON-ALLOY STEEL BILLETS' end as ItemName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.Quantityinvoiced as Quantity, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount,
Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) ),2) as FixedSalesTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount)) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) as SaleTaxAmount ,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice) as ValueTaxAmountReturn, (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount )) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) as FurtherTaxAmount , Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount,2) as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount, Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))),2) As AmountReceivable, Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) ),0) as ActualInvoiceAmount, AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber as BuyerSTRNNumber, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax , SAL_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount AS NetAmount, ((isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount,0)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0)) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100 as TaxPayable , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount from SAL_InvoiceHeader Inner Join SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status=1 Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID --AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1 inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 inner Join SAL_DispatchHeader on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status=1
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID --And AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Left Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.Status = 1 inner Join Set_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID inner Join Inv_Item on Inv_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID --AND Inv_Item.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND Inv_Item.Status = 1 inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID where SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 And (SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null) And (SAL_ContractHeader.BrokerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null) AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND InvoiceType in (280) )TAB
Group BY TAB.InvoiceID, TAB.BuyerNTN, TAB.BuyerCNICNo,TAB.BuyerName, TAB.CustomerCategoryID, TAB.CustomerCategory, TAB.Provinceid, TAB.ProvinceName, TAB.InvoiceType,TAB.DocumentType, TAB.InvoiceNumber , TAB.DocumentDate, TAB.SaleType, TAB.Rate, TAB.ItemID, TAB.ItemName, TAB.UOMName, TAB.WithHolding, TAB.TaxAmount, TAB.ExciseDutyAmount, TAb.FEDAmount, TAB.BuyerSTRNNumber, TAB.CompanyName, TAB.CompanyAddressLine1, TAB.CompanyAddressLine2, TAB.CompanyAddressLine3, TAB.CompanyZipCode, TAB.CompanyCity, TAB.CompanyPhone, TAB.Logoimage, TAB.CompanyFax ,TAB.NetAmount,TAB.TaxPayable,TAB.ExciseDutyActualAmount Order By TAB.CustomerCategory, TAB.InvoiceNumber

AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) ),0) as ActualInvoiceAmount, AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber as BuyerSTRNNumber, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax , SAL_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount AS NetAmount, ((isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount,0)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0)) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100 as TaxPayable , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount ,SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo ,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as DealerName from SAL_InvoiceHeader Inner Join SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status=1 Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID --AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 inner Join SAL_DispatchHeader on SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID --And AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Left Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.Status = 1 inner Join Set_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID inner Join Inv_Item on Inv_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID --AND Inv_Item.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND Inv_Item.Status = 1 inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID where SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 And (SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null) And (SAL_ContractHeader.BrokerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null) AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between @FromDate and @ToDate

--Declare @CurrentFiscalID int = 1 -- Declare @CompanyID int = 1 --Declare @PeriodID int = 1 --Declare @FromDate datetime = '2019-10-01 00:00:00:000' --Declare @ToDate datetime = '2020-05-28 00:00:00:000'
--Declare @CurrentFiscalID int = 3 --Declare @CompanyID int = 2 --Declare @PeriodID int = 1 --Declare @FromDate datetime = '2019-10-01 00:00:00:000' --Declare @ToDate datetime = '2020-06-03 00:00:00:000'
Select FinalTAB.CompanyName,RTrim(Ltrim(FinalTAB.CustomerName)) as CustomerName,Count(distinct FinalTAB.InvoiceNumber) as InvoiceNumber,SUM(FinalTAB.QuantityInvoiced) as QuantityInvoiced ,SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) as SaleTaxAmount ,SUM(FinalTAB.ExciseDutyActualAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount ,SUM(FinalTAB.AdvanceAmount) as AdvanceAmount ,SUM(FinalTAB.AmountReceivable) as AmountReceivable ,SUM(FinalTAB.FurtherTaxAdvance) as FurtherTaxAdvance ,SUM(FinalTAB.WithHoldingAmount) as WithHoldingAmount --,FinalTAB.DocumentType ,FinalTAB.Inclusive ,avg(FinalTAB.AvgRate) as AvgRate from ( Select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as CustomerName , SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate --, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1 --, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2 --, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3 , SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced ,(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'R' else 'U' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'R' else 'U' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber
-- , SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as UnitPrice -- ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount -- , SET_Currency.CurrencySign -- , SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount -- , SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount --, SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding --,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) ) as ExclusiveSalesTaxAmount
, case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sales Invoice - Billet%' then ((Round((SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice),0) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount)) when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sales Invoice - Ethanol%' then ((Round((SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice),0) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) / (100 )) when set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Molasses%' then ( case when SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo is null then CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate > '2019-07-01'
AND SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG > case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) then 70.2 else 70.2 end
AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%'
)

( ( ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced
* ( INV_Item.UnitWeight
* ( isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG)
--+ ( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01'
-- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%'

-- ) THEN 3.60

- ( ( ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced
* ( INV_Item.UnitWeight
* ( isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG)
--+ ( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01'
-- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%'
-- AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0
-- ) THEN 3.60
-- ELSE 0
-- END ) ) ) )
* ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) )
/ ( 100
+ [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) )
* [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / ( 100
+ [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount )
ELSE
(( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced
* SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate
* [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / 100 ))
END else 0 end ) else case when SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo is null then CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate > '2019-07-01'
AND SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG > case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) then 70.2 else 70.2 end
AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%'
)
THEN
( ( ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced
* ( INV_Item.UnitWeight
* ( isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG)
) )) )
- ( ( ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced
* ( INV_Item.UnitWeight
* ( isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG)
) ) )
* ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) )
/ ( 100
+ [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) )
* [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / ( 100
+ [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount )
ELSE
(( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced
* SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate
* [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / 100 ))
END else 0 end
end AS SaleTaxAmount
, case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sales Invoice - Billet%' then ((Round((SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice),0) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount)) else (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) end as ExciseDutyActualAmount -- , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount -- ,SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID, --Brokername.CustomerName as DealerName, --case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate end as SaleOrderDate
,
case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sales Invoice - Bagasse%' then Round((SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice),0) +
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sales Invoice - Billet%' then ((Round((SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice),0) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount)) else case when SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo is null then CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate > '2019-07-01'
AND SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG > case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) then 70.2 else 70.2 end
AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%'
)
THEN
( ( ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced
* ( INV_Item.UnitWeight
* ( isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG)
) )) )
- ( ( ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced
* ( INV_Item.UnitWeight
* ( isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG)
) ) )
* ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) )
/ ( 100
+ [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) )
* [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / ( 100
+ [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount )
ELSE
(( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced
* SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate
* [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / 100 ))
END else 0 end
end )
+ ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sales Invoice - Billet%' then ((Round((SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice),0) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount)) else (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) end ) + ( (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) ) when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sales Invoice - Billet%' then Round((SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice),0) when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Molasses%' then ( (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * case when ( COnvert(decimal(18,2),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) > 0 and isnull((select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and CurrentFiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID and CompanyID = @CompanyID and PeriodID = @PeriodID and Status = 1),0) > 0 ) then COnvert(decimal(18,2),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) else (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG )end))) ) else case when isnull(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive,0) > 0 then SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive else ((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced ) * ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.Rate,SAL_OrderDetail.Rate) )) end end as AmountReceivable
-- ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate) as ActualInvoiceAmount --,SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo, --SAL_OrderHeader.DTREDate ,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)AdvanceAmount --,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 --and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID --and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID --and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)WHAdvance
,ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)FurtherTaxAdvance ,Convert(int,ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive,0))Inclusive ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.unitprice as AvgRate From SAL_InvoiceDetail Inner Join SAL_InvoiceHeader ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 Left JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID
LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status=1
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Inner Join SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID INNER Join AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer Brokername ON Brokername.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID Inner Join INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID Inner Join SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceCurrencyID Left Join SET_City AS CityCust ON CityCust.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID Left Join SET_Term ON SET_Term.TermID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.TermsID Left Join SET_UnitOfMeasure ON SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID = SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID Left Join AR_SET_Customer ARS ON ARS.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.billedtoid
Left Join SET_City AS SC ON SC.CityID = ARS.CityID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID where SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType in @DocumentTypeID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1
Union All

-- SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, -- SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, -- SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, 0 as QuantityInvoiced, --SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, -- SET_DocumentType.DocumentType AS InvoiceType, (Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'R' else 'U' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'R' else 'U' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber -- 0 AS DispatchNo, -- 0 AS DeliveryOrderNo, 0 as ContractNo,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName,
-- FORMAT( Convert(int , isnull(replace(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,'-','' ),0)), '#######-#') as NTNNumber, -- '' as InvoicedDescription, -- AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 AS CustomerAddress, AR_SET_Customer.ZipCode AS CustomerZipCode, CityCust.CityName AS CustomerCity, -- AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber AS CustomerPhone, --'' AS Terms, '' As ItemDescription, '' as UOMName,
-- , Sal_InvoiceHeader.Description As InvoiceComments, Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoicedTo, -- 0 as UnitPrice, -- 0 as TaxAmount, SET_Currency.CurrencySign, -- 0 as ExciseDutyAmount, 0 as FEDAmount, -- ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5), '') -- as DocumentStatus , '0' as ItemCode, SAL_InvoiceHeader.Billedtoid AS BilledTo, 0 as Discount -- ,'0' as CustomerRefNo -- , 0 as WithHolding, -- 0 as ExclusiveSalesTaxAmount , 0 as SaleTaxAmount , 0 as ExciseDutyActualAmount -- , 0 as FEDTaxAmount , 0 as WithHoldingAmount -- ,0 as BrokerID, --'' as DealerName, --'' as SaleOrderDate , case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sales Invoice - Billet%' then 0 --(SAL_InvoiceDetail.Quantity * SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice) else Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount end as AmountReceivable
-- Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount as ActualInvoiceAmount --,'0' as DTRENo, --SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DTREDate ,0 as AdvanceAmount --,0 ,0 as FurtherTaxAdvance
,Convert(int,0)Inclusive ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,0 as AvgRate from SAL_InvoiceHeader
left Join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Status = 1
inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID
Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId
Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId
Inner Join SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType
Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID Inner Join AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID
Inner Join SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceCurrencyID
Left Join SET_City AS CityCust ON CityCust.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID Left Join SET_Term ON SET_Term.TermID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.TermsID Left Join AR_SET_Customer ARS ON ARS.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.billedtoid
Left Join SET_City AS SC ON SC.CityID = ARS.CityID
left join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
where SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType in @DocumentTypeID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1
)FinalTAB Where FinalTAB.InvoiceDate between @FromDate and @ToDate group by FinalTAB.CompanyName,RTrim(Ltrim(FinalTAB.CustomerName)) ,FinalTAB.Inclusive Order bY RTrim(Ltrim(FinalTAB.CustomerName)) asc
