, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount ,SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID, Brokername.CustomerName as DealerName, --[SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate as SaleOrderDate case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate end as SaleOrderDate
,(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * case when COnvert(decimal(18,2),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) > 0 then COnvert(decimal(18,2),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) else (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end))end))) As AmountReceivable,
([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate) as ActualInvoiceAmount ,SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo, SAL_OrderHeader.DTREDate ,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)AdvanceAmount ,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)WHAdvance
,ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)FurtherTaxAdvance ,Convert(int,ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive,0))Inclusive From SAL_InvoiceDetail Inner Join SAL_InvoiceHeader ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 Left JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID
LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status=1
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Inner Join SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And INNER Join AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID --AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And -- And AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer Brokername ON Brokername.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID -- AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID Inner Join INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID Inner Join SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceCurrencyID Left Join SET_City AS CityCust ON CityCust.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID Left Join SET_Term ON SET_Term.TermID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.TermsID Left Join SET_UnitOfMeasure ON SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID = SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID Left Join AR_SET_Customer ARS ON ARS.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.billedtoid --And ARS.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And ARS.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
Left Join SET_City AS SC ON SC.CityID = ARS.CityID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 --and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
where SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 {2} --and INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
Union All
Select SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName,SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID,SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID, Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName, '' As BilledtoName, '' AS BilledtoAddress, '' As BilledtoZipCode, '' AS BilledtoPhone, '' As BilledtoCity, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID as InvoiceHeaderID, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType AS InvoiceType, (Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber, 0 AS DispatchNo, 0 AS DeliveryOrderNo, 0 as ContractNo,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as CustomerName, FORMAT( Convert(int , isnull(replace(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,'-','' ),0)), '#######-#') as NTNNumber, '' as InvoicedDescription, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 AS CustomerAddress, AR_SET_Customer.ZipCode AS CustomerZipCode, CityCust.CityName AS CustomerCity, AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber AS CustomerPhone, '' AS Terms, '' As ItemDescription, '' as UOMName, 0 as QuantityInvoiced, Sal_InvoiceHeader.Description As InvoiceComments, Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoicedTo, 0 as UnitPrice, 0 as TaxAmount, SET_Currency.CurrencySign, 0 as ExciseDutyAmount, 0 as FEDAmount, ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5), '') as DocumentStatus , '0' as ItemCode, SAL_InvoiceHeader.Billedtoid AS BilledTo, 0 as Discount ,'0' as CustomerRefNo , 0 as WithHolding, 0 as ExclusiveSalesTaxAmount , 0 as SaleTaxAmount , 0 as ExciseDutyActualAmount , 0 as FEDTaxAmount , 0 as WithHoldingAmount ,0 as BrokerID, '' as DealerName, '' as SaleOrderDate , Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount as AmountReceivable,
Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount as ActualInvoiceAmount ,'0' as DTRENo, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DTREDate ,0 as AdvanceAmount,0,0 ,Convert(int,0)Inclusive from SAL_InvoiceHeader
left Join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Status = 1
inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID
Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId
Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId
Inner Join SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType
Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID Inner Join AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID --AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And
Inner Join SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceCurrencyID
Left Join SET_City AS CityCust ON CityCust.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID Left Join SET_Term ON SET_Term.TermID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.TermsID Left Join AR_SET_Customer ARS ON ARS.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.billedtoid --AND ARS.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And ARS.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
Left Join SET_City AS SC ON SC.CityID = ARS.CityID
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 --and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
where SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 --And SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sales Invoice%Mud%' {2} --and SAL_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
)FinalTAB Where FinalTAB.InvoiceDate between @FromDate and @ToDate group by FinalTAB.PeriodSetName, FinalTAB.Inclusive,FinalTAB.InvoiceDate ,FinalTAB.OperatingUnitName,FinalTAB.CompanyID,FinalTAB.PeriodID )Tab
)Fintab group by Fintab.mnth,Fintab.Months,Fintab.OperatingUnitName,Fintab.CompanyID,Fintab.PeriodID
)FinalFintab Group By FinalFintab.mnth,FinalFintab.Months, FinalFintab.CompanyID, FinalFintab.PeriodID,FinalFintab.OperatingUnitName Order By FinalFintab.mnth

data.name: Query_Monthly_Summary_Sales__Bagasse_Report
data.value:
--Declare @CurrentFiscalID int = 5 --Declare @PeriodID int = 1 --Declare @FromDate datetime = '2020-10-01 00:00:00:000' --Declare @ToDate datetime = '2021-03-31 00:00:00:000'
Select FinalFintab.mnth, FinalFintab.Months, FinalFintab.OperatingUnitName, FinalFintab.CompanyID, FinalFintab.PeriodID, Sum(QuantityInvoiced) as QuantityInvoiced, Sum(CalNetAmount) as CalNetAmount, SUM(GrossAmount) as GrossAmount, SUM(NetAmount) as NetAmount, SUM(T_GrossAmount) as T_GrossAmount, SUM(ExciseDutyActualAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount, SUM(SaleTaxAmount) as SaleTaxAmount, SUM(AmountReceivable) as AmountReceivable, Sum(Amount) - SUM(FinalFintab.SecurityDeposit) as ReceiptAmount ,SUM(FinalFintab.QtySold) as QtySold ,SUM(FinalFintab.TotalSaleRs) as TotalSaleRs ,SUM(FinalFintab.SecurityDeposit) as SecurityDeposit from (
Select 0 as mnth, 'Opening Balance' as Months, Fintab.OperatingUnitName, Fintab.CompanyID, Fintab.PeriodID, Sum(QuantityInvoiced) as QuantityInvoiced, Sum(CalNetAmount) as CalNetAmount, SUM(GrossAmount) as GrossAmount, SUM(NetAmount) as NetAmount, SUM(T_GrossAmount) as T_GrossAmount, SUM(ExciseDutyActualAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount, SUM(SaleTaxAmount) as SaleTaxAmount, SUM(AmountReceivable) as AmountReceivable, Sum(Amount) as Amount ,Sum(Fintab.QtySold)as QtySold ,SUM(Fintab.TotalSaleRs) as TotalSaleRs ,SUM(Fintab.SecurityDeposit) as SecurityDeposit
from ( Select Datepart(Month, SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate) as mnth, concat(FORMAT(SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate,'MMM') ,' - ',DATEPART(YEAR, SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate)) as Months, SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID,SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID,
0 as QuantityInvoiced, 0 as TotalSale, 0 as AmountReceived,
0 AS CalNetAmount, 0 as GrossAmount, 0 as NetAmount, 0 as T_GrossAmount, 0 as ExciseDutyActualAmount ,0 as SaleTaxAmount, 0 As AmountReceivable ,0 as Amount , SAL_OrderDetail.Quantity as QtySold ,SAL_OrderDetail.NetAmount as TotalSaleRs ,0 as SecurityDeposit
--, SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG
from SAL_OrderHeader
inner Join SAL_OrderDetail on SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID And SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID And SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID And SAL_OrderDetail.Status=1
left Join SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail on SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID And SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status=1
left Join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID And SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.Status=1 and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.StatusCode=1
Inner Join INV_Item On INV_Item.ItemID= SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID= SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status=1 Inner Join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID= SAL_OrderHeader.SaleContractTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID= SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID= SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID And SET_DocumentType.Status=1
Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status=1
Left Join AR_SET_Customer Set_Broker on Set_Broker.CustomerID=SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID --AND Set_Broker.CompanyID = SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID AND Set_Broker.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID And Set_Broker.Status=1
INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1
INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 Where SAL_OrderHeader.Status=1 And SAL_OrderHeader.StatusCode=1 And SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID And SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID= @PeriodID --And SAL_OrderHeader.FiscalID= @CurrentFiscalID and Cast(SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate as Date) < @FromDate --And [SAL_OrderHeader].SaleContractTypeID =158 {1} )Fintab Group By Fintab.mnth,Fintab.Months, Fintab.CompanyID, Fintab.PeriodID,Fintab.OperatingUnitName
Union All
Select 0 as mnth,'Opening Balance' as Months, Fin.OperatingUnitName, Fin.CompanyID, Fin.PeriodID, 0 as QuantityInvoiced, 0 AS CalNetAmount, 0 as GrossAmount, 0 as NetAmount, 0 as T_GrossAmount, 0 as ExciseDutyActualAmount ,0 as SaleTaxAmount, 0 As AmountReceivable, Sum(Fin.Amount) as Amount ,0 as QtySold ,0 as TotalSaleRs ,0 as SecurityDeposit from ( Select Datepart(Month, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) as mnth, concat(FORMAT(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,'MMM') ,' - ',DATEPART(YEAR, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)) as Months, SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID, 0 as QuantityInvoiced, 0 AS CalNetAmount, 0 as GrossAmount, 0 as NetAmount, 0 as T_GrossAmount, 0 as ExciseDutyActualAmount ,0 as SaleTaxAmount, 0 As AmountReceivable ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount as Amount ,0 as QtySold ,0 as TotalSaleRs ,0 as SecurityDeposit From AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1
INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 Where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = (Select top 1 DocumentTypeID from SET_DocumentType Where SET_DocumentType.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND DocumentType like 'Direct%Receipt%Mud%') AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID --AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate )Fin Group By Fin.OperatingUnitName, Fin.CompanyID, Fin.PeriodID
Union All
Select 0 as mnth,'Opening Balance' as Months, Fin.OperatingUnitName, Fin.CompanyID, Fin.PeriodID, 0 as QuantityInvoiced, 0 AS CalNetAmount, 0 as GrossAmount, 0 as NetAmount, 0 as T_GrossAmount, 0 as ExciseDutyActualAmount ,0 as SaleTaxAmount, 0 As AmountReceivable, 0 as Amount ,0 as QtySold ,0 as TotalSaleRs ,Sum(Fin.SecurityDeposit) as SecurityDeposit from ( Select Datepart(Month, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) as mnth, concat(FORMAT(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,'MMM') ,' - ',DATEPART(YEAR, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)) as Months, SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID, 0 as QuantityInvoiced, 0 AS CalNetAmount, 0 as GrossAmount, 0 as NetAmount, 0 as T_GrossAmount, 0 as ExciseDutyActualAmount ,0 as SaleTaxAmount, 0 As AmountReceivable ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount as Amount ,0 as QtySold ,0 as TotalSaleRs ,isnull(AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount,0) as SecurityDeposit From AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1
INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
inner join AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail on AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.FiscalID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.FiscalID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Status = 1
inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description like '%SECURITY DEPOSITS - OTHERS%'
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1
Where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = (Select top 1 DocumentTypeID from SET_DocumentType Where SET_DocumentType.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND DocumentType like 'Direct%Receipt%Mud%') AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID --AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate )Fin Group By Fin.OperatingUnitName, Fin.CompanyID, Fin.PeriodID
Union ALL
Select 0 as mnth, 'Opening Balance' as Months, Fintab.OperatingUnitName, Fintab.CompanyID, Fintab.PeriodID, Sum(Fintab.QuantityInvoiced) as QuantityInvoiced, 0 as CalNetAmount, SUM(Fintab.AmountReceivable) as GrossAmount, SUM(Fintab.TotalAmountReceivable) as NetAmount, 0 as T_GrossAmount, SUM(Fintab.ExciseDutyActualAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount, SUM(Fintab.SaleTaxAmount) as SaleTaxAmount, 0 as AmountReceivable, 0 as Amount ,0as QtySold ,0 as TotalSaleRs ,0 as SecurityDeposit
from (
select Datepart(Month, Tab.InvoiceDate) as mnth, concat(FORMAT(Tab.InvoiceDate,'MMM') ,' - ',DATEPART(YEAR, Tab.InvoiceDate)) as Months, Tab.OperatingUnitName, Tab.CompanyID,Tab.PeriodID, Tab.PeriodSetName, ( case when Tab.f_SaleTaxAmount > 0 or Tab.SaleTaxAmount = 0 then (Tab.f_Value_Inclusive - (Tab.SaleTaxAmount+Tab.ExciseDutyActualAmount) ) else 0 end ) as AmountReceivable , Tab.f_SaleTaxAmount as SaleTaxAmount, Tab.ExciseDutyActualAmount as ExciseDutyActualAmount, Tab.AdvanceAmount as AdvanceAmount , Tab.Inclusive
, Tab.f_Total_Amount_Receivable as TotalAmountReceivable
,Tab.QuantityInvoiced as QuantityInvoiced from (
Select FinalTAB.PeriodSetName ,SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) as SaleTaxAmount , SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) - SUM(FinalTAB.AdvanceAmount) as f_SaleTaxAmount , SUM(FinalTAB.ExciseDutyActualAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount , SUM(FinalTAB.AdvanceAmount) as AdvanceAmount , FinalTAB.Inclusive
,(case when FinalTAB.Inclusive = 0 then
case when ( (SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) - SUM(FinalTAB.AdvanceAmount)) > 0 OR SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) = 0 ) then round(SUM(FinalTAB.AmountReceivable) + SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) + SUM(FinalTAB.ExciseDutyActualAmount),0) else 0 end
when ( (SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) - SUM(FinalTAB.AdvanceAmount)) > 0 OR SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) = 0 ) then round(SUM(FinalTAB.AmountReceivable),0) else 0 end ) as f_Total_Amount_Receivable
, case when ( (SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) - SUM(FinalTAB.AdvanceAmount)) > 0 OR SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) = 0 ) then round((case when FinalTAB.Inclusive = 0 then
case when ( (SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) - SUM(FinalTAB.AdvanceAmount)) > 0 OR SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) = 0 ) then round(SUM(FinalTAB.AmountReceivable) + SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) + SUM(FinalTAB.ExciseDutyActualAmount),0) else 0 end

Where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = (Select top 1 DocumentTypeID from SET_DocumentType Where SET_DocumentType.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND DocumentType like 'Direct%Receipt%Mud%') AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID --AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate AND @ToDate)Fin Group By Fin.mnth,Fin.Months, Fin.OperatingUnitName, Fin.CompanyID, Fin.PeriodID
Union All
Select Fin.mnth,Fin.Months, Fin.OperatingUnitName, Fin.CompanyID, Fin.PeriodID, 0 as QuantityInvoiced, 0 AS CalNetAmount, 0 as GrossAmount, 0 as NetAmount, 0 as T_GrossAmount, 0 as ExciseDutyActualAmount ,0 as SaleTaxAmount, 0 As AmountReceivable, 0 as Amount ,0 as QtySold ,0 as TotalSaleRs ,Sum(Fin.SecurityDeposit) as SecurityDeposit from ( Select Datepart(Month, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) as mnth, concat(FORMAT(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,'MMM') ,' - ',DATEPART(YEAR, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)) as Months, SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID, 0 as QuantityInvoiced, 0 AS CalNetAmount, 0 as GrossAmount, 0 as NetAmount, 0 as T_GrossAmount, 0 as ExciseDutyActualAmount ,0 as SaleTaxAmount, 0 As AmountReceivable ,0 as Amount ,0 as QtySold ,0 as TotalSaleRs ,Isnull(AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount,0) as SecurityDeposit From AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1
INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
inner join AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail on AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.FiscalID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.FiscalID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Status = 1
inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description like '%SECURITY DEPOSITS - OTHERS%'
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1
Where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = (Select top 1 DocumentTypeID from SET_DocumentType Where SET_DocumentType.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND DocumentType like 'Direct%Receipt%Mud%') AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID --AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate Between @FromDate AND @ToDate)Fin Group By Fin.mnth,Fin.Months, Fin.OperatingUnitName, Fin.CompanyID, Fin.PeriodID
Union ALL
Select Fintab.mnth, Fintab.Months, Fintab.OperatingUnitName, Fintab.CompanyID, Fintab.PeriodID, Sum(Fintab.QuantityInvoiced) as QuantityInvoiced, 0 as CalNetAmount, SUM(Fintab.AmountReceivable) as GrossAmount, SUM(Fintab.TotalAmountReceivable) as NetAmount, 0 as T_GrossAmount, SUM(Fintab.ExciseDutyActualAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount, SUM(Fintab.SaleTaxAmount) as SaleTaxAmount, 0 as AmountReceivable, 0 as Amount ,0as QtySold ,0 as TotalSaleRs ,0 as SecurityDeposit
from (
select Datepart(Month, Tab.InvoiceDate) as mnth, concat(FORMAT(Tab.InvoiceDate,'MMM') ,' - ',DATEPART(YEAR, Tab.InvoiceDate)) as Months, Tab.OperatingUnitName, Tab.CompanyID,Tab.PeriodID, Tab.PeriodSetName, ( case when Tab.f_SaleTaxAmount > 0 or Tab.SaleTaxAmount = 0 then (Tab.f_Value_Inclusive - (Tab.SaleTaxAmount+Tab.ExciseDutyActualAmount) ) else 0 end ) as AmountReceivable , Tab.f_SaleTaxAmount as SaleTaxAmount, Tab.ExciseDutyActualAmount as ExciseDutyActualAmount, Tab.AdvanceAmount as AdvanceAmount , Tab.Inclusive
, Tab.f_Total_Amount_Receivable as TotalAmountReceivable
,Tab.QuantityInvoiced as QuantityInvoiced from (
Select FinalTAB.PeriodSetName ,SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) as SaleTaxAmount , SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) - SUM(FinalTAB.AdvanceAmount) as f_SaleTaxAmount , SUM(FinalTAB.ExciseDutyActualAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount , SUM(FinalTAB.AdvanceAmount) as AdvanceAmount , FinalTAB.Inclusive
,(case when FinalTAB.Inclusive = 0 then
case when ( (SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) - SUM(FinalTAB.AdvanceAmount)) > 0 OR SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) = 0 ) then round(SUM(FinalTAB.AmountReceivable) + SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) + SUM(FinalTAB.ExciseDutyActualAmount),0) else 0 end
when ( (SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) - SUM(FinalTAB.AdvanceAmount)) > 0 OR SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) = 0 ) then round(SUM(FinalTAB.AmountReceivable),0) else 0 end ) as f_Total_Amount_Receivable
, case when ( (SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) - SUM(FinalTAB.AdvanceAmount)) > 0 OR SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) = 0 ) then round((case when FinalTAB.Inclusive = 0 then
case when ( (SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) - SUM(FinalTAB.AdvanceAmount)) > 0 OR SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) = 0 ) then round(SUM(FinalTAB.AmountReceivable) + SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) + SUM(FinalTAB.ExciseDutyActualAmount),0) else 0 end
when ( (SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) - SUM(FinalTAB.AdvanceAmount)) > 0 OR SUM(FinalTAB.SaleTaxAmount) = 0 ) then round(SUM(FinalTAB.AmountReceivable),0) else 0 end ) - SUM(FinalTab.WithHoldingAmount),0)
else 0 end as f_Value_Inclusive
,SUM(isnull(FinalTab.QuantityInvoiced,0)) as QuantityInvoiced ,FinalTab.InvoiceDate ,FinalTab.OperatingUnitName ,FinalTab.CompanyID,FinalTab.PeriodID from ( Select distinct SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName,SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID,SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID,Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName, ARS.CustomerName As BilledtoName, ARS.AddressLine1 AS BilledtoAddress, ARS.ZipCode As BilledtoZipCode, ARS.PhoneNumber AS BilledtoPhone, SC.CityName As BilledtoCity, SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType AS InvoiceType, (Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AS DispatchNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode AS DeliveryOrderNo ,case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo end ContractNo ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, Case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) Then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName Else [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerNameII end as CustomerName,
--Case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) Then AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber Else [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerCNICII end as NTNNumber , Case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) Then --FORMAT( Convert(int , isnull(replace(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,'-','' ),0)), '#######-#') isnull(replace(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,'-','' ),0) Else format(convert(float(50), isnull(replace([SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerCNICII, '-',''),0)),'#####-#######-#') end as NTNNumber , (case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName else [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerNameII end) as InvoicedDescription, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 AS CustomerAddress, AR_SET_Customer.ZipCode AS CustomerZipCode, CityCust.CityName AS CustomerCity, AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber AS CustomerPhone, SET_Term.Description AS Terms, INV_Item.Description As ItemDescription, SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced, Sal_InvoiceHeader.Description As InvoiceComments, Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoicedTo,
SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as UnitPrice, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, SET_Currency.CurrencySign, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount, ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5), '') as DocumentStatus , INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemCode, SAL_InvoiceHeader.Billedtoid AS BilledTo, SAL_InvoiceDetail.DiscountAmountTaken as Discount ,SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno as CustomerRefNo , SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) ) as ExclusiveSalesTaxAmount
, case when isnull(SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo,'') = '' then ( Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].Rate / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) ) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) else Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0) end ) else 0 end AS SaleTaxAmount
, --(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount case when isnull(SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo,'') = '' then ( (Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.Rate / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount )) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) else Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount,0) end) ) else 0 end as ExciseDutyActualAmount
, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount ,SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID, Brokername.CustomerName as DealerName, --[SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate as SaleOrderDate case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate end as SaleOrderDate
,(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * case when COnvert(decimal(18,2),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) > 0 then COnvert(decimal(18,2),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) else (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end))end))) As AmountReceivable,
([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate) as ActualInvoiceAmount ,SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo, SAL_OrderHeader.DTREDate ,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)AdvanceAmount ,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)WHAdvance
,ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)FurtherTaxAdvance ,Convert(int,ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive,0))Inclusive From SAL_InvoiceDetail Inner Join SAL_InvoiceHeader ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 Left JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID
LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status=1
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Inner Join SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And INNER Join AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID --AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And -- And AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer Brokername ON Brokername.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID -- AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID Inner Join INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID Inner Join SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceCurrencyID Left Join SET_City AS CityCust ON CityCust.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID Left Join SET_Term ON SET_Term.TermID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.TermsID Left Join SET_UnitOfMeasure ON SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID = SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID Left Join AR_SET_Customer ARS ON ARS.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.billedtoid --And ARS.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And ARS.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
Left Join SET_City AS SC ON SC.CityID = ARS.CityID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 --and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
where SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 {2} --and INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
Union All
Select SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName,SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID,SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID, Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName, '' As BilledtoName, '' AS BilledtoAddress, '' As BilledtoZipCode, '' AS BilledtoPhone, '' As BilledtoCity, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID as InvoiceHeaderID, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType AS InvoiceType, (Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber, 0 AS DispatchNo, 0 AS DeliveryOrderNo, 0 as ContractNo,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as CustomerName, FORMAT( Convert(int , isnull(replace(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,'-','' ),0)), '#######-#') as NTNNumber, '' as InvoicedDescription, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 AS CustomerAddress, AR_SET_Customer.ZipCode AS CustomerZipCode, CityCust.CityName AS CustomerCity, AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber AS CustomerPhone, '' AS Terms, '' As ItemDescription, '' as UOMName, 0 as QuantityInvoiced, Sal_InvoiceHeader.Description As InvoiceComments, Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoicedTo, 0 as UnitPrice, 0 as TaxAmount, SET_Currency.CurrencySign, 0 as ExciseDutyAmount, 0 as FEDAmount, ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5), '') as DocumentStatus , '0' as ItemCode, SAL_InvoiceHeader.Billedtoid AS BilledTo, 0 as Discount ,'0' as CustomerRefNo , 0 as WithHolding, 0 as ExclusiveSalesTaxAmount , 0 as SaleTaxAmount , 0 as ExciseDutyActualAmount , 0 as FEDTaxAmount , 0 as WithHoldingAmount ,0 as BrokerID, '' as DealerName, '' as SaleOrderDate , Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount as AmountReceivable,
Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount as ActualInvoiceAmount ,'0' as DTRENo, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DTREDate ,0 as AdvanceAmount,0,0 ,Convert(int,0)Inclusive from SAL_InvoiceHeader
left Join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Status = 1
inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID
Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId
Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId
Inner Join SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType
Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID Inner Join AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID --AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And
Inner Join SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceCurrencyID
Left Join SET_City AS CityCust ON CityCust.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID Left Join SET_Term ON SET_Term.TermID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.TermsID Left Join AR_SET_Customer ARS ON ARS.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.billedtoid --AND ARS.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And ARS.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
Left Join SET_City AS SC ON SC.CityID = ARS.CityID
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 --and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
where SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 --And SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sales Invoice%Mud%' {2} --and SAL_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
)FinalTAB Where FinalTAB.InvoiceDate between @FromDate and @ToDate group by FinalTAB.PeriodSetName, FinalTAB.Inclusive,FinalTAB.InvoiceDate ,FinalTAB.OperatingUnitName,FinalTAB.CompanyID,FinalTAB.PeriodID )Tab
)Fintab group by Fintab.mnth,Fintab.Months,Fintab.OperatingUnitName,Fintab.CompanyID,Fintab.PeriodID

data.value:
SELECT Distinct [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType as InvoiceType ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceDate,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].Description ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceNumber, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo as DeliveryOrderNo --,Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced as Quantity
, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced *
(select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc)
/ 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as ExciseDutyActualAmount
--, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SaleTaxAmount ,(case when ( SAL_OrderDetail.Rate <=
--(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' (case when
--SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' (select top 1 isnull(Inclusive,0) as Inclusive from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) = 1
then (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) else ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) - ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 36 No (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced--SAL_OrderDetail.Quantity else
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced--SAL_OrderDetail.Quantity else (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount) end)
end) else --((([SAL_OrderDetail].[NetAmount]-[SAL_OrderDetail].WithHoldingAmount) * [SAL_OrderDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_OrderDetail].[SalesTaxAmount])) ((( ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice ) - --WithHolding --((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice)* ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / 100 ) (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice) * ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding)
) * [SAL_OrderDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_OrderDetail].[SalesTaxAmount])) end )as SaleTaxAmount , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount --, (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG) * --( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice ) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced ,INV_Item.UnitWeight ,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG , SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SalesTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding as WithHoldingTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as ExciseDutyAmountTaxPer ,[SAL_OrderHeader].DTRENo , [SAL_OrderHeader].DTREDate --,(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight) * [SAL_OrderDetail].PriceperKG) As AmountReceivable ,(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice )) As AmountReceivable ,SET_Business.BusinessName as SupplierName ,SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName as SupplierNameComplete ,SET_Business.AddressLine1 as SupplierAddress ,SET_Business.NTNNumber as SupplierNTN, SET_Business.PhoneNumber as SupplierPhoneNumber , SET_Business.SalesTaxNumber as SupplierSTRN, [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid, BC.CustomerName as BIllTo, --AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerNameII as CustomerName ,AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 as CustomerAddress, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as CustomerNTN, AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber as CustomerPhoneNumber ,AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber as CustomeSTRN --,AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerCNICII as CNICNumber, [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo as DispatchNo, INV_Item.Description as ItemDescription ,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemStatusCode, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, Abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity]) AS [BaseQuantity] ,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].Transactioncost as UnitPrice, [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],[SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount, [SAL_OrderDetail].[T_GrossAmount], ((isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount,0)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0)) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100 as TaxPayable ,--[SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount + (isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[GrossAmount],0) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100 as TotalAmount ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount + ((isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount,0)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0)) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0) as TotalAmount ,null as LogoImage ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerAddress as Shipto,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].Description as DescriptionTagNo, SAL_InvoiceDetail.DiscountAmountTaken
,(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+'SI' +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+'SI' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+'SI'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as SINumber
,SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno as CustomerRefNo ,SET_Business.AddressLine1 ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding AS WithHolding ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount AS NetAmount --,SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo AS ContractNo ,case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo end as ContractNo --,SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate AS ContractDate, ,case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate end as ContractDate, --([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount,
([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced *
(select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc)
) as ActualInvoiceAmount,
--([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + -- (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 -- else -- 0 end)) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount, SAL_OrderDetail.GrossAmount As TAmountReceivable, SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID, Brokername.CustomerName as BrokerName ,SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 as UnitAddress, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber as UnitPhoneNo, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber as UnitFaxNo ,Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory as BrokerCategory ,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID),0)AdvanceAmount
, (select distinct stuff(( select distinct ',' + COnvert(varchar(10),u.AdvancePaymentID) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment u where u.AdvancePaymentID = AdvancePaymentID and u.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID
for xml path('') ),1,1,'') as userlist from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID group by AdvancePaymentID) as PaymentReference
,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID),0)WHAdvance
,ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID),0)FurtherTaxAdvance
,case when [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerPRovinceID = 1 then 'Balochistan' when CustomerProvinceID = 2 then 'KPK' when CustomerProvinceID = 3 then 'Punjab' when CustomerProvinceID = 4 then 'Sindh' end as ProvinceName ,case when isnull([INV_Item].PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,0) <> 0 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [INV_Item].UnitWeight) / isnull([INV_Item].PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,1)) else 0 end as QtyinPackets, isnull(SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDFixRate,0) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced as FEDFixAmount
FROM [SAL_InvoiceHeader] INNER JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] On [SAL_InvoiceDetail].InvoiceHeaderID =[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].CompanyID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].PeriodID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].ItemID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID -- inner join Set_PeriodCustom spc_dispatch on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between spc_dispatch.StartDate and spc_dispatch.EndDate --and spc_dispatch.Status = 1 and spc_dispatch.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID Left JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID left join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1 left join [SAL_OrderDetail] on [SAL_OrderDetail].OrderID =SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 And SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
left JOIN INV_SET_Category On INV_SET_Category.CategoryID =INV_Item.ItemTypeID --AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID =INV_Item.CompanyID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer BC ON BC.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer Brokername ON Brokername.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And left JOin SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.uomId=[SAL_InvoiceDetail].ItemUnitID And SET_UnitofMeasure.status=1 WHERE [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[Status] = 1 AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID is null)
