) as ActualInvoiceAmount,
--([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + -- (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 -- else -- 0 end)) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount, SAL_OrderDetail.GrossAmount As TAmountReceivable, SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID, Brokername.CustomerName as BrokerName ,SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 as UnitAddress, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber as UnitPhoneNo, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber as UnitFaxNo ,Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory as BrokerCategory ,SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName ,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID),0)AdvanceAmount
, (select distinct stuff(( select distinct ',' + COnvert(varchar(10),u.AdvancePaymentID) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment u where u.AdvancePaymentID = AdvancePaymentID and u.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID
for xml path('') ),1,1,'') as userlist from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID group by AdvancePaymentID) as PaymentReference
,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID),0)WHAdvance
,ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID),0)FurtherTaxAdvance
,case when [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerPRovinceID = 1 then 'Balochistan' when CustomerProvinceID = 2 then 'KPK' when CustomerProvinceID = 3 then 'Punjab' when CustomerProvinceID = 4 then 'Sindh' end as ProvinceName ,case when isnull([INV_Item].PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,0) <> 0 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [INV_Item].UnitWeight) / isnull([INV_Item].PrimaryUnitOfMeasure,1)) else 0 end as QtyinPackets ,[SAL_GateIn].BiltyName ,[SAL_GateIn].BiltyCnicNo
FROM [SAL_InvoiceHeader] INNER JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] On [SAL_InvoiceDetail].InvoiceHeaderID =[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].CompanyID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].PeriodID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].ItemID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID -- inner join Set_PeriodCustom spc_dispatch on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between spc_dispatch.StartDate and spc_dispatch.EndDate --and spc_dispatch.Status = 1 and spc_dispatch.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID Left JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID left join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1 left join [SAL_OrderDetail] on [SAL_OrderDetail].OrderID =SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 And SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
left JOIN INV_SET_Category On INV_SET_Category.CategoryID =INV_Item.ItemTypeID --AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID =INV_Item.CompanyID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer BC ON BC.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer Brokername ON Brokername.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID Inner Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And left JOin SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.uomId=[SAL_InvoiceDetail].ItemUnitID And SET_UnitofMeasure.status=1
left join [SAL_GateIn] on [SAL_GateIn].DeliveryOrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo And [SAL_GateIn].CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID And [SAL_GateIn].PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID And [SAL_GateIn].Status = 1
WHERE [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[Status] = 1 AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID is null)

data.name: Query_GetAllDispatchWithoutCNICCheck_New
data.value:
--declare @DocumentTypeID int --set @DocumentTypeID = 104 --declare @CustomerID int --set @CustomerID = 500014 --declare @CompanyID int --set @CompanyID = 1 --declare @PeriodID int --set @PeriodID = 1 --declare @FiscalID int --set @FiscalID = 39 --declare @DateFrom datetime --set @DateFrom = '2025-03-23' --declare @DateTo datetime --set @DateTo = '2025-03-25'
Select * from(
Select convert(Varchar(Max),FinTab.DispatchNo) as DispatchNo, Convert(Varchar(Max),FinTab.DispatchID) as DispatchID, FinTab.DispatchDate, FinTab.CustomerID,FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.BrokerID,FinTab.BrokerName, FinTab.IsExporter, FinTab.IsRegistered ,FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.DocumentType, SUM(ABS(FinTab.Quantity) * FinTab.Rate) as TotalAmount ,FinTab.Action ,FinTab.CustomerCNICII ,ContractNo ,ContractID From ( Select * from ( Select (SELECT Distinct STUFF ( (SELECT ',' + D1.DispatchNo FROM SAL_DispatchHeader as D1 Where D1.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID And D1.DocumentTypeID= @DocumentTypeID And D1.Status=1 AND D1.DispatchDate = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate AND D1.CustomerNameII = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerNameII And D1.DispatchNo in (Select DispatchNo from ( Select Tab.Quantity, Tab.DispatchNo, Tab.DocumentTypeID,Tab.CustomerID,Tab.CompanyID, Tab.PeriodID,Tab.FiscalID, Tab.DispatchDate ,SUM(ABS(Tab.Quantity) * Tab.Rate) as TotalAmount ,Tab.CustomerCNICII from ( Select Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ) AS Quantity ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo , [SAL_DispatchHeader].DocumentTypeID,[SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerID,[SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID, [SAL_DispatchHeader].PeriodID,[SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID, [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].TotalAmount ,SAL_ContractDetail.Rate ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerCNICII from SAL_DispatchHeader Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID=SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo=SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID=SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID=SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1
INNER JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode = Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo And INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID And Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.Status=1
INNER JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail ON Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID AND SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status=1
left join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.Status = 1 left join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID and INV_SET_Category.Status = 1
Where [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] =@PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID]= @CompanyID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[FiscalID]=@FiscalID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchDate] Between @DateFrom AND @DateTo And SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode=1 And SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID= @DocumentTypeID {0}
and isnull(INV_SET_Category.SeperateInvoices,0) = 0
)Tab Where Tab.Quantity > 0 group by tab.Quantity,tab.DispatchNo,tab.DocumentTypeID,tab.CustomerID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PeriodID,tab.FiscalID,tab.DispatchDate ,tab.Rate,tab.CustomerCNICII )FinTab) And D1.StatusCode=1 FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '' ) as DispatchNo FROM SAL_DispatchHeader Dispatch2 Where Dispatch2.CustomerID= SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID AND Dispatch2.[DispatchDate] = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate AND Dispatch2.Status=1 GROUP by CustomerID, DispatchDate, DocumentTypeID , CustomerCNICII) as DispatchNo ,(SELECT Distinct STUFF ( (SELECT ',' + Cast(D3.DispatchID as Varchar) FROM SAL_DispatchHeader as D3 Where D3.CustomerID=SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID And D3.DocumentTypeID= @DocumentTypeID And D3.Status= 1 AND D3.DispatchDate = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate AND D3.CustomerNameII = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerNameII And D3.DispatchNo in (Select DispatchNo from ( Select Tab.Quantity, Tab.DispatchNo, Tab.DocumentTypeID,Tab.CustomerID,Tab.CompanyID, Tab.PeriodID,Tab.FiscalID, Tab.DispatchDate ,SUM(ABS(Tab.Quantity) * Tab.Rate) as TotalAmount from ( Select Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ) AS Quantity ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo , [SAL_DispatchHeader].DocumentTypeID,[SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerID,[SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID, [SAL_DispatchHeader].PeriodID,[SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID, [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate ,[SAL_DispatchHeader].TotalAmount ,SAL_ContractDetail.Rate from SAL_DispatchHeader Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID=SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo=SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID=SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID=SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1
INNER JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode = Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo And INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID And Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.Status=1
INNER JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail ON Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID AND SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = Sal_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID And Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status=1
left join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.Status = 1 left join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID and INV_SET_Category.Status = 1
Where [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] =@PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID]= @CompanyID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[FiscalID]=@FiscalID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchDate] Between @DateFrom AND @DateTo And SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode=1 And SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID= @DocumentTypeID {0}
and isnull(INV_SET_Category.SeperateInvoices,0) = 0
)Tab Where Tab.Quantity > 0 group by tab.Quantity,tab.DispatchNo,tab.DocumentTypeID,tab.CustomerID,tab.CompanyID,tab.PeriodID,tab.FiscalID,tab.DispatchDate ,tab.Rate )FinTab) And D3.StatusCode=1 FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '' ) as DispatchNo FROM SAL_DispatchHeader Dispatch3 Where Dispatch3.CustomerID= SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID AND Dispatch3.[DispatchDate] = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate GROUP by CustomerID, DispatchDate, DocumentTypeID , CustomerCNICII) as DispatchID ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate, CostCentreID,SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter,AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,Brokers.CustomerID as BrokerID,Brokers.CustomerName as BrokerName, SAL_DispatchHeader.LocationID,SET_Location.LocationName , SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType , SAL_DispatchHeader.TotalAmount ,SAL_ContractDetail.Rate ,'Add' as Action, Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ) AS Quantity ,SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII , SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo ,SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID From SAL_DispatchHeader Left Join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID= SAL_DispatchHeader.CostCentreID AND SET_CostCenter.Status=1 Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID=SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0
Inner Join AR_SET_Customer Brokers on Brokers.CustomerID=SAL_DispatchHeader.BrokerID AND Brokers.status = 1
Left Join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID=SAL_DispatchHeader.LocationID AND SET_Location.Status=1 Inner Join Set_PeriodCustom on Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID=SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND Set_PeriodCustom.PeriodID=SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID=SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID inner Join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID= SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID= SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID= SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID=SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo=SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID=SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID=SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID=SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID And INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID And INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1
Left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1
Inner JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status = 1 inner Join [SAL_OrderHeader] on [SAL_OrderHeader].OrderID= SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID AND [SAL_OrderHeader].CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND [SAL_OrderHeader].PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID AND [SAL_OrderHeader].Status=1
inner join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
inner join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
left join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID and INV_Item.Status = 1 left join INV_SET_Category on INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID and INV_SET_Category.Status = 1
WHERE [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID]= @CompanyID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[FiscalID]= @FiscalID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchDate] Between @DateFrom AND @DateTo And SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode=1 And SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID= @DocumentTypeID {0}
and isnull(INV_SET_Category.SeperateInvoices,0) = 0 )Tab Where Tab.Quantity>0 And Tab.DispatchNo is not null )FinTab Group By FinTab.DispatchNo, FinTab.DispatchID, FinTab.DispatchDate, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName,FinTab.BrokerID,FinTab.BrokerName, FinTab.IsExporter, FinTab.IsRegistered, FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.Action ,FinTab.CustomerCNICII,ContractNo,ContractID

Select convert(Varchar(Max),FinTab.DispatchNo) as DispatchNo, Convert(Varchar(Max),FinTab.DispatchID) as DispatchID, FinTab.DispatchDate, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName,FinTab.BrokerID,FinTab.BrokerName, FinTab.IsExporter, FinTab.IsRegistered ,FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.DocumentType, SUM(ABS(FinTab.Quantity) * FinTab.Rate) as TotalAmount ,FinTab.Action ,FinTab.CustomerCNICII ,ContractNo ,ContractID From ( Select * from ( Select DispatchNo , DispatchID ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate, CostCentreID,SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter,AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,Brokers.CustomerID as BrokerID,Brokers.CustomerName as BrokerName, SAL_DispatchHeader.LocationID,SET_Location.LocationName , SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType , SAL_DispatchHeader.TotalAmount ,SAL_ContractDetail.Rate ,'Add' as Action, Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) -
